verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹ֣ל הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל־מְפִיבֹ֖שֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בֶּן־שָׁא֑וּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּינֹתָ֔ם בֵּ֣ין דָּוִ֔ד וּבֵ֖ין יְהוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vychml hmlkh 'lmpybsht bnyhvntn bnsh'vl 'lshb't yhvh 'shr byntm byn dvd vbyn yhvntn bnsh'vl
verses.translation: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־שְׁ֠נֵ֠י בְּנֵ֨י רִצְפָּ֤ה בַת־אַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלְדָ֣ה לְשָׁא֔וּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִ֖י וְאֶת־מְפִבֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵ֗שֶׁת בְּנֵי֙ מִיכַ֣ל בַּת־שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֛ה לְעַדְרִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּ֖י הַמְּחֹלָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqch hmlkh 'tshny bny rtsph bt'yh 'shr yldh lsh'vl 't'rmny v'tmpbsht v'tchmsht bny mykhl btsh'vl 'shr yldh l'dry'l bnbrzly hmchlty
verses.translation: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֞ם בְּיַ֣ד הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗ים וַיֹּקִיעֻ֤ם בָּהָר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּפְּל֥וּ (שבעתים) [שְׁבַעְתָּ֖ם] יָ֑חַד (והם) [וְהֵ֨מָּה] הֻמְת֜וּ בִּימֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ בָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים (תחלת) [בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת] קְצִ֥יר שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytnm byd hgb'nym vyqy'm bhr lpny yhvh vyplv (shb'tym) [shb'tm] ychd (vhm) [vhmh] hmtv bymy qtsyr br'shnym (tchlt) [btchlt] qtsyr sh'rym
verses.translation: and he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the mountain before the LORD, and they fell all seven together; and they were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח רִצְפָּה֩ בַת־אַיָּ֨ה אֶת־הַשַּׂ֜ק וַתַּטֵּ֨הוּ לָ֤הּ אֶל־הַצּוּר֙ מִתְּחִלַּ֣ת קָצִ֔יר עַ֛ד נִתַּךְ־מַ֥יִם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִן־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־נָתְנָה֩ ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם לָנ֤וּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֶת־חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: vtqch rtsph bt'yh 'thshq vtthv lh 'lhtsvr mtchlt qtsyr 'd ntkhmym 'lyhm mnhshmym vl'ntnh 'vf hshmym lnvch 'lyhm yvmm v'tchyt hshdh lylh
verses.translation: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water was poured upon them from heaven; and she suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֖ד לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֛ה רִצְפָּ֥ה בַת־אַיָּ֖ה פִּלֶ֥גֶשׁ שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vygd ldvd 't 'shr'shth rtsph bt'yh plgsh sh'vl
verses.translation: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־עַצְמ֤וֹת שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֔וֹ מֵאֵ֕ת בַּעֲלֵ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֲשֶׁר֩ גָּנְב֨וּ אֹתָ֜ם מֵרְחֹ֣ב בֵּֽית־שַׁ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר (תלום שם הפלשתים) [תְּלָא֥וּם שָׁ֙מָּה֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים] בְּי֨וֹם הַכּ֧וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אֶת־שָׁא֖וּל בַּגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vylkh dvd vyqch 't'tsmvt sh'vl v't'tsmvt yhvntn bnv m't b'ly ybysh gl'd 'shr gnbv 'tm mrchb bytshn 'shr (tlvm shm hplshtym) [tl'vm shmh plshtym] byvm hkhvt plshtym 'tsh'vl bglb'
verses.translation: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the broad place of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, in the day that the Philistines slew Saul in Gilboa;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל מִשָּׁם֙ אֶת־עַצְמ֣וֹת שָׁא֔וּל וְאֶת־עַצְמ֖וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣אַסְפ֔וּ אֶת־עַצְמ֖וֹת הַמּוּקָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshm 't'tsmvt sh'vl v't'tsmvt yhvntn bnv vy'spv 't'tsmvt hmvq'ym
verses.translation: and he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁא֣וּל וִיהוֹנָֽתָן־בְּ֠נ֠וֹ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן בְּצֵלָ֗ע בְּקֶ֙בֶר֙ קִ֣ישׁ אָבִ֔יו וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָאָ֖רֶץ אַחֲרֵי־כֵֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqbrv 't'tsmvtsh'vl vyhvntnbnv b'rts bnymn btsl' bqbr qysh 'byv vy'shv khl 'shrtsvh hmlkh vy'tr 'lhym l'rts 'chrykhn {p}
verses.translation: And they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the sepulchre of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ע֧וֹד מִלְחָמָ֛ה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֨רֶד דָּוִ֜ד וַעֲבָדָ֥יו עִמּ֛וֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיָּ֥עַף דָּוִֽד׃
verses.translit: vthy'vd mlchmh lplshtym 'tyshr'l vyrd dvd v'bdyv 'mv vylchmv 'tplshtym vy'f dvd
verses.translation: And the Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines; and David waxed faint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וישבו) [וְיִשְׁבִּ֨י] בְנֹ֜ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר  בִּילִידֵ֣י הָרָפָ֗ה וּמִשְׁקַ֤ל קֵינוֹ֙ שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְה֖וּא חָג֣וּר חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְהַכּ֥וֹת אֶת־דָּוִֽד׃
verses.translit: (vyshbv) [vyshby] bnb 'shr  bylydy hrph vmshql qynv shlsh m'vt mshql nchsht vhv' chgvr chdshh vy'mr lhkhvt 'tdvd
verses.translation: And Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with new armour, thought to have slain David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲזׇר־לוֹ֙ אֲבִישַׁ֣י בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֔ה וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י וַיְמִתֵ֑הוּ אָ֣ז נִשְׁבְּעוּ֩ אַנְשֵֽׁי־דָוִ֨ד ל֜וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־תֵצֵ֨א ע֤וֹד אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תְכַבֶּ֖ה אֶת־נֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'zrlv 'byshy bntsrvyh vykh 'thplshty vymthv 'z nshb'v 'nshydvd lv l'mr l'tts' 'vd 'tnv lmlchmh vl' tkhbh 'tnr yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David swore unto him, saying: ‘Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the lamp of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַתְּהִי־ע֧וֹד הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּג֖וֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים אָ֣ז הִכָּ֗ה סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י אֶת־סַ֕ף אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּילִדֵ֥י הָרָפָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy 'chrykhn vthy'vd hmlchmh bgvb 'mplshtym 'z hkhh sbkhy hchshty 'tsf 'shr byldy hrph {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that there was again war with the Philistines at Gob; then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ע֧וֹד הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּג֖וֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֡ךְ אֶלְחָנָן֩ בֶּן־יַעְרֵ֨י אֹרְגִ֜ים בֵּ֣ית הַלַּחְמִ֗י אֵ֚ת גׇּלְיָ֣ת הַגִּתִּ֔י וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔וֹ כִּמְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vthy'vd hmlchmh bgvb 'mplshtym vykh 'lchnn bny'ry 'rgym byt hlchmy 't glyt hgty v'ts chnytv khmnvr 'rgym {s}
verses.translation: And there was again war with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim the Beth-lehemite slew Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּגַ֑ת וַיְהִ֣י  אִ֣ישׁ (מדין) [מָד֗וֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹ֣ת יָדָיו֩ וְאֶצְבְּעֹ֨ת רַגְלָ֜יו שֵׁ֣שׁ וָשֵׁ֗שׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבַּע֙ מִסְפָּ֔ר וְגַם־ה֖וּא יֻלַּ֥ד לְהָרָפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vthy'vd mlchmh bgt vyhy  'ysh (mdyn) [mdvn] v'tsb't ydyv v'tsb't rglyv shsh vshsh 'shrym v'rb' mspr vgmhv' yld lhrph
verses.translation: And there was again war at Gath, where was a champion, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן־[שִׁמְעָ֖ה] (שמעי) אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: vychrf 'tyshr'l vykhhv yhvntn bn[shm'h] (shm'y) 'chy dvd
verses.translation: And when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְהָרָפָ֖ה בְּגַ֑ת וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בְיַד־דָּוִ֖ד וּבְיַ֥ד עֲבָדָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 't'rb't 'lh yldv lhrph bgt vyplv byddvd vbyd 'bdyv {p}
verses.translation: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כׇּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vydbr dvd lyhvh 'tdbry hshyrh hz't byvm htsyl yhvh 'tv mkhf khl'ybyv vmkhf sh'vl
verses.translation: And David spoke unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהֹוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh sl'y vmtsdty vmpltyly
verses.translation: and he said: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'lhy tsvry 'chshbv mgny vqrn ysh'y mshgby vmnvsy msh'y mchms tsh'ny
verses.translation: The God who is my rock, in Him I take refuge; My shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, Thou savest me from violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: mhll 'qr' yhvh vm'yby 'vsh'
verses.translation: Praised, I cry, is the LORD, and I am saved from mine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy 'ppny mshbrymvt nchly bly'l yb'tny
verses.translation: For the waves of Death compassed me. The floods of Belial assailed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: chbly sh'vl sbny qdmny mqshy mvt
verses.translation: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of Death confronted me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאׇזְנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: btsrly 'qr' yhvh v'l'lhy 'qr' vyshm' mhykhlv qvly vshv'ty b'znyv
verses.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD, yea, I called unto my God; and out of His temple He heard my voice, and my cry did enter into His ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ותגעש) [וַיִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (vtg'sh) [vytg'sh] vtr'sh h'rts mvsdvt hshmym yrgzv vytg'shv khychrh lv
verses.translation: Then the earth did shake and quake, the foundations of heaven did tremble; they were shaken, because He was wroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'shn b'pv v'sh mpyv t'khl gchlym b'rv mmnv
verses.translation: Smoke arose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth did devour; coals flamed forth from Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyt shmym vyrd v'rpl tcht rglyv
verses.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and thick darkness was under His feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'lkhrvb vy'f vyr' 'lkhnpyrvch
verses.translation: And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, He was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysht chshkh sbybtyv skhvt chshrtmym 'by shchqym
verses.translation: And He made darkness pavilions round about Him, gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: mngh ngdv b'rv gchly'sh
verses.translation: At the brightness before Him coals of fire flamed forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yr'm mnshmym yhvh v'lyvn ytn qvlv
verses.translation: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth His voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק (ויהמם) [וַיָּהֹֽם]׃
verses.translit: vyshlch chtsym vypytsm brq (vyhmm) [vyhm]
verses.translation: And He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 'pqy ym yglv msdvt tbl bg'rt yhvh mnshmt rvch 'pv
verses.translation: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were laid bare by the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: yshlch mmrvm yqchny ymshny mmym rbym
verses.translation: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: ytsylny m'yby 'z mshn'y khy 'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: He delivered me from mine enemy most strong, from them that hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: yqdmny byvm 'ydy vyhy yhvh msh'n ly
verses.translation: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was a stay unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyts' lmrchb 'ty ychltsny khychpts by
verses.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because He delighted in me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
verses.translit: ygmlny yhvh khtsdqty khbr ydy yshyb ly
verses.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath He recompensed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy shmrty drkhy yhvh vl' rsh'ty m'lhy
verses.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י כׇל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֖ו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: khy khlmshptv lngdy vchqtyv l''svr mmnh
verses.translation: For all His ordinances were before me; And as for His statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'hyh tmym lv v'shtmrh m'vny
verses.translation: And I was single-hearted toward Him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהֹוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshb yhvh ly khtsdqty khbry lngd 'ynyv
verses.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִם־חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mchsyd ttchsd 'mgbvr tmym ttmm
verses.translation: With the merciful Thou dost show Thyself merciful, With the upright man Thou dost show Thyself upright,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִם־נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃
verses.translit: 'mnbr ttbr v'm'qsh ttpl
verses.translation: With the pure Thou dost show Thyself pure; And with the crooked Thou dost show Thyself subtle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֥יךָ עַל־רָמִ֖ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: v't'm 'ny tvshy' v'ynykh 'lrmym tshpyl
verses.translation: And the afflicted people Thou dost save; But Thine eyes are upon the haughty, that Thou mayest humble them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיהֹוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חׇשְׁכִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'th nyry yhvh vyhvh ygyh chshkhy
verses.translation: For Thou art my lamp, O LORD; And the LORD doth lighten my darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: khy bkhh 'rvts gdvd b'lhy 'dlgshvr
verses.translation: For by Thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I scale a wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: h'l tmym drkhv 'mrt yhvh tsrvph mgn hv' lkhl hchsym bv
verses.translation: As for God, His way is perfect; The word of the LORD is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: khy my'l mbl'dy yhvh vmy tsvr mbl'dy 'lhynv
verses.translation: For who is God, save the LORD? And who is a Rock, save our God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים (דרכו) [דַּרְכִּֽי]׃
verses.translit: h'l m'vzy chyl vytr tmym (drkhv) [drkhy]
verses.translation: The God who is my strong fortress, And who letteth my way go forth straight;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה (רגליו) [רַגְלַ֖י] כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: mshvh (rglyv) [rgly] kh'ylvt v'l bmty y'mdny
verses.translation: Who maketh my feet like hinds’, And setteth me upon my high places;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: mlmd ydy lmlchmh vncht qshtnchvshh zr'ty
verses.translation: Who traineth my hands for war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vttnly mgn ysh'kh v'ntkh trbny
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me Thy shield of salvation; And Thy condescension hath made me great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
verses.translit: trchyb ts'dy tchtny vl' m'dv qrsly
verses.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'rdph 'yby v'shmydm vl' 'shvb 'dkhlvtm
verses.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'khlm v'mchtsm vl' yqvmvn vyplv tcht rgly
verses.translation: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, that they cannot arise; Yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vtzrny chyl lmlchmh tkhry' qmy tchtny
verses.translation: For Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'yby tth ly 'rf mshn'y v'tsmytm
verses.translation: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me; Yea, them that hate me, that I might cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃
verses.translit: ysh'v v'yn mshy' 'lyhvh vl' 'nm
verses.translation: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto the LORD, but He answered them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shchqm kh'pr'rts khtytchvtsvt 'dqm 'rq'm
verses.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the streets, and did tread them down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vtpltny mryby 'my tshmrny lr'sh gvym 'm l'yd'ty y'bdny
verses.translation: Thou also hast delivered me from the contentions of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations; A people whom I have not known serve me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny nkhr ytkhchshvly lshmv' 'zn yshm'v ly
verses.translation: The sons of the stranger dwindle away before me; As soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny nkhr yblv vychgrv mmsgrvtm
verses.translation: The sons of the stranger fade away, And come halting out of their close places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־יְהֹוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.translit: chyyhvh vbrvkh tsvry vyrm 'lhy tsvr ysh'y
verses.translation: The LORD liveth, and blessed be my Rock; And exalted be the God, my Rock of salvation; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: h'l hntn nqmt ly vmryd 'mym tchtny
verses.translation: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And bringeth down peoples under me,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vmvtsy'y m'yby vmqmy trvmmny m'ysh chmsym ttsylny
verses.translation: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies; Yea, Thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'vdkh yhvh bgvym vlshmkh 'zmr
verses.translation: Therefore I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the nations, And will sing praises unto Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (מגדיל) [מִגְדּ֖וֹל] יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: (mgdyl) [mgdvl] yshv'vt mlkhv v'shhchsd lmshychv ldvd vlzr'v 'd'vlm {p}
verses.translation: A tower of salvation is He to His king; And showeth mercy to His anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה דִּבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים נְאֻ֧ם דָּוִ֣ד בֶּן־יִשַׁ֗י וּנְאֻ֤ם הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ הֻ֣קַם עָ֔ל מְשִׁ֙יחַ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּנְעִ֖ים זְמִר֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh dbry dvd h'chrnym n'm dvd bnyshy vn'm hgbr hqm 'l mshych 'lhy y'qb vn'ym zmrvt yshr'l
verses.translation: Now these are the last words of David: The saying of David the son of Jesse, And the saying of the man raised on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet singer of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֥וּחַ יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֶּר־בִּ֑י וּמִלָּת֖וֹ עַל־לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: rvch yhvh dbrby vmltv 'llshvny
verses.translation: The spirit of the LORD spoke by me, And His word was upon my tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַר֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ֥י דִבֶּ֖ר צ֣וּר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מוֹשֵׁל֙ בָּאָדָ֔ם צַדִּ֕יק מוֹשֵׁ֖ל יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhy yshr'l ly dbr tsvr yshr'l mvshl b'dm tsdyq mvshl yr't 'lhym
verses.translation: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spoke to me: ‘Ruler over men shall be The righteous, even he that ruleth in the fear of God,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְא֥וֹר בֹּ֖קֶר יִזְרַח־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ בֹּ֚קֶר לֹ֣א עָב֔וֹת מִנֹּ֥גַהּ מִמָּטָ֖ר דֶּ֥שֶׁא מֵאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vkh'vr bqr yzrchshmsh bqr l' 'bvt mngh mmtr dsh' m'rts
verses.translation: And as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds; When through clear shining after rain, The tender grass springeth out of the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־לֹא־כֵ֥ן בֵּיתִ֖י עִם־אֵ֑ל כִּי֩ בְרִ֨ית עוֹלָ֜ם שָׂ֣ם לִ֗י עֲרוּכָ֤ה בַכֹּל֙ וּשְׁמֻרָ֔ה כִּי־כׇל־יִשְׁעִ֥י וְכׇל־חֵ֖פֶץ כִּי־לֹ֥א יַצְמִֽיחַ׃
verses.translit: khyl'khn byty 'm'l khy bryt 'vlm shm ly 'rvkhh bkhl vshmrh khykhlysh'y vkhlchpts khyl' ytsmych
verses.translation: For is not my house established with God? For an everlasting covenant He hath made with me, Ordered in all things, and sure; For all my salvation, and all my desire, Will he not make it to grow?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְלִיַּ֕עַל כְּק֥וֹץ מֻנָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֑הַם כִּי־לֹ֥א בְיָ֖ד יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vbly'l khqvts mnd khlhm khyl' byd yqchv
verses.translation: But the ungodly, they are as thorns thrust away, all of them, For they cannot be taken with the hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ יִגַּ֣ע בָּהֶ֔ם יִמָּלֵ֥א בַרְזֶ֖ל וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית וּבָאֵ֕שׁ שָׂר֥וֹף יִשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בַּשָּֽׁבֶת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ysh yg' bhm yml' brzl v'ts chnyt vb'sh shrvf yshrpv bshbt {p}
verses.translation: But the man that toucheth them Must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear; And they shall be utterly burned with fire in their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד יֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּשֶּׁ֜בֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִ֣י  רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁ֗י ה֚וּא עֲדִינ֣וֹ (העצנו) [הָֽעֶצְנִ֔י] עַל־שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֛וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם (אחד) [אֶחָֽת]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt hgbrym 'shr ldvd yshb bshbt tchkhmny  r'sh hshlshy hv' 'dynv (h'tsnv) [h'tsny] 'lshmnh m'vt chll bp'm ('chd) ['cht] {s}
verses.translation: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite; [he lifted up his spear] against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛ו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־[דֹּד֖וֹ] (דדי) בֶּן־אֲחֹחִ֑י בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה (גברים) [הַגִּבֹּרִ֜ים] עִם־דָּוִ֗ד בְּחָרְפָ֤ם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'chrv 'l'zr bn[ddv] (ddy) bn'chchy bshlshh (gbrym) [hgbrym] 'mdvd bchrpm bplshtym n'spvshm lmlchmh vy'lv 'ysh yshr'l
verses.translation: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they jeoparded their lives against the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וּא קָם֩ וַיַּ֨ךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים עַ֣ד  כִּֽי־יָגְעָ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וַתִּדְבַּ֤ק יָדוֹ֙ אֶל־הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהֹוָ֛ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְהָעָ֛ם יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אַחֲרָ֖יו אַךְ־לְפַשֵּֽׁט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hv' qm vykh bplshtym 'd  khyyg'h ydv vtdbq ydv 'lhchrb vy'sh yhvh tshv'h gdvlh byvm hhv' vh'm yshbv 'chryv 'khlpsht {s}
verses.translation: he stood firm, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand did cleave unto the sword; and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to strip the slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו שַׁמָּ֥ה בֶן־אָגֵ֖א הָרָרִ֑י וַיֵּאָסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַחַיָּ֗ה וַתְּהִי־שָׁ֞ם חֶלְקַ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖ס מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'chryv shmh bn'g' hrry vy'spv plshtym lchyh vthyshm chlqt hshdh ml'h 'dshym vh'm ns mpny plshtym
verses.translation: And after him was Shammah the son of Age the Ararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֤ב בְּתוֹךְ־הַחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּילֶ֔הָ וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהֹוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytytsb btvkhhchlqh vytsylh vykh 'tplshtym vy'sh yhvh tshv'h gdvlh {s}
verses.translation: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD wrought a great victory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֨וּ (שלשים) [שְׁלֹשָׁ֜ה] מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים רֹ֗אשׁ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־קָצִיר֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔ד אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וְחַיַּ֣ת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyrdv (shlshym) [shlshh] mhshlshym r'sh vyb'v 'lqtsyr 'ldvd 'lm'rt 'dlm vchyt plshtym chnh b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִ֖ד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּמַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vdvd 'z bmtsvdh vmtsb plshtym 'z byt lchm
verses.translation: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַוֶּ֥ה דָוִ֖ד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבֹּ֥אר בֵּֽית־לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyt'vh dvd vy'mr my yshqny mym mb'r bytlchm 'shr bsh'r {s}
verses.translation: And David longed, and said: ‘Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְקְעוּ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִ֜ים בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־מַ֙יִם֙ מִבֹּ֤אר בֵּֽית־לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־דָּוִ֑ד וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיַּסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybq'v shlsht hgbrym bmchnh plshtym vysh'bvmym mb'r bytlchm 'shr bsh'r vysh'v vyb'v 'ldvd vl' 'bh lshtvtm vyskh 'tm lyhvh
verses.translation: And the three mighty men broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; but he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִ֩ילָה֩ לִּ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה מֵעֲשֹׂ֣תִי זֹ֗את הֲדַ֤ם הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr chlylh ly yhvh m'shty z't hdm h'nshym hhlkhym bnpshvtm vl' 'bh lshtvtm 'lh 'shv shlsht hgbrym {s}
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this; shall I drink the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives?’ therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִישַׁ֞י אֲחִ֣י  יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֗ה ה֚וּא רֹ֣אשׁ (השלשי) [הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה] וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'byshy 'chy  yv'b bntsrvyh hv' r'sh (hshlshy) [hshlshh] vhv' 'vrr 'tchnytv 'lshlsh m'vt chll vlvshm bshlshh
verses.translation: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה֙ הֲכִ֣י נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnhshlshh hkhy nkhbd vyhy lhm lshr v'dhshlshh l'b' {s}
verses.translation: He was most honourable of the three; therefore he was made their captain; howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־אִֽישׁ־[חַ֛יִל] (חי) רַב־פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽקַּבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠ה֠וּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־[הָאֲרִ֛י] (האריה) בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבֹּ֖אר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃
verses.translit: vbnyhv bnyhvyd' bn'ysh[chyl] (chy) rbp'lym mqbts'l hv' hkhh 't shny 'r'l mv'b vhv' yrd vhkhh 't[h'ry] (h'ryh) btvkh hb'r byvm hshlg
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he smote the two altar-hearths of Moab; he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־הִכָּה֩ אֶת־אִ֨ישׁ מִצְרִ֜י (אשר) [אִ֣ישׁ] מַרְאֶ֗ה וּבְיַ֤ד הַמִּצְרִי֙ חֲנִ֔ית וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhv'hkhh 't'ysh mtsry ('shr) ['ysh] mr'h vbyd hmtsry chnyt vyrd 'lyv bshbt vygzl 'thchnyt myd hmtsry vyhrghv bchnytv
verses.translation: and he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man; and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'shh bnyhv bnyhvyd' vlvshm bshlshh hgbrym
verses.translation: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים נִכְבָּ֔ד וְאֶל־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָ֑א וַיְשִׂמֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖ד אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnhshlshym nkhbd v'lhshlshh l'b' vyshmhv dvd 'lmshm'tv {s}
verses.translation: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשָׂהאֵ֥ל אֲחִֽי־יוֹאָ֖ב בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־דֹּד֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shh'l 'chyyv'b bshlshym 'lchnn bnddv byt lchm {s}
verses.translation: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַחֲרֹדִ֔י {ס} אֱלִיקָ֖א הַחֲרֹדִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shmh hchrdy {s} 'lyq' hchrdy {s}
verses.translation: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֚לֶץ הַפַּלְטִ֔י {ס} עִירָ֥א בֶן־עִקֵּ֖שׁ {ס} הַתְּקוֹעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chlts hplty {s} 'yr' bn'qsh {s} htqv'y {s}
verses.translation: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ הָעַנְּתֹתִ֔י {ס} מְבֻנַּ֖י הַחֻשָׁתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'by'zr h'ntty {s} mbny hchshty {s}
verses.translation: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַלְמוֹן֙ הָאֲחֹחִ֔י {ס} מַהְרַ֖י הַנְּטֹפָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tslmvn h'chchy {s} mhry hntpty {s}
verses.translation: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶב בֶּֽן־בַּעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטֹפָתִ֑י {ס} אִתַּי֙ בֶּן־רִיבַ֔י מִגִּבְעַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chlb bnb'nh hntpty {s} 'ty bnryby mgb't bny bnymn {s}
verses.translation: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ פִּרְעָ֣תֹנִ֔י {ס} הִדַּ֖י מִנַּ֥חֲלֵי גָֽעַשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyhv pr'tny {s} hdy mnchly g'sh {s}
verses.translation: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of Nahale-gaash;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבִֽי־עַלְבוֹן֙ הָעַרְבָתִ֔י {ס} עַזְמָ֖וֶת הַבַּרְחֻמִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'by'lbvn h'rbty {s} 'zmvt hbrchmy {s}
verses.translation: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְיַחְבָּא֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַלְבֹנִ֔י {ס} בְּנֵ֥י יָשֵׁ֖ן יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lychb' hsh'lbny {s} bny yshn yhvntn {s}
verses.translation: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַהֲרָרִ֔י {ס} אֲחִיאָ֥ם בֶּן־שָׁרָ֖ר הָארָרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shmh hhrry {s} 'chy'm bnshrr h'rry {s}
verses.translation: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלִיפֶ֥לֶט בֶּן־אֲחַסְבַּ֖י בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י {ס} אֱלִיעָ֥ם בֶּן־אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל הַגִּלֹנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lyplt bn'chsby bnhm'khty {s} 'ly'm bn'chytpl hglny {s}
verses.translation: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (חצרו) [חֶצְרַי֙] הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י {ס} פַּעֲרַ֖י הָאַרְבִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: (chtsrv) [chtsry] hkhrmly {s} p'ry h'rby {s}
verses.translation: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְאָ֤ל בֶּן־נָתָן֙ מִצֹּבָ֔ה {ס} בָּנִ֖י הַגָּדִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yg'l bnntn mtsbh {s} bny hgdy {s}
verses.translation: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמֹּנִ֑י {ס} נַחְרַי֙ הַבְּאֵ֣רֹתִ֔י (נשאי) [נֹשֵׂ֕א] כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרֻיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tslq h'mny {s} nchry hb'rty (nsh'y) [nsh'] khly yv'b bntsryh {s}
verses.translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armour-bearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י {ס} גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yr' hytry {s} grb hytry {s}
verses.translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י כֹּ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'vryh hchty khl shlshym vshb'h {p}
verses.translation: Uriah the Hittite. Thirty and seven in all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙סֶף֙ אַף־יְהֹוָ֔ה לַחֲר֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֨סֶת אֶת־דָּוִ֤ד בָּהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ מְנֵ֥ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vysf 'fyhvh lchrvt byshr'l vyst 'tdvd bhm l'mr lkh mnh 'tyshr'l v'tyhvdh
verses.translation: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and He moved David against them, saying: ‘Go, number Israel and Judah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָ֣ב  שַׂר־הַחַ֣יִל אֲשֶׁר־אִתּ֗וֹ שֽׁוּט־נָ֞א בְּכׇל־שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וּפִקְד֖וּ אֶת־הָעָ֑ם וְיָ֣דַעְתִּ֔י אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר הָעָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'lyv'b  shrhchyl 'shr'tv shvtn' bkhlshbty yshr'l mdn v'db'r shb' vpqdv 'th'm vyd'ty 't mspr h'm {s}
verses.translation: And the king said to Joab the captain of the host that was with him: ‘Go now to and fro through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the sum of the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹאָ֜ב אֶל־הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיוֹסֵ֣ף יְהֹוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֶל־הָעָ֜ם כָּהֵ֤ם ׀ וְכָהֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים וְעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ רֹא֑וֹת וַאדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥מָּה חָפֵ֖ץ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b 'lhmlkh vyvsf yhvh 'lhykh 'lh'm khhm  vkhhm m'h p'mym v'yny 'dnyhmlkh r'vt v'dny hmlkh lmh chpts bdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Joab said unto the king: ‘Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they may be, a hundredfold, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it; but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק דְּבַר־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־יוֹאָ֔ב וְעַ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וַיֵּצֵ֨א יוֹאָ֜ב וְשָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֙יִל֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְקֹ֥ד אֶת־הָעָ֖ם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vychzq dbrhmlkh 'lyv'b v'l shry hchyl vyts' yv'b vshry hchyl lpny hmlkh lpqd 'th'm 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בַעֲרוֹעֵ֗ר יְמִ֥ין הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּ֥חַל הַגָּ֖ד וְאֶל־יַעְזֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'brv 'thyrdn vychnv b'rv'r ymyn h'yr 'shr btvkhhnchl hgd v'ly'zr
verses.translation: And they passed over the Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and unto Jazer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔דָה וְאֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֖ים חׇדְשִׁ֑י וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ דָּ֣נָה יַּ֔עַן וְסָבִ֖יב אֶל־צִידֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyb'v hgl'dh v'l'rts tchtym chdshy vyb'v dnh y'n vsbyb 'ltsydvn
verses.translation: then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and round about to Zidon,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִבְצַר־צֹ֔ר וְכׇל־עָרֵ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י וַיֵּ֥צְא֛וּ אֶל־נֶ֥גֶב יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.translit: vyb'v mbtsrtsr vkhl'ry hchvy vhkhn'ny vyts'v 'lngb yhvdh b'r shb'
verses.translation: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beer-sheba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֖טוּ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ מִקְצֵ֨ה תִשְׁעָ֧ה חֳדָשִׁ֛ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים י֖וֹם יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyshtv bkhlh'rts vyb'v mqtsh tsh'h chdshym v'shrym yvm yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: So when they had gone to and fro through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת־מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד־הָעָ֖ם אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתְּהִ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שְֽׁמֹנֶה֩ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף אִֽישׁ־חַ֙יִל֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה חֲמֵשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vytn yv'b 'tmspr mpqdh'm 'lhmlkh vthy yshr'l shmnh m'vt 'lf 'yshchyl shlf chrb v'ysh yhvdh chmshm'vt 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤ךְ לֵב־דָּוִד֙ אֹת֔וֹ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן סָפַ֣ר אֶת־הָעָ֑ם {פ} וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֗ה חָטָ֤אתִֽי מְאֹד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה הַֽעֲבֶר־נָא֙ אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן עַבְדְּךָ֔ כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vykh lbdvd 'tv 'chrykhn spr 'th'm {p} vy'mr dvd 'lyhvh cht'ty m'd 'shr 'shyty v'th yhvh h'brn' 't'vn 'bdkh khy nskhlty m'd
verses.translation: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD: ‘I have sinned greatly in what I have done; but now, O LORD, put away, I beseech Thee, the iniquity of Thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קׇם דָּוִ֖ד בַּבֹּ֑קֶר {פ} וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־גָּ֣ד הַנָּבִ֔יא חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqm dvd bbqr {p} vdbryhvh hyh 'lgd hnby' chzh dvd l'mr
verses.translation: And when David rose up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֶל־דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שָׁלֹ֕שׁ אָנֹכִ֖י נוֹטֵ֣ל עָלֶ֑יךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ֥ אַחַת־מֵהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hlvkh vdbrt 'ldvd khh 'mr yhvh shlsh 'nkhy nvtl 'lykh bchrlkh 'chtmhm v''shhlkh
verses.translation: ’Go and speak unto David: Thus saith the LORD: I lay upon thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא־גָ֥ד אֶל־דָּוִ֖ד וַיַּגֶּד־ל֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֡וֹ הֲתָב֣וֹא לְךָ֣ שֶׁבַע־שָׁנִ֣ים ׀ רָעָ֣ב ׀ בְּאַרְצֶ֡ךָ אִם־שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳ֠דָשִׁ֠ים נֻסְךָ֨ לִפְנֵי־צָרֶ֜יךָ וְה֣וּא רֹדְפֶ֗ךָ וְאִם־הֱ֠י֠וֹת שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֥ים דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּאַרְצֶ֔ךָ עַתָּה֙ דַּ֣ע וּרְאֵ֔ה מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖י דָּבָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb'gd 'ldvd vygdlv vy'mr lv htbv' lkh shb'shnym  r'b  b'rtskh 'mshlshh chdshym nskh lpnytsrykh vhv' rdpkh v'mhyvt shlsht ymym dbr b'rtskh 'th d' vr'h mh'shyb shlchy dbr {s}
verses.translation: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him: ‘Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thy foes while they pursue thee? or shall there be three days’pestilence in thy land? now advise thee, and consider what answer I shall return to Him that sent Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־גָּ֖ד צַר־לִ֣י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְּלָה־נָּ֤א בְיַד־יְהֹוָה֙ כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים רַחֲמָ֔ו וּבְיַד־אָדָ֖ם אַל־אֶפֹּֽלָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'lgd tsrly m'd nplhn' bydyhvh khyrbym rchmv vbyd'dm 'l'plh
verses.translation: And David said unto Gad: ‘I am in a great strait; let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for His mercies are great; and let me not fall into the hand of man.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֥ה דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵהַבֹּ֖קֶר וְעַד־עֵ֣ת מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיָּ֣מׇת מִן־הָעָ֗ם מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh dbr byshr'l mhbqr v'd't mv'd vymt mnh'm mdn v'db'r shb' shb'ym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed; and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יָד֨וֹ הַמַּלְאָ֥ךְ ׀ יְֽרוּשָׁלַ֘͏ִם֮ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ֒ וַיִּנָּ֤חֶם יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַ֠יֹּ֠אמֶר לַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַמַּשְׁחִ֤ית בָּעָם֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ הָיָ֔ה עִם־גֹּ֖רֶן (האורנה) [הָֽאֲרַ֥וְנָה] הַיְבֻסִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshlch ydv hml'kh  yrvshl͏m lshchth vynchm yhvh 'lhr'h vy'mr lml'kh hmshchyt b'm rb 'th hrf ydkh vml'kh yhvh hyh 'mgrn (h'vrnh) [h'rvnh] hybsy {s}
verses.translation: And when the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented Him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people: ‘It is enough; now stay thy hand.’ And the angel of the LORD was by the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֜ה בִּרְאֹת֣וֹ  אֶֽת־הַמַּלְאָ֣ךְ  הַמַּכֶּ֣ה בָעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֙אתִי֙ וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֶעֱוֵ֔יתִי וְאֵ֥לֶּה הַצֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א יָדְךָ֛ בִּ֖י וּבְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'lyhvh br'tv  'thml'kh  hmkhh b'm vy'mr hnh 'nkhy cht'ty v'nkhy h'vyty v'lh hts'n mh 'shv thy n' ydkh by vbbyt 'by {p}
verses.translation: And David spoke unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said: ‘Lo, I have sinned, and I have done iniquitously; but these sheep, what have they done? let Thy hand, I pray Thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא־גָ֥ד אֶל־דָּוִ֖ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ עֲלֵה֙ הָקֵ֤ם לַֽיהֹוָה֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּגֹ֖רֶן (ארניה) [אֲרַ֥וְנָה] הַיְבֻסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyb'gd 'ldvd byvm hhv' vy'mr lv 'lh hqm lyhvh mzbch bgrn ('rnyh) ['rvnh] hybsy
verses.translation: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him: ‘Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל דָּוִד֙ כִּדְבַר־גָּ֔ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'l dvd khdbrgd kh'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁקֵ֣ף אֲרַ֗וְנָה וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֶת־עֲבָדָ֔יו עֹבְרִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֲרַ֔וְנָה וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyshqf 'rvnh vyr' 'thmlkh v't'bdyv 'brym 'lyv vyts' 'rvnh vyshtchv lmlkh 'pyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Araunah looked forth, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him; and Araunah went out, and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲרַ֔וְנָה מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לִקְנ֧וֹת מֵעִמְּךָ֣ אֶת־הַגֹּ֗רֶן לִבְנ֤וֹת מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְתֵעָצַ֥ר הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvnh mdv' b' 'dnyhmlkh 'l'bdv vy'mr dvd lqnvt m'mkh 'thgrn lbnvt mzbch lyhvh vt'tsr hmgph m'l h'm
verses.translation: And Araunah said: ‘Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant?’ And David said: ‘To buy the threshing-floor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔ד יִקַּ֥ח וְיַ֛עַל אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינָ֑ו רְאֵה֙ הַבָּקָ֣ר לָעֹלָ֔ה וְהַמֹּרִגִּ֛ים וּכְלֵ֥י הַבָּקָ֖ר לָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvnh 'ldvd yqch vy'l 'dny hmlkh htvb b'ynv r'h hbqr l'lh vhmrgym vkhly hbqr l'tsym
verses.translation: And Araunah said unto David: ‘Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him; behold the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing-instruments and the furniture of the oxen for the wood.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּ֗ל נָתַ֛ן אֲרַ֥וְנָה הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ {ס} וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִרְצֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hkhl ntn 'rvnh hmlkh lmlkh {s} vy'mr 'rvnh 'lhmlkh yhvh 'lhykh yrtskh
verses.translation: All this did Araunah the king give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king: ‘The LORD thy God accept thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַ֗וְנָה לֹ֚א כִּֽי־קָנ֨וֹ אֶקְנֶ֤ה מֵאֽוֹתְךָ֙ בִּמְחִ֔יר וְלֹ֧א אַעֲלֶ֛ה לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י עֹל֣וֹת חִנָּ֑ם וַיִּ֨קֶן דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־הַגֹּ֙רֶן֙ וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֔ר בְּכֶ֖סֶף שְׁקָלִ֥ים חֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l'rvnh l' khyqnv 'qnh m'vtkh bmchyr vl' ''lh lyhvh 'lhy 'lvt chnm vyqn dvd 'thgrn v'thbqr bkhsf shqlym chmshym
verses.translation: And the king said unto Araunah: ‘Nay; but I will verily buy it of thee at a price; neither will I offer burnt-offerings unto the LORD my God which cost me nothing.’ So David bought the threshing-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֩בֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤ד מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיֵּעָתֵ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ וַתֵּעָצַ֥ר הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vybn shm dvd mzbch lyhvh vy'l 'lvt vshlmym vy'tr yhvh l'rts vt'tsr hmgph m'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיְכַסֻּ֙הוּ֙ בַּבְּגָדִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִחַ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhmlkh dvd zqn b' bymym vykhshv bbgdym vl' ychm lv
verses.translation: Now King David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he could get no heat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣וֹ עֲבָדָ֗יו יְבַקְשׁ֞וּ לַאדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה וְעָֽמְדָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּתְהִי־ל֖וֹ סֹכֶ֑נֶת וְשָׁכְבָ֣ה בְחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וְחַ֖ם לַאדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'bdyv ybqshv l'dny hmlkh n'rh btvlh v'mdh lpny hmlkh vthylv skhnt vshkhbh bchyqkh vchm l'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: Wherefore his servants said unto him: ‘Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin; and let her stand before the king, and be a companion unto him; and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה יָפָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית וַיָּבִ֥אוּ אֹתָ֖הּ לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vybqshv n'rh yph bkhl gbvl yshr'l vymts'v 't'byshg hshvnmyt vyb'v 'th lmlkh
verses.translation: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה יָפָ֣ה עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וַתְּהִ֨י לַמֶּ֤לֶךְ סֹכֶ֙נֶת֙ וַתְּשָׁ֣רְתֵ֔הוּ וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יְדָעָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhn'rh yph 'dm'd vthy lmlkh skhnt vtshrthv vhmlkh l' yd'h
verses.translation: And the damsel was very fair; and she became a companion unto the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲדֹנִיָּ֧ה בֶן־חַגִּ֛ית מִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י אֶמְלֹ֑ךְ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ ל֗וֹ רֶ֚כֶב וּפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ רָצִ֥ים לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'dnyh bnchgyt mtnsh' l'mr 'ny 'mlkh vy'sh lv rkhb vprshym vchmshym 'ysh rtsym lpnyv
verses.translation: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying: ‘I will be king’; and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־עֲצָב֨וֹ אָבִ֤יו מִיָּמָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּ֖וּעַ כָּ֣כָה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וְגַם־ה֤וּא טֽוֹב־תֹּ֙אַר֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְאֹת֥וֹ יָלְדָ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vl''tsbv 'byv mymyv l'mr mdv' khkhh 'shyt vgmhv' tvbt'r m'd v'tv yldh 'chry 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And his father had not grieved him all his life in saying: ‘Why hast thou done so?’ and he was also a very goodly man; and he was born after Absalom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ דְבָרָ֔יו עִ֚ם יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֔ה וְעִ֖ם אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַֽיַּעְזְר֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhyv dbryv 'm yv'b bntsrvyh v'm 'bytr hkhhn vy'zrv 'chry 'dnyh
verses.translation: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵ֠ן וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וְנָתָ֤ן הַנָּבִיא֙ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י וְרֵעִ֔י וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד לֹ֥א הָי֖וּ עִם־אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vtsdvq hkhhn vbnyhv bnyhvyd' vntn hnby' vshm'y vr'y vhgbvrym 'shr ldvd l' hyv 'm'dnyhv
verses.translation: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men that belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וּמְרִ֔יא עִ֚ם אֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּחֶ֔לֶת אֲשֶׁר־אֵ֖צֶל עֵ֣ין רֹגֵ֑ל וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־כׇּל־אֶחָיו֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְכׇל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עַבְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyzbch 'dnyhv ts'n vbqr vmry' 'm 'bn hzchlt 'shr'tsl 'yn rgl vyqr' 'tkhl'chyv bny hmlkh vlkhl'nshy yhvdh 'bdy hmlkh
verses.translation: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־נָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא וּבְנָיָ֜הוּ וְֽאֶת־הַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'tntn hnby' vbnyhv v'thgbvrym v'tshlmh 'chyv l' qr'
verses.translation: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נָתָ֗ן אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁ֤בַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֣וֹא שָׁמַ֔עַתְּ כִּ֥י מָלַ֖ךְ אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־חַגִּ֑ית וַאֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ דָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'lbtshb' 'mshlmh l'mr hlv' shm't khy mlkh 'dnyhv bnchgyt v'dnynv dvd l' yd'
verses.translation: Then Nathan spoke unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying: ‘Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לְכִ֛י אִיעָצֵ֥ךְ נָ֖א עֵצָ֑ה וּמַלְּטִי֙ אֶת־נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ וְאֶת־נֶ֥פֶשׁ בְּנֵ֖ךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th lkhy 'y'tskh n' 'tsh vmlty 'tnpshkh v'tnpsh bnkh shlmh
verses.translation: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכִ֞י וּבֹ֣אִי  אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְאָמַ֤רְתְּ אֵלָיו֙ הֲלֹֽא־אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ נִשְׁבַּ֤עְתָּ לַאֲמָֽתְךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְאִ֑י וּמַדּ֖וּעַ מָלַ֥ךְ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhy vb'y  'lhmlkh dvd v'mrt 'lyv hl''th 'dny hmlkh nshb't l'mtkh l'mr khyshlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'lkhs'y vmdv' mlkh 'dnyhv
verses.translation: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him: Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thy handmaid, saying: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה עוֹדָ֛ךְ מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת שָׁ֖ם עִם־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽאֲנִי֙ אָב֣וֹא אַחֲרַ֔יִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִ֖י אֶת־דְּבָרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'vdkh mdbrt shm 'mhmlkh v'ny 'bv' 'chrykh vml'ty 'tdbrykh
verses.translation: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֨א בַת־שֶׁ֤בַע אֶל־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַחַ֔דְרָה וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וַאֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית מְשָׁרַ֖ת אֶת־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vtb' btshb' 'lhmlkh hchdrh vhmlkh zqn m'd v'byshg hshvnmyt mshrt 'thmlkh
verses.translation: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber.—Now the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקֹּ֣ד בַּת־שֶׁ֔בַע וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vtqd btshb' vtshtchv lmlkh vy'mr hmlkh mhlkh
verses.translation: And Bath-sheba bowed, and prostrated herself unto the king. And the king said: ‘What wouldest thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֲדֹנִי֙ אַתָּ֨ה נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתָּ בַּיהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֵ֖ךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסְאִֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'dny 'th nshb't byhvh 'lhykh l'mtkh khyshlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'lkhs'y
verses.translation: And she said unto him: ‘My lord, thou didst swear by the LORD thy God unto thy handmaid: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אֲדֹנִיָּ֖ה מָלָ֑ךְ וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'th hnh 'dnyh mlkh v'th 'dny hmlkh l' yd't
verses.translation: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and thou, my lord the king, knowest it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּזְבַּ֠ח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ {פ} וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְכׇל־בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וּלְיֹאָ֖ב שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyzbch shvr vmry'vts'n lrb {p} vyqr' lkhlbny hmlkh vl'bytr hkhhn vly'b shr htsb' vlshlmh 'bdkh l' qr'
verses.translation: And he hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar, the priest, and Joab the captain of the host; but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עֵינֵ֥י כׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלֶ֑יךָ לְהַגִּ֣יד לָהֶ֔ם מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'th 'dny hmlkh 'yny khlyshr'l 'lykh lhgyd lhm my yshb 'lkhs' 'dnyhmlkh 'chryv
verses.translation: And thou, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּשְׁכַ֥ב אֲדֹנִֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְהָיִ֗יתִי אֲנִ֛י וּבְנִ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חַטָּאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh khshkhb 'dnyhmlkh 'm'btyv vhyyty 'ny vbny shlmh cht'ym
verses.translation: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה עוֹדֶ֥נָּה מְדַבֶּ֖רֶת עִם־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְנָתָ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא בָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vhnh 'vdnh mdbrt 'mhmlkh vntn hnby' b'
verses.translation: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֖ה נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vygydv lmlkh l'mr hnh ntn hnby' vyb' lpny hmlkh vyshtchv lmlkh 'l'pyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And they told the king, saying: ‘Behold Nathan the prophet.’ And when he was come in before the king, he bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ נָתָן֒ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּ֖הוּ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסְאִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'dny hmlkh 'th 'mrt 'dnyhv ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'lkhs'y
verses.translation: And Nathan said: ‘My lord, O king, hast thou said: Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  יָרַ֣ד הַיּ֗וֹם וַ֠יִּזְבַּ֠ח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְכׇל־בְּנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ וּלְאֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנָּ֛ם אֹכְלִ֥ים וְשֹׁתִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khy  yrd hyvm vyzbch shvr vmry'vts'n lrb vyqr' lkhlbny hmlkh vlshry htsb' vl'bytr hkhhn vhnm 'khlym vshtym lpnyv vy'mrv ychy hmlkh 'dnyhv
verses.translation: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say: Long live king Adonijah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִ֣י אֲנִֽי־עַ֠בְדֶּ֠ךָ וּלְצָדֹ֨ק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִבְנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.translit: vly 'ny'bdkh vltsdq hkhhn vlbnyhv bnyhvyd' vlshlmh 'bdkh l' qr'
verses.translation: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon hath he not called.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ נִֽהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הוֹדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֶֽת־[עַבְדְּךָ֔] (עבדיך) מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'm m't 'dny hmlkh nhyh hdbr hzh vl' hvd't 't['bdkh] ('bdykh) my yshb 'lkhs' 'dnyhmlkh 'chryv {s}
verses.translation: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not declared unto thy servant who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר קִרְאוּ־לִ֖י לְבַת־שָׁ֑בַע וַתָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh dvd vy'mr qr'vly lbtshb' vtb' lpny hmlkh vt'md lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then king David answered and said: ‘Call me Bath-sheba.’ And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר חַי־יְהֹוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָ֥ה אֶת־נַפְשִׁ֖י מִכׇּל־צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshb' hmlkh vy'mr chyyhvh 'shrpdh 'tnpshy mkhltsrh
verses.translation: And the king swore and said: ‘As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי לָ֜ךְ בַּיהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֛וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסְאִ֖י תַּחְתָּ֑י כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy kh'shr nshb'ty lkh byhvh 'lhy yshr'l l'mr khyshlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'lkhs'y tchty khy khn ''shh hyvm hzh
verses.translation: verily as I swore unto thee by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; verily so will I do this day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקֹּ֨ד בַּת־שֶׁ֤בַע אַפַּ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתֹּ֕אמֶר יְחִ֗י אֲדֹנִ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לְעֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtqd btshb' 'pym 'rts vtshtchv lmlkh vt'mr ychy 'dny hmlkh dvd l'lm {p}
verses.translation: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and prostrated herself to the king, and said: ‘Let my lord king David live for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד קִרְאוּ־לִ֞י לְצָד֤וֹק הַכֹּהֵן֙ וּלְנָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְלִבְנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  hmlkh dvd qr'vly ltsdvq hkhhn vlntn hnby' vlbnyhv bnyhvyd' vyb'v lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And king David said: ‘Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.’ And they came before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לָהֶ֗ם קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ אֶת־עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם֙ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י עַל־הַפִּרְדָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־לִ֑י וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־גִּחֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lhm qchv 'mkhm 't'bdy 'dnykhm vhrkhbtm 'tshlmh bny 'lhprdh 'shrly vhvrdtm 'tv 'lgchvn
verses.translation: And the king said unto them: ‘Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֣ח אֹת֣וֹ שָׁ֠ם צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְנָתָ֧ן הַנָּבִ֛יא לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּתְקַעְתֶּם֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vmshch 'tv shm tsdvq hkhhn vntn hnby' lmlkh 'lyshr'l vtq'tm bshvpr v'mrtm ychy hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel; and blow ye with the horn, and say: Long live king Solomon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲלִיתֶ֣ם אַחֲרָ֗יו וּבָא֙ וְיָשַׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְאִ֔י וְה֥וּא יִמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑י וְאֹת֤וֹ צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lytm 'chryv vb' vyshb 'lkhs'y vhv' ymlkh tchty v'tv tsvyty lhyvt ngyd 'lyshr'l v'lyhvdh
verses.translation: Then ye shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead; and I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ׀ אָמֵ֑ן כֵּ֚ן יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'n bnyhv bnyhvyd' 'thmlkh vy'mr  'mn khn y'mr yhvh 'lhy 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said: ‘Amen; so say the LORD, the God of my lord the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ עִם־אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כֵּ֖ן (יהי) [יִהְיֶ֣ה] עִם־שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וִֽיגַדֵּל֙ אֶת־כִּסְא֔וֹ מִ֨כִּסֵּ֔א אֲדֹנִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.translit: kh'shr hyh yhvh 'm'dny hmlkh khn (yhy) [yhyh] 'mshlmh vygdl 'tkhs'v mkhs' 'dny hmlkh dvd
verses.translation: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be He with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד צָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵ֠ן וְנָתָ֨ן הַנָּבִ֜יא וּבְנָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וְהַכְּרֵתִי֙ וְהַפְּלֵתִ֔י וַיַּרְכִּ֙בוּ֙ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַל־פִּרְדַּ֖ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֹּלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־גִּחֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyrd tsdvq hkhhn vntn hnby' vbnyhv bnyhvyd' vhkhrty vhplty vyrkhbv 'tshlmh 'lprdt hmlkh dvd vylkhv 'tv 'lgchvn
verses.translation: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־קֶ֤רֶן הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ מִן־הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיִּמְשַׁ֖ח אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqch tsdvq hkhhn 'tqrn hshmn mnh'hl vymshch 'tshlmh vytq'v bshvpr vy'mrv khlh'm ychy hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil out of the Tent, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the ram’s horn; and all the people said: ‘Long live king Solomon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ כׇל־הָעָם֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְהָעָם֙ מְחַלְּלִ֣ים בַּחֲלִלִ֔ים וּשְׂמֵחִ֖ים שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּקוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'lv khlh'm 'chryv vh'm mchllym bchllym vshmchym shmchh gdvlh vtbq' h'rts bqvlm
verses.translation: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ וְכׇל־הַקְּרֻאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וְהֵ֖ם כִּלּ֣וּ לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֥וּעַ קֽוֹל־הַקִּרְיָ֖ה הוֹמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm' 'dnyhv vkhlhqr'ym 'shr 'tv vhm khlv l'khl vyshm' yv'b 'tqvl hshvpr vy'mr mdv' qvlhqryh hvmh
verses.translation: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the horn, he said: ‘Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בָּ֑א וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֹּ֔א כִּ֣י אִ֥ישׁ חַ֛יִל אַ֖תָּה וְט֥וֹב תְּבַשֵּֽׂר׃
verses.translit: 'vdnv mdbr vhnh yvntn bn'bytr hkhhn b' vy'mr 'dnyhv b' khy 'ysh chyl 'th vtvb tbshr
verses.translation: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said: ‘Come in; for thou art a worthy man, and bringest good tidings.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַן֙ יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ אֲבָ֕ל אֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִ֖ד הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'n yvntn vy'mr l'dnyhv 'bl 'dnynv hmlkhdvd hmlykh 'tshlmh
verses.translation: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah: ‘Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אִתּֽוֹ־הַ֠מֶּ֠לֶךְ אֶת־צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶת־נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וַיַּרְכִּ֣בוּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל פִּרְדַּ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tvhmlkh 'ttsdvq hkhhn v'tntn hnby' vbnyhv bnyhvyd' vhkhrty vhplty vyrkhbv 'tv 'l prdt hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְשְׁח֣וּ אֹת֡וֹ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא ׀ לְמֶ֜לֶךְ בְּגִח֗וֹן וַיַּעֲל֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ שְׂמֵחִ֔ים וַתֵּהֹ֖ם הַקִּרְיָ֑ה ה֥וּא הַקּ֖וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
