verses.translit: v'shr b'mh hkhrvb hshny mdh 'cht vqtsb 'chd lshny hkhrbym
verses.translation: And the other cherub was ten cubits; both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹמַת֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הָאֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן הַכְּר֥וּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: qvmt hkhrvb h'chd 'shr b'mh vkhn hkhrvb hshny
verses.translation: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ  הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֗י וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת־כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִים֒ וַתִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּכְנַף֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּקִּ֣יר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל־כָּנָֽף׃
verses.translit: vytn 'thkhrvbym btvkh  hbyt hpnymy vyprshv 'tkhnpy hkhrbym vtg' khnfh'chd bqyr vkhnf hkhrvb hshny ng't bqyr hshny vkhnpyhm 'ltvkh hbyt ng't khnf 'lkhnf
verses.translation: And he set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vytsf 'thkhrvbym zhb
verses.translation: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ כׇּל־קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב  קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִמֹרֹ֔ת וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִלִּפְנִ֖ים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v't khlqyrvt hbyt msb  ql' ptvchy mql'vt khrvbym vtmrt vptvry tstsym mlpnym vlchytsvn
verses.translation: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִפְנִ֖ימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'tqrq' hbyt tsph zhb lpnymh vlchytsvn
verses.translation: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַדְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן הָאַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית׃
verses.translit: v't ptch hdbyr 'shh dltvt 'tsyshmn h'yl mzvzvt chmshyt
verses.translation: And for the entrance of the Sanctuary he made doors of olive-wood, the door-posts within the frame having five angles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁ֒מֶן֒ וְקָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵיהֶ֠ם מִקְלְע֞וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְתִמֹרֹ֛ת וּפְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַיָּ֛רֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹר֖וֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vshty dltvt 'tsyshmn vql' 'lyhm mql'vt khrvbym vtmrt vptvry tstsym vtsph zhb vyrd 'lhkhrvbym v'lhtmrvt 'thzhb
verses.translation: And as for the two doors of olive-wood, he carved upon them carvings of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold upon the cherubim, and upon the palm-trees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְפֶ֥תַח הַהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן מֵאֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית׃
verses.translit: vkhn 'shh lptch hhykhl mzvzvt 'tsyshmn m't rb'yt
verses.translation: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door-posts of olive-wood, within a frame four-square;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַדֶּ֤לֶת הָאַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּשְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַדֶּ֥לֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: vshty dltvt 'tsy brvshym shny tsl'ym hdlt h'cht glylym vshny ql'ym hdlt hshnyt glylym
verses.translation: and two doors of cypress-wood; the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְתִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּפְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vql' khrvbym vtmrvt vptry tstsym vtsph zhb myshr 'lhmchqh
verses.translation: And he carved thereon cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.translit: vybn 'thchtsr hpnymyt shlshh tvry gzyt vtvr khrtt 'rzym
verses.translation: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewn stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּיֶ֖רַח זִֽו׃
verses.translit: bshnh hrby'yt ysd byt yhvh byrch zv
verses.translation: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Ziv.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָה֩ הָאַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּיֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְכׇל־דְּבָרָ֖יו וּלְכׇל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֑ו וַיִּבְנֵ֖הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbshnh h'cht 'shrh byrch bvl hv' hchdsh hshmyny khlh hbyt lkhldbryv vlkhlmshptv vybnhv shb' shnym
verses.translation: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּנָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְכַ֖ל אֶת־כׇּל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tbytv bnh shlmh shlsh 'shrh shnh vykhl 'tkhlbytv
verses.translation: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־בֵּ֣ית  יַ֣עַר הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן מֵאָ֨ה אַמָּ֤ה אׇרְכּוֹ֙ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָת֑וֹ עַ֗ל אַרְבָּעָה֙ טוּרֵי֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וּכְרֻת֥וֹת אֲרָזִ֖ים עַל־הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vybn 'tbyt  y'r hlbnvn m'h 'mh 'rkhv vchmshym 'mh rchbv vshlshym 'mh qvmtv 'l 'rb'h tvry 'mvdy 'rzym vkhrtvt 'rzym 'lh'mvdym
verses.translation: For he built the house of the forest of Lebanon: the length thereof was a hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָפֻ֣ן בָּאֶ֗רֶז מִמַּ֙עַל֙ עַל־הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַטּֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vspn b'rz mm'l 'lhtsl'vt 'shr 'lh'mvdym 'rb'ym vchmshh chmshh 'shr htvr
verses.translation: And it was covered with cedar above upon the side-chambers, that lay on forty and five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁקֻפִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה טוּרִ֑ים וּמֶחֱזָ֥ה אֶל־מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vshqpym shlshh tvrym vmchzh 'lmchzh shlsh p'mym
verses.translation: And there were beams in three rows; and light was over against light in three ranks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַפְּתָחִ֥ים וְהַמְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף וּמ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל־מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhlhptchym vhmzvzvt rb'ym shqf vmvl mchzh 'lmchzh shlsh p'mym
verses.translation: And all the doors with their posts were square in the frame; and light was over against light in three ranks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אׇרְכּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רׇחְבּ֑וֹ וְאוּלָם֙ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמֻּדִ֥ים וְעָ֖ב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v't 'vlm h'mvdym 'shh chmshym 'mh 'rkhv vshlshym 'mh rchbv v'vlm 'lpnyhm v'mdym v'b 'lpnyhm
verses.translation: And he made the porch of pillars: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits; and a porch before them; and pillars and thick beams before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֤ם הַכִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפׇּט־שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאֶ֔רֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־הַקַּרְקָֽע׃
verses.translit: v'vlm hkhs' 'shr yshptshm 'lm hmshpt 'shh vspvn b'rz mhqrq' 'dhqrq'
verses.translation: And he made the porch of the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵיתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר־יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָאַחֶ֗רֶת מִבֵּית֙ לָאוּלָ֔ם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וּבַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּאוּלָ֖ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbytv 'shryshb shm chtsr h'chrt mbyt l'vlm khm'shh hzh hyh vbyt y'shh lbtpr'h 'shr lqch shlmh kh'vlm hzh
verses.translation: And his house where he might dwell, in the other court, within the porch, was of the like work. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom Solomon had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה אֲבָנִ֤ים יְקָרֹת֙ כְּמִדּ֣וֹת גָּזִ֔ית מְגֹרָר֥וֹת בַּמְּגֵרָ֖ה מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וּמִמַּסָּד֙ עַד־הַטְּפָח֔וֹת וּמִח֖וּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַגְּדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: khl'lh 'bnym yqrt khmdvt gzyt mgrrvt bmgrh mbyt vmchvts vmmsd 'dhtpchvt vmchvts 'dhchtsr hgdvlh
verses.translation: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewn stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside unto the great court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת אַבְנֵי֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת וְאַבְנֵ֖י שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vmysd 'bnym yqrvt 'bnym gdlvt 'bny 'shr 'mvt v'bny shmnh 'mvt
verses.translation: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִלְמַ֗עְלָה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּמִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָאָֽרֶז׃
verses.translit: vmlm'lh 'bnym yqrvt khmdvt gzyt v'rz
verses.translation: And above were costly stones, after the measure of hewn stones, and cedar-wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָצֵ֨ר הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה סָבִ֗יב שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ טוּרִ֣ים גָּזִ֔ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֣ת אֲרָזִ֑ים וְלַחֲצַ֧ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֛ה הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וּלְאֻלָ֥ם הַבָּֽיִת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vchtsr hgdvlh sbyb shlshh tvrym gzyt vtvr khrtt 'rzym vlchtsr bytyhvh hpnymyt vl'lm hbyt {p}
verses.translation: And the great court round about had three rows of hewn stone, and a row of cedar beams, like as the inner court of the house of the LORD, and the court of the porch of the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֶת־חִירָ֖ם מִצֹּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh shlmh vyqch 'tchyrm mtsr
verses.translation: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹ֒שֶׁת֒ וַ֠יִּמָּלֵ֠א אֶת־הַחׇכְמָ֤ה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה֙ וְאֶת־הַדַּ֔עַת לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־כׇּל־מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bn'shh 'lmnh hv' mmth nptly v'byv 'yshtsry chrsh nchsht vyml' 'thchkhmh v'thtbvnh v'thd't l'shvt khlml'khh bnchsht vybv' 'lhmlkh shlmh vy'sh 'tkhlml'khtv
verses.translation: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛צַר אֶת־שְׁנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָעַמּ֣וּד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְחוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת־הָעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vytsr 'tshny h'mvdym nchsht shmnh 'shrh 'mh qvmt h'mvd h'chd vchvt shtym'shrh 'mh ysb 'th'mvd hshny
verses.translation: Thus he fashioned the two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high each; and a line of twelve cubits did compass it about; [and so] the other pillar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָתֵ֛ת עַל־רָאשֵׁ֥י הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vshty khtrt 'shh ltt 'lr'shy h'mvdym mtsq nchsht chmsh 'mvt qvmt hkhtrt h'cht vchmsh 'mvt qvmt hkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made two capitals of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars; the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂבָכִ֞ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂבָכָ֗ה גְּדִלִים֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שַׁרְשְׁר֔וֹת לַכֹּ֣תָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה לַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: shbkhym m'shh shbkhh gdlym m'shh shrshrvt lkhtrt 'shr 'lr'sh h'mvdym shb'h lkhtrt h'cht vshb'h lkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: He also made nets of checker-work, and wreaths of chain-work, for the capitals which were upon the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וּשְׁנֵי֩ טוּרִ֨ים סָבִ֜יב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֗ת לְכַסּ֤וֹת אֶת־הַכֹּֽתָרֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָרִמֹּנִ֔ים וְכֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לַכֹּתֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'th'mvdym vshny tvrym sbyb 'lhshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 'thkhtrt 'shr 'lr'sh hrmnym vkhn 'shh lkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made the pillars; and there were two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the capitals that were upon the top of the pomegranates; and so did he for the other capital.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹתָרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה שׁוּשַׁ֣ן בָּאוּלָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֖ע אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'shr 'lr'sh h'mvdym m'shh shvshn b'vlm 'rb' 'mvt
verses.translation: And the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily-work, four cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹתָרֹ֗ת עַל־שְׁנֵי֙ הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים גַּם־מִמַּ֙עַל֙ מִלְּעֻמַּ֣ת הַבֶּ֔טֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֵ֣בֶר (שבכה) [הַשְּׂבָכָ֑ה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִ֤ים מָאתַ֙יִם֙ טֻרִ֣ים סָבִ֔יב עַ֖ל הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'lshny h'mvdym gmmm'l ml'mt hbtn 'shr l'br (shbkhh) [hshbkhh] vhrmvnym m'tym trym sbyb 'l hkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And there were capitals above also upon the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network; and the pomegranates were two hundred, in rows round about upon each capital.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים לְאֻלָ֖ם הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־הָעַמּ֣וּד הַיְמָנִ֗י וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמוֹ֙ יָכִ֔ין וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־הָעַמּ֣וּד הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔י וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'th'mdym l'lm hhykhl vyqm 'th'mvd hymny vyqr' 'tshmv ykhyn vyqm 'th'mvd hshm'ly vyqr' 'tshmv b'z
verses.translation: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the temple; and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin; and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן וַתִּתֹּ֖ם מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'l r'sh h'mvdym m'shh shvshn vttm ml'kht h'mvdym
verses.translation: And upon the top of the pillars was lily-work; so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּ֠ה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ עַד־שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָגֹ֣ל  סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ (וקוה) [וְקָו֙] שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thym mvtsq 'shr b'mh mshptv 'dshptv 'gl  sbyb vchmsh b'mh qvmtv (vqvh) [vqv] shlshym b'mh ysb 'tv sbyb
verses.translation: And he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקָעִים֩ מִתַּ֨חַת לִשְׂפָת֤וֹ ׀ סָבִיב֙ סֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּפִ֥ים אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנֵ֤י טוּרִים֙ הַפְּקָעִ֔ים יְצֻקִ֖ים בִּיצֻֽקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vpq'ym mtcht lshptv  sbyb sbbym 'tv 'shr b'mh mqpym 'thym sbyb shny tvrym hpq'ym ytsqym bytsqtv
verses.translation: And under the brim of it round about there were knops which did compass it, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about; the knops were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹמֵ֞ד עַל־שְׁנֵ֧י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים ׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים ׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה  פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכׇל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: 'md 'lshny 'shr bqr shlshh pnym  tspvnh vshlshh pnym  ymh vshlshh  pnym ngbh vshlshh pnym mzrchh vhym 'lyhm mlm'lh vkhl'chryhm byth
verses.translation: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעׇבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָת֛וֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שְׂפַת־כּ֖וֹס פֶּ֣רַח שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בַּ֖ת יָכִֽיל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'byv tpch vshptv khm'shh shptkhvs prch shvshn 'lpym bt ykhyl {p}
verses.translation: And it was a hand-breadth thick; and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily; it held two thousand baths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֛וֹת עֶ֖שֶׂר נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת וְאַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רׇחְבָּ֔הּ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ בָּאַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thmkhnvt 'shr nchsht 'rb' b'mh 'rkh hmkhvnh h'cht v'rb' b'mh rchbh vshlsh b'mh qvmth
verses.translation: And he made the ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּכוֹנָ֖ה מִסְגְּרֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וּמִסְגְּרֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין הַשְׁלַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vzh m'shh hmkhvnh msgrt lhm vmsgrt byn hshlbym
verses.translation: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders; and there were borders between the stays;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַֽל־הַמִּסְגְּר֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר  בֵּ֣ין הַשְׁלַבִּ֗ים אֲרָי֤וֹת ׀ בָּקָר֙ וּכְרוּבִ֔ים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּ֖ים כֵּ֣ן מִמָּ֑עַל וּמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַאֲרָי֣וֹת וְלַבָּקָ֔ר לֹי֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה מוֹרָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'lhmsgrvt 'shr  byn hshlbym 'ryvt  bqr vkhrvbym v'lhshlbym khn mm'l vmtcht l'ryvt vlbqr lyvt m'shh mvrd
verses.translation: and on the borders that were between the stays were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and upon the stays it was in like manner above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ אוֹפַנֵּ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָ֤ה הָאַחַת֙ וְסַרְנֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פַעֲמֹתָ֖יו כְּתֵפֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם מִתַּ֤חַת לַכִּיֹּר֙ הַכְּתֵפ֣וֹת יְצֻק֔וֹת מֵעֵ֥בֶר אִ֖ישׁ לֹיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'rb'h 'vpny nchsht lmkhvnh h'cht vsrny nchsht v'rb'h p'mtyv khtpt lhm mtcht lkhyr hkhtpvt ytsqvt m'br 'ysh lyvt
verses.translation: And every base had four brazen wheels, and axles of brass; and the four feet thereof had undersetters; beneath the laver were the undersetters molten, with wreaths at the side of each.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠פִ֠יהוּ מִבֵּ֨ית לַכֹּתֶ֤רֶת וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וּפִ֙יהָ֙ עָגֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵ֔ן אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֣י הָאַמָּ֑ה וְגַם־עַל־פִּ֙יהָ֙ מִקְלָע֔וֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶ֥ם מְרֻבָּע֖וֹת לֹ֥א עֲגֻלּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vpyhv mbyt lkhtrt vm'lh b'mh vpyh 'gl m'shhkhn 'mh vchtsy h'mh vgm'lpyh mql'vt vmsgrtyhm mrb'vt l' 'glvt
verses.translation: And the mouth of it within the crown and above was a cubit high; and the mouth thereof was round after the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also upon the mouth of it were gravings; and their borders were foursquare, not round.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת הָאוֹפַנִּ֗ים לְמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַֽמִּסְגְּר֔וֹת וִיד֥וֹת הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים בַּמְּכוֹנָ֑ה וְקוֹמַת֙ הָאוֹפַ֣ן הָאֶחָ֔ד אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֥י הָאַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'rb't h'vpnym lmtcht lmsgrvt vydvt h'vpnym bmkhvnh vqvmt h'vpn h'chd 'mh vchtsy h'mh
verses.translation: And the four wheels were underneath the borders; and the axletrees of the wheels were in the base; and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַֽעֲשֵׂה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אוֹפַ֣ן הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֑ה יְדוֹתָ֣ם וְגַבֵּיהֶ֗ם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶ֛ם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶ֖ם הַכֹּ֥ל מוּצָֽק׃
verses.translit: vm'shh h'vpnym khm'shh 'vpn hmrkhbh ydvtm vgbyhm vchshqyhm vchshryhm hkhl mvtsq
verses.translation: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel; their axletrees, and their felloes, and their spokes, and their naves, were all molten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣ע כְּתֵפ֔וֹת אֶ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנּ֔וֹת הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה כְּתֵפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'rb' khtpvt 'l 'rb' pnvt hmkhnh h'cht mnhmkhnh khtpyh
verses.translation: And there were four undersetters at the four corners of each base; the undersetters thereof were of one piece with the base itself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְרֹ֣אשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָ֗ה חֲצִ֧י הָאַמָּ֛ה קוֹמָ֖ה עָגֹ֣ל ׀ סָבִ֑יב וְעַ֨ל רֹ֤אשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vbr'sh hmkhvnh chtsy h'mh qvmh 'gl  sbyb v'l r'sh hmkhnh ydtyh vmsgrtyh mmnh
verses.translation: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high; and on the top of the base the stays thereof and the borders thereof were of one piece therewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְפַתַּ֤ח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וְעַל֙ (ומסגרתיה) [מִסְגְּרֹתֶ֔יהָ] כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲרָי֣וֹת וְתִמֹרֹ֑ת כְּמַעַר־אִ֥ישׁ וְלֹי֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyptch 'lhlcht ydtyh v'l (vmsgrtyh) [msgrtyh] khrvbym 'ryvt vtmrt khm'r'ysh vlyvt sbyb
verses.translation: And on the plates of the stays thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubim, lions, and palm-trees, according to the space of each, with wreaths round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּזֹ֣את עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת עֶ֣שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת מוּצָ֨ק אֶחָ֜ד מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לְכֻלָּֽהְנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khz't 'shh 't 'shr hmkhnvt mvtsq 'chd mdh 'cht qtsb 'chd lkhlhnh {s}
verses.translation: After this manner he made the ten bases; all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה כִיֹּר֖וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבָּעִ֨ים בַּ֜ת יָכִ֣יל  הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֔ד כִּיּ֤וֹר אֶחָד֙ עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָאַחַ֔ת לְעֶ֖שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'shrh khyrvt nchsht 'rb'ym bt ykhyl  hkhyvr h'chd 'rb' b'mh hkhyvr h'chd khyvr 'chd 'lhmkhvnh h'cht l'shr hmkhnvt
verses.translation: And he made ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths; and every laver was four cubits; and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת חָמֵ֞שׁ עַל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ מִיָּמִ֔ין וְחָמֵ֛שׁ עַל־כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת מִשְּׂמֹאל֑וֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֧יִת הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytn 'thmkhnvt chmsh 'lkhtf hbyt mymyn vchmsh 'lkhtf hbyt mshm'lv v'thym ntn mkhtf hbyt hymnyt qdmh mmvl ngb {s}
verses.translation: And he set the bases, five on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house; and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חִיר֔וֹם אֶ֨ת־הַכִּיֹּר֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָ֗ם לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh chyrvm 'thkhyrvt v'thy'ym v'thmzrqvt vykhl chyrm l'shvt 'tkhlhml'khh 'shr 'shh lmlkh shlmh byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Hiram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמֻּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְגֻלֹּ֧ת הַכֹּתָרֹ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mdym shnym vglt hkhtrt 'shr'lr'sh h'mvdym shtym vhshbkhvt shtym lkhsvt 'tshty glvt hkhtrt 'shr 'lr'sh h'mvdym
verses.translation: the two pillars, and the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנֵֽי־טוּרִ֤ים רִמֹּנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'thrmnym 'rb' m'vt lshty hshbkhvt shnytvrym rmnym lshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 'tshty glvt hkhtrt 'shr 'lpny h'mvdym
verses.translation: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָ֑שֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹ֥ת עֲשָׂרָ֖ה עַל־הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'thmkhnvt 'shr v'thkhyrt 'shrh 'lhmkhnvt
verses.translation: and the ten bases, and the ten lavers on the bases;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַיָּ֖ם הָאֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר תַּ֥חַת הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'thym h'chd v'thbqr shnym'shr tcht hym
verses.translation: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַסִּיר֨וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֜ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֣ים (האהל) [הָאֵ֔לֶּה] אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט׃
verses.translit: v'thsyrvt v'thy'ym v'thmzrqvt v't khlhkhlym (h'hl) [h'lh] 'shr 'shh chyrm lmlkh shlmh byt yhvh nchsht mmrt
verses.translation: and the pots, and the shovels, and the basins; even all these vessels, which Hiram made for king Solomon, in the house of the LORD, were of burnished brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵ֖ה הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צָרְתָֽן׃
verses.translit: bkhkhr hyrdn ytsqm hmlkh bm'bh h'dmh byn skhvt vbyn tsrtn
verses.translation: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּנַּ֤ח שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים מֵרֹ֖ב מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vynch shlmh 'tkhlhkhlym mrb m'd m'd l' nchqr mshql hnchsht
verses.translation: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many; the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֛יו לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh 't khlhkhlym 'shr byt yhvh 't mzbch hzhb v'thshlchn 'shr 'lyv lchm hpnym zhb
verses.translation: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of the LORD: the golden altar, and the table whereupon the showbread was, of gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַ֠מְּנֹר֠וֹת חָמֵ֨שׁ מִיָּמִ֜ין וְחָמֵ֧שׁ מִשְּׂמֹ֛אול לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּרֹ֛ת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'thmnrvt chmsh mymyn vchmsh mshm'vl lpny hdbyr zhb sgvr vhprch vhnrt vhmlqchym zhb
verses.translation: and the candlesticks, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the Sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הַסִּפּ֠וֹת וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֹּת֡וֹת לְדַלְתוֹת֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַפְּנִימִ֜י לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים לְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhspvt vhmzmrvt vhmzrqvt vhkhpvt vhmchtvt zhb sgvr vhptvt ldltvt hbyt hpnymy lqdsh hqdshym ldlty hbyt lhykhl zhb {p}
verses.translation: and the cups, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the pans, and the fire-pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, that is, of the temple, of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כׇּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־קׇדְשֵׁ֣י  דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗יו אֶת־הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtshlm khlhml'khh 'shr 'shh hmlkh shlmh byt yhvh vyb' shlmh 'tqdshy  dvd 'byv 'thkhsf v'thzhb v'thkhlym ntn b'tsrvt byt yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Thus all the work that king Solomon wrought in the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated, the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַקְהֵ֣ל שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת־זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֶת־כׇּל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּוֹת֩ נְשִׂיאֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת לִבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֛ה מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'z yqhl shlmh 'tzqny yshr'l 'tkhlr'shy hmtvt nshy'y h'bvt lbny yshr'l 'lhmlkh shlmh yrvshl͏m lh'lvt 't'rvn brytyhvh m'yr dvd hy' tsyvn
verses.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’houses of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ אֶל־הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ כׇּל־אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּיֶ֥רַח הָאֵתָנִ֖ים בֶּחָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqhlv 'lhmlkh shlmh khl'ysh yshr'l byrch h'tnym bchg hv' hchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyb'v khl zqny yshr'l vysh'v hkhhnym 'th'rvn
verses.translation: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ אֶת־אֲר֤וֹן יְהֹוָה֙ וְאֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֑הֶל וַיַּעֲל֣וּ אֹתָ֔ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'lv 't'rvn yhvh v't'hl mv'd v'tkhlkhly hqdsh 'shr b'hl vy'lv 'tm hkhhnym vhlvym
verses.translation: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent; even these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְכׇל־עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַנּוֹעָדִ֣ים עָלָ֔יו אִתּ֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֑וֹן מְזַבְּחִים֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְלֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh vkhl'dt yshr'l hnv'dym 'lyv 'tv lpny h'rvn mzbchym ts'n vbqr 'shr l'ysprv vl' ymnv mrb
verses.translation: And king Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֣אוּ הַ֠כֹּהֲנִ֠ים אֶת־אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֶל־מְקוֹמ֛וֹ אֶל־דְּבִ֥יר הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb'v hkhhnym 't'rvn brytyhvh 'lmqvmv 'ldbyr hbyt 'lqdsh hqdshym 'ltcht khnpy hkhrvbym
verses.translation: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto its place, into the Sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הַכְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם אֶל־מְק֖וֹם הָאָר֑וֹן וַיָּסֹ֧כּוּ הַכְּרֻבִ֛ים עַל־הָאָר֥וֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: khy hkhrvbym prshym khnpym 'lmqvm h'rvn vyskhv hkhrbym 'lh'rvn v'lbdyv mlm'lh
verses.translation: For the cherubim spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּאֲרִ֘כוּ֮ הַבַּדִּים֒ וַיֵּרָאוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַבַּדִּ֤ים מִן־הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וְלֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַח֑וּצָה וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'rkhv hbdym vyr'v r'shy hbdym mnhqdsh 'lpny hdbyr vl' yr'v hchvtsh vyhyv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the staves were so long that the ends of the staves were seen from the holy place, even before the Sanctuary; but they could not be seen without; and there they are unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽאָר֔וֹן רַ֗ק שְׁנֵי֙ לֻח֣וֹת הָאֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִנִּ֥חַ שָׁ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּחֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ עִם־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'yn b'rvn rq shny lchvt h'bnym 'shr hnch shm mshh bchrb 'shr khrt yhvh 'mbny yshr'l bts'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י בְּצֵ֥את הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים מִן־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָ֥ן מָלֵ֖א אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy bts't hkhhnym mnhqdsh vh'nn ml' 'tbyt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יָכְל֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים לַעֲמֹ֥ד לְשָׁרֵ֖ת מִפְּנֵ֣י הֶעָנָ֑ן כִּי־מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'ykhlv hkhhnym l'md lshrt mpny h'nn khyml' khbvdyhvh 'tbyt yhvh {p}
verses.translation: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֖ז אָמַ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה יְהֹוָ֣ה אָמַ֔ר לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן בָּעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.translit: 'z 'mr shlmh yhvh 'mr lshkhn b'rpl
verses.translation: Then spoke Solomon: The LORD hath said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנֹ֥ה בָנִ֛יתִי בֵּ֥ית זְבֻ֖ל לָ֑ךְ מָכ֥וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֖ עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: bnh bnyty byt zbl lkh mkhvn lshbtkh 'vlmym
verses.translation: I have surely built Thee a house of habitation, A place for Thee to dwell in for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶת־פָּנָ֔יו וַיְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכׇל־קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vysb hmlkh 'tpnyv vybrkh 't khlqhl yshr'l vkhlqhl yshr'l 'md
verses.translation: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel; and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּפִ֔יו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י וּבְיָד֥וֹ מִלֵּ֖א לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr dbr bpyv 't dvd 'by vbydv ml' l'mr
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth unto David my father, and hath with His hand fulfilled it, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֜אתִי אֶת־עַמִּ֣י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ מִמִּצְרַ֒יִם֒ לֹֽא־בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְעִ֗יר מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וָאֶבְחַ֣ר בְּדָוִ֔ד לִהְי֖וֹת עַל־עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mnhyvm 'shr hvts'ty 't'my 'tyshr'l mmtsrym l'bchrty b'yr mkhl shbty yshr'l lbnvt byt lhyvt shmy shm v'bchr bdvd lhyvt 'l'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Since the day that I brought forth My people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that My name might be there; but I chose David to be over My people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י עִם־לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'mlbb dvd 'by lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם־לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י הֱֽטִיבֹ֔תָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ldvd 'by y'n 'shr hyh 'mlbbkh lbnvt byt lshmy htybt khy hyh 'mlbbkh
verses.translation: But the LORD said unto David my father: Whereas it was in thy heart to build a house for My name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַבָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י אִם־בִּנְךָ֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣א מֵחֲלָצֶ֔יךָ הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי׃
verses.translit: rq 'th l' tbnh hbyt khy 'mbnkh hyts' mchltsykh hv'ybnh hbyt lshmy
verses.translation: nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for My name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קֶם יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־דְּבָר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָאָקֻ֡ם תַּ֩חַת֩ דָּוִ֨ד אָבִ֜י וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב  עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה וָאֶבְנֶ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqm yhvh 'tdbrv 'shr dbr v'qm tcht dvd 'by v'shb  'lkhs' yshr'l kh'shr dbr yhvh v'bnh hbyt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD hath established His word that He spoke; for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָשִׂ֨ם שָׁ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לָאָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ עִם־אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ בְּהוֹצִיא֥וֹ אֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shm shm mqvm l'rvn 'shrshm bryt yhvh 'shr khrt 'm'btynv bhvtsy'v 'tm m'rts mtsrym {s}
verses.translation: And there have I set a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which He made with our fathers, when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִפְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כׇּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'md shlmh lpny mzbch yhvh ngd khlqhl yshr'l vyprsh khpyv hshmym
verses.translation: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין־כָּמ֣וֹךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לַעֲבָדֶ֕יךָ הַהֹלְכִ֥ים לְפָנֶ֖יךָ בְּכׇל־לִבָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'ynkhmvkh 'lhym bshmym mm'l v'lh'rts mtcht shmr hbryt vhchsd l'bdykh hhlkhym lpnykh bkhllbm
verses.translation: and he said: ‘O LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like Thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keepest covenant and mercy with Thy servants, that walk before Thee with all their heart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ ל֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר בְּפִ֛יךָ וּבְיָדְךָ֥ מִלֵּ֖אתָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shr shmrt l'bdkh dvd 'by 't 'shrdbrt lv vtdbr bpykh vbydkh ml't khyvm hzh
verses.translation: who hast kept with Thy servant David my father that which Thou didst promise him; yea, Thou spokest with Thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with Thy hand, as it is this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹ֠ר לְעַבְדְּךָ֨ דָוִ֤ד אָבִי֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא־יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם־יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֤יךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת לְפָנַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh  'lhy yshr'l shmr l'bdkh dvd 'by 't 'shr dbrt lv l'mr l'ykhrt lkh 'ysh mlpny yshb 'lkhs' yshr'l rq 'myshmrv bnykh 'tdrkhm llkht lpny kh'shr hlkht lpny
verses.translation: Now therefore, O LORD, the God of Israel, keep with Thy servant David my father that which Thou hast promised him saying: There shall not fail thee a man in My sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only thy children take heed to their way, to walk before Me as thou hast walked before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵאָ֤מֶן נָא֙ (דבריך) [דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔] אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֖ דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lhy yshr'l y'mn n' (dbrykh) [dbrkh] 'shr dbrt l'bdkh dvd 'by
verses.translation: Now therefore, O God of Israel, let Thy word, I pray Thee, be verified, which Thou didst speak unto Thy servant David my father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֥ב אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּ֠ה הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּשְׁמֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: khy h'mnm yshb 'lhym 'lh'rts hnh hshmym vshmy hshmym l' ykhlkhlvkh 'f khyhbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: But will God in very truth dwell on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Thee; how much less this house that I have builded!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָנִ֜יתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּךָ֛ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּת֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל־הָֽרִנָּה֙ וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַבְדְּךָ֛ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְפָנֶ֖יךָ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vpnyt 'ltplt 'bdkh v'ltchntv yhvh 'lhy lshm' 'lhrnh v'lhtplh 'shr 'bdkh mtpll lpnykh hyvm
verses.translation: Yet have Thou respect unto the prayer of Thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which Thy servant prayeth before Thee this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִהְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨ךָ פְתֻחֹ֜ת אֶל־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָי֔וֹם אֶ֨ל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lhyvt 'ynkh ptcht 'lhbyt hzh lylh vyvm 'lhmqvm 'shr 'mrt yhyh shmy shm lshm' 'lhtplh 'shr ytpll 'bdkh 'lhmqvm hzh
verses.translation: that Thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place whereof Thou hast said: My name shall be there; to hearken unto the prayer which Thy servant shall pray toward this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל־תְּחִנַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּלְל֖וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְ֠אַתָּ֠ה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־מְק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ֙ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְסָלָֽחְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vshm't 'ltchnt 'bdkh v'mkh yshr'l 'shr ytpllv 'lhmqvm hzh v'th tshm' 'lmqvm shbtkh 'lhshmym vshm't vslcht
verses.translation: And hearken Thou to the supplication of Thy servant, and of Thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place; yea, hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place; and when Thou hearest, forgive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְנָשָׁא־ב֥וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְהַאֲלֹת֑וֹ וּבָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲךָ֖ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 't 'shr ycht' 'ysh lr'hv vnsh'bv 'lh lh'ltv vb' 'lh lpny mzbchkh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be exacted of him to cause him to swear, and he come and swear before Thine altar in this house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה  תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְהַרְשִׁ֣יעַ רָשָׁ֔ע לָתֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖וֹ בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּלְהַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ כְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th  tshm' hshmym v'shyt vshptt 't'bdykh lhrshy' rsh' ltt drkhv br'shv vlhtsdyq tsdyq ltt lv khtsdqtv
verses.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and do, and judge Thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽהִנָּגֵ֞ף עַמְּךָ֧ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיֵ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֤בוּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהִתְפַּלְל֧וּ וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֛וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bhngf 'mkh yshr'l lpny 'vyb 'shr ycht'vlkh vshbv 'lykh vhvdv 'tshmkh vhtpllv vhtchnnv 'lykh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: When Thy people Israel are smitten down before the enemy, when they do sin against Thee, if they turn again to Thee, and confess Thy name, and pray and make supplication unto Thee in this house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְסָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ לְחַטַּ֖את עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַהֲשֵֽׁבֹתָם֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּ לַאֲבוֹתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym vslcht lcht't 'mkh yshr'l vhshbtm 'lh'dmh 'shr ntt l'bvtm {s}
verses.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of Thy people Israel, and bring them back unto the land which Thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהֵעָצֵ֥ר שָׁמַ֛יִם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֑ךְ וְהִֽתְפַּלְל֞וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָ֥ם יְשׁוּב֖וּן כִּ֥י תַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.translit: bh'tsr shmym vl'yhyh mtr khy ycht'vlkh vhtpllv 'lhmqvm hzh vhvdv 'tshmkh vmcht'tm yshvbvn khy t'nm
verses.translation: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, when they do sin against Thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess Thy name, and turn from their sin, when Thou dost afflict them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה  תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְסָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְחַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תוֹרֵ֛ם אֶת־הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה מָטָר֙ עַֽל־אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּה לְעַמְּךָ֖ לְנַחֲלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th  tshm' hshmym vslcht lcht't 'bdykh v'mkh yshr'l khy tvrm 'thdrkh htvbh 'shr ylkhvbh vntth mtr 'l'rtskh 'shrntth l'mkh lnchlh {s}
verses.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of Thy servants, and of Thy people Israel, when Thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon Thy land, which Thou hast given to Thy people for an inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָעָ֞ב כִּֽי־יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֗רֶץ דֶּ֣בֶר כִּֽי־יִֽ֠הְיֶ֠ה שִׁדָּפ֨וֹן יֵרָק֜וֹן אַרְבֶּ֤ה חָסִיל֙ כִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה כִּ֧י יָֽצַר־ל֛וֹ אֹיְב֖וֹ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שְׁעָרָ֑יו כׇּל־נֶ֖גַע כׇּֽל־מַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: r'b khyyhyh b'rts dbr khyyhyh shdpvn yrqvn 'rbh chsyl khy yhyh khy ytsrlv 'ybv b'rts sh'ryv khlng' khlmchlh
verses.translation: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־תְּפִלָּ֣ה כׇל־תְּחִנָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְכׇל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לְכֹ֖ל עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵדְע֗וּן אִ֚ישׁ נֶ֣גַע לְבָב֔וֹ וּפָרַ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו אֶל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khltplh khltchnh 'shr thyh lkhlh'dm lkhl 'mkh yshr'l 'shr yd'vn 'ysh ng' lbbv vprsh khpyv 'lhbyt hzh
verses.translation: what prayer and supplication soever be made by any man of all Thy people Israel, who shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּ֠ה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְסָלַחְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ וְנָתַתָּ֤ לָאִישׁ֙ כְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּדַ֖ע אֶת־לְבָב֑וֹ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ אֶת־לְבַ֖ב כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym mkhvn shbtkh vslcht v'shyt vntt l'ysh khkhldrkhyv 'shr td' 'tlbbv khy'th yd't lbdkh 'tlbb khlbny h'dm
verses.translation: then hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and forgive, and do, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart Thou knowest—for Thou, even Thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִרָא֔וּךָ כׇּ֨ל־הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: lm'n yr'vkh khlhymym 'shrhm chyym 'lpny h'dmh 'shr ntth l'btynv
verses.translation: that they may fear Thee all the days that they live in the land which Thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם֙ אֶל־הַנׇּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ֥ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ה֑וּא וּבָ֛א מֵאֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vgm 'lhnkhry 'shr l'm'mkh yshr'l hv' vb' m'rts rchvqh lm'n shmkh
verses.translation: Moreover concerning the stranger that is not of Thy people Israel, when he shall come out of a far country for Thy name’s sake—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ֣ הַגָּד֔וֹל וְאֶת־יָֽדְךָ֙ הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּבָ֥א וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy yshm'vn 'tshmkh hgdvl v'tydkh hchzqh vzr'kh hntvyh vb' vhtpll 'lhbyt hzh
verses.translation: for they shall hear of Thy great name, and of Thy mighty hand, and of Thine outstretched arm—when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֞ה תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֔ךָ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַנׇּכְרִ֑י לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְעוּן֩ כׇּל־עַמֵּ֨י הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ לְיִרְאָ֤ה אֹֽתְךָ֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלָדַ֕עַת כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: 'th tshm' hshmym mkhvn shbtkh v'shyt khkhl 'shryqr' 'lykh hnkhry lm'n yd'vn khl'my h'rts 'tshmkh lyr'h 'tkh kh'mkh yshr'l vld't khyshmkh nqr' 'lhbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to Thee for; that all the peoples of the earth may know Thy name, to fear Thee, as doth Thy people Israel, and that they may know that Thy name is called upon this house which I have built.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יֵצֵ֨א עַמְּךָ֤ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־אֹ֣יְב֔וֹ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֑ם וְהִתְפַּלְל֣וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֗ה דֶּ֤רֶךְ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתָּ בָּ֔הּ וְהַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִ֥תִי לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khyyts' 'mkh lmlchmh 'l'ybv bdrkh 'shr tshlchm vhtpllv 'lyhvh drkh h'yr 'shr bchrt bh vhbyt 'shrbnty lshmkh
verses.translation: If Thy people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatsoever way Thou shalt send them, and they pray unto the LORD toward the city which Thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for Thy name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָֽׁמַעְתָּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָ֖ם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshm't hshmym 'ttpltm v'ttchntm v'shyt mshptm
verses.translation: then hear Thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֗ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יֶחֱטָ֔א וְאָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔ם וּנְתַתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְשָׁב֤וּם שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הָאוֹיֵ֔ב רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy ycht'vlkh khy 'yn 'dm 'shr l'ycht' v'npt bm vnttm lpny 'vyb vshbvm shbyhm 'l'rts h'vyb rchvqh 'v qrvbh
verses.translation: If they sin against Thee—for there is no man that sinneth not—and Thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive unto the land of the enemy, far off or near;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶל־לִבָּ֔ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁ֑ם וְשָׁ֣בוּ  וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ וְהֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vhshybv 'llbm b'rts 'shr nshbvshm vshbv  vhtchnnv 'lykh b'rts shbyhm l'mr cht'nv vh'vynv rsh'nv
verses.translation: yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn back, and make supplication unto Thee in the land of them that carried them captive, saying: We have sinned, and have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבָם֙ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהִתְפַּלְל֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבוֹתָ֔ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְהַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־[בָּנִ֥יתִי] (בנית) לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vshbv 'lykh bkhllbbm vbkhlnpshm b'rts 'ybyhm 'shrshbv 'tm vhtpllv 'lykh drkh 'rtsm 'shr ntth l'bvtm h'yr 'shr bchrt vhbyt 'shr[bnyty] (bnyt) lshmkh
verses.translation: if they return unto Thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them captive, and pray unto Thee toward their land, which Thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which Thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for Thy name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָ֖ם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshm't hshmym mkhvn shbtkh 'ttpltm v'ttchntm v'shyt mshptm
verses.translation: then hear Thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and maintain their cause;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָלַחְתָּ֤ לְעַמְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְאוּ־לָ֔ךְ וּלְכׇל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָ֑ךְ וּנְתַתָּ֧ם לְרַחֲמִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י שֹׁבֵיהֶ֖ם וְרִחֲמֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vslcht l'mkh 'shr cht'vlkh vlkhlpsh'yhm 'shr psh'vbkh vnttm lrchmym lpny shbyhm vrchmvm
verses.translation: and forgive Thy people who have sinned against Thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against Thee; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַמְּךָ֥ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ֖ הֵ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם מִתּ֖וֹךְ כּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translit: khy'mkh vnchltkh hm 'shr hvts't mmtsrym mtvkh khvr hbrzl
verses.translation: for they are Thy people, and Thine inheritance, which Thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִהְי֨וֹת עֵינֶ֤יךָ פְתֻחֹת֙ אֶל־תְּחִנַּ֣ת עַבְדְּךָ֔ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּ֖ת עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל קׇרְאָ֥ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: lhyvt 'ynykh ptcht 'ltchnt 'bdkh v'ltchnt 'mkh yshr'l lshm' 'lyhm bkhl qr'm 'lykh
verses.translation: that Thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of Thy servant, and unto the supplication of Thy people Israel, to hearken unto them whensoever they cry unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה הִבְדַּלְתָּ֤ם לְךָ֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֜רְתָּ בְּיַ֣ד  מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ֧ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֛ינוּ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy'th hbdltm lkh lnchlh mkhl 'my h'rts kh'shr dbrt byd  mshh 'bdkh bhvtsy'kh 't'btynv mmtsrym 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: For Thou didst set them apart from among all the peoples of the earth, to be Thine inheritance, as Thou didst speak by the hand of Moses Thy servant, when Thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כְּכַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת כׇּל־הַתְּפִלָּ֥ה וְהַתְּחִנָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את קָ֞ם מִלִּפְנֵ֨י מִזְבַּ֤ח יְהֹוָה֙ מִכְּרֹ֣עַ עַל־בִּרְכָּ֔יו וְכַפָּ֖יו פְּרֻשׂ֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khkhlvt shlmh lhtpll 'lyhvh 't khlhtplh vhtchnh hz't qm mlpny mzbch yhvh mkhr' 'lbrkhyv vkhpyv prshvt hshmym
verses.translation: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread forth toward heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֕ד וַיְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'md vybrkh 't khlqhl yshr'l qvl gdvl l'mr
verses.translation: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן מְנוּחָה֙ לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר לֹֽא־נָפַ֞ל דָּבָ֣ר אֶחָ֗ד מִכֹּל֙ דְּבָר֣וֹ הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'shr ntn mnvchh l'mv yshr'l khkhl 'shr dbr l'npl dbr 'chd mkhl dbrv htvb 'shr dbr byd mshh 'bdv
verses.translation: ’Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto His people Israel, according to all that He promised; there hath not failed one word of all His good promise, which He promised by the hand of Moses His servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ עִמָּ֔נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵ֖נוּ וְאַֽל־יִטְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: yhy yhvh 'lhynv 'mnv kh'shr hyh 'm'btynv 'ly'zbnv v'lytshnv
verses.translation: The LORD our God be with us, as He was with our fathers; let Him not leave us, nor forsake us;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַטּ֥וֹת לְבָבֵ֖נוּ אֵלָ֑יו לָלֶ֣כֶת בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֗יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֤יו וְחֻקָּיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: lhtvt lbbnv 'lyv llkht bkhldrkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vchqyv vmshptyv 'shr tsvh 't'btynv
verses.translation: that He may incline our hearts unto Him, to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments, and His statutes, and His ordinances, which He commanded our fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֨וּ דְבָרַ֜י אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִתְחַנַּ֙נְתִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה קְרֹבִ֛ים אֶל־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת  מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַבְדּ֗וֹ וּמִשְׁפַּ֛ט עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhyv dbry 'lh 'shr htchnnty lpny yhvh qrbym 'lyhvh 'lhynv yvmm vlylh l'shvt  mshpt 'bdv vmshpt 'mv yshr'l dbryvm byvmv
verses.translation: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that He maintain the cause of His servant, and the cause of His people Israel, as every day shall require;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן דַּ֚עַת כׇּל־עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: lm'n d't khl'my h'rts khy yhvh hv' h'lhym 'yn 'vd
verses.translation: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD, He is God; there is none else.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְבַבְכֶם֙ שָׁלֵ֔ם עִ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֧כֶת בְּחֻקָּ֛יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖יו כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh lbbkhm shlm 'm yhvh 'lhynv llkht bchqyv vlshmr mtsvtyv khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Let your heart therefore be whole with the LORD our God, to walk in His statutes, and to keep His commandments, as at this day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּ֑וֹ זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhmlkh vkhlyshr'l 'mv zbchym zbch lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֵ֣ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָבַ֣ח לַיהֹוָה֒ בָּקָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְצֹ֕אן מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וַֽיַּחְנְכוּ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְכׇל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyzbch shlmh 't zbch hshlmym 'shr zbch lyhvh bqr 'shrym vshnym 'lf vts'n m'h v'shrym 'lf vychnkhv 'tbyt yhvh hmlkh vkhlbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא קִדַּ֨שׁ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־תּ֣וֹךְ הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י בֵית־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּי־עָ֣שָׂה שָׁ֗ם אֶת־הָֽעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים כִּֽי־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה קָטֹ֗ן מֵֽהָכִיל֙ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֣ה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' qdsh hmlkh 'ttvkh hchtsr 'shr lpny bytyhvh khy'shh shm 'th'lh v'thmnchh v't chlby hshlmym khymzbch hnchsht 'shr lpny yhvh qtn mhkhyl 'th'lh v'thmnchh v't chlby hshlmym
verses.translation: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD; for there he offered the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings; because the brazen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בָעֵת־הַהִ֣יא ׀ אֶת־הֶחָ֡ג וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּוֹ֩ קָהָ֨ל גָּד֜וֹל מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֣ת  עַד־נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֗יִם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh b'thhy'  'thchg vkhlyshr'l 'mv qhl gdvl mlbv' chmt  'dnchl mtsrym lpny yhvh 'lhynv shb't ymym vshb't ymym 'rb'h 'shr yvm
verses.translation: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entrance Hamath unto the Brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְבָרְכ֖וּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּלְכ֣וּ לְאׇהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַ֣ל כׇּל־הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לְדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֔וֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: byvm hshmyny shlch 'th'm vybrkhv 'thmlkh vylkhv l'hlyhm shmchym vtvby lb 'l khlhtvbh 'shr 'shh yhvh ldvd 'bdv vlyshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: On the eighth day he sent the people away, and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had shown unto David His servant, and to Israel His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֥וֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפֵ֖ץ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt shlmh lbnvt 'tbytyhvh v'tbyt hmlkh v't khlchshq shlmh 'shr chpts l'shvt {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s delight which he was pleased to do,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה שֵׁנִ֑ית כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh 'lshlmh shnyt kh'shr nr'h 'lyv bgb'vn
verses.translation: that the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as He had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו שָׁ֠מַ֠עְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ֣ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְחַנַּ֣נְתָּה לְפָנַי֒ הִקְדַּ֗שְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֔תָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִ֥י שָׁ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧י וְלִבִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv shm'ty 'ttpltkh v'ttchntkh 'shr htchnnth lpny hqdshty 'thbyt hzh 'shr bnth lshvmshmy shm 'd'vlm vhyv 'yny vlby shm khlhymym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him: ‘I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before Me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put My name there for ever; and Mine eyes and My heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אִם־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנַ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלַ֜ךְ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֙יךָ֙ בְּתׇם־לֵבָ֣ב וּבְיֹ֔שֶׁר לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑יךָ חֻקַּ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mtlkh lpny kh'shr hlkh dvd 'bykh btmlbb vbyshr l'shvt khkhl 'shr tsvytykh chqy vmshpty tshmr
verses.translation: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before Me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep My statutes and Mine ordinances;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִ֨מֹתִ֜י אֶת־כִּסֵּ֧א מַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ֛ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעֹלָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי עַל־דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵעַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'tkhs' mmlkhtkh 'lyshr'l l'lm kh'shr dbrty 'ldvd 'bykh l'mr l'ykhrt lkh 'ysh m'l khs' yshr'l
verses.translation: then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom over Israel for ever; according as I promised to David thy father, saying: There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שׁ֨וֹב תְּשֻׁב֜וּן אַתֶּ֤ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְלֹ֤א תִשְׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקֹּתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַֽעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mshvb tshbvn 'tm vbnykhm m'chry vl' tshmrv mtsvty chqty 'shr ntty lpnykhm vhlkhtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm
verses.translation: But if ye shall turn away from following Me, ye or your children, and not keep My commandments and My statutes which I have set before you, but shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵעַ֨ל פְּנֵ֤י הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִ֔י אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמָשָׁ֥ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּכׇל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhkhrty 'tyshr'l m'l pny h'dmh 'shr ntty lhm v'thbyt 'shr hqdshty lshmy 'shlch m'l pny vhyh yshr'l lmshl vlshnynh bkhlh'mym
verses.translation: then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for My name, will I cast out of My sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a by word among all peoples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן כׇּל־עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו יִשֹּׁ֣ם וְשָׁרָ֑ק וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל־מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְלַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhbyt hzh yhyh 'lyvn khl'br 'lyv yshm vshrq v'mrv 'lmh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'rts hz't vlbyt hzh
verses.translation: and this house which is so high [shall become desolate], and every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and when they shall say: Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָזְב֜וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֒יִם֒ וַֽיַּחֲזִ֙קוּ֙ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ] לָהֶ֖ם וַיַּעַבְדֻ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֗ן הֵבִ֤יא יְהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 'tyhvh 'lhyhm 'shr hvtsy' 't'btm m'rts mtsrym vychzqv b'lhym 'chrym (vyshtchv) [vyshtchvv] lhm vy'bdm 'lkhn hby' yhvh 'lyhm 't khlhr'h hz't {p}
verses.translation: they shall be answered: Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them; therefore hath the LORD brought all this evil upon them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקְצֵה֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י הַבָּתִּ֑ים אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh 'shrym shnh 'shrbnh shlmh 'tshny hbtym 'tbyt yhvh v'tbyt hmlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD and the king’s house—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִירָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־צֹ֠ר נִשָּׂ֨א אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בַּעֲצֵי֩ אֲרָזִ֨ים וּבַעֲצֵ֧י בְרוֹשִׁ֛ים וּבַזָּהָ֖ב לְכׇל־חֶפְצ֑וֹ אָ֡ז יִתֵּן֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה לְחִירָם֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֔יר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגָּלִֽיל׃
verses.translit: chyrm mlkhtsr nsh' 'tshlmh b'tsy 'rzym vb'tsy brvshym vbzhb lkhlchptsv 'z ytn hmlkh shlmh lchyrm 'shrym 'yr b'rts hglyl
verses.translation: now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar-trees and cypress-trees, and with gold, according to all his desire—that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א חִירָם֙ מִצֹּ֔ר לִרְאוֹת֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַן־ל֖וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יָשְׁר֖וּ בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyts' chyrm mtsr lr'vt 'th'rym 'shr ntnlv shlmh vl' yshrv b'ynyv
verses.translation: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him: and they pleased him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖י אָחִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כָּב֔וּל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr mh h'rym h'lh 'shrntth ly 'chy vyqr' lhm 'rts khbvl 'd hyvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: And he said: ‘What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother?’ And they were called the land of Cabul, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִירָ֖ם לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm lmlkh m'h v'shrym khkhr zhb
verses.translation: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֨ה דְבַר־הַמַּ֜ס אֲשֶֽׁר־הֶעֱלָ֣ה  הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנוֹת֩ אֶת־בֵּ֨ית יְהֹוָ֤ה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּ֔וֹא וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְאֶת־חָצֹ֥ר וְאֶת־מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־גָּֽזֶר׃
verses.translit: vzh dbrhms 'shrh'lh  hmlkh shlmh lbnvt 'tbyt yhvh v'tbytv v'thmlv' v't chvmt yrvshl͏m v'tchtsr v'tmgdv v'tgzr
verses.translation: And this is the account of the levy which king Solomon raised; to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֨ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֜יִם עָלָ֗ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־גֶּ֙זֶר֙ וַיִּשְׂרְפָ֣הּ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְאֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּעִ֖יר הָרָ֑ג וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֙ שִׁלֻּחִ֔ים לְבִתּ֖וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: pr'h mlkhmtsrym 'lh vylkhd 'tgzr vyshrph b'sh v'thkhn'ny hyshb b'yr hrg vytnh shlchym lbtv 'sht shlmh
verses.translation: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a portion unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־גָּ֔זֶר וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חֹרֹ֖ן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vybn shlmh 'tgzr v'tbyt chrn tchtvn
verses.translation: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶֽת־בַּעֲלָ֛ת וְאֶת־[תַּדְמֹ֥ר] (תמר) בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'tb'lt v't[tdmr] (tmr) bmdbr b'rts
verses.translation: and Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת  חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v't khl'ry hmskhnvt 'shr hyv lshlmh v't 'ry hrkhb v't 'ry hprshym v't  chshq shlmh 'shr chshq lbnvt byrvshl͏m vblbnvn vbkhl 'rts mmshltv
verses.translation: and all the store-cities that Solomon had, and the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הָ֠עָ֠ם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַחִתִּ֤י הַפְּרִזִּי֙ הַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: khlh'm hnvtr mnh'mry hchty hprzy hchvy vhybvsy 'shr l'mbny yshr'l hmh
verses.translation: All the people that were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
