verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהוֹשָׁפָט֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhvshpt 'm'btyv vyqbr 'm'btyv b'yr dvd 'byv vymlkh yhvrm bnv tchtyv {s}
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father; and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'chzyhv bn'ch'b mlkh 'lyshr'l bshmrvn bshnt shb' 'shrh lyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh vymlkh 'lyshr'l shntym
verses.translation: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אָבִיו֙ וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ אִמּ֔וֹ וּבְדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ יָרׇבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkh 'byv vbdrkh 'mv vbdrkh yrb'm bnnbt 'shr hchty' 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherein he made Israel to sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔עַל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה ל֑וֹ וַיַּכְעֵ֗ס אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'bd 'thb'l vyshtchvh lv vykh's 'tyhvh 'lhy yshr'l khkhl 'shr'shh 'byv
verses.translation: And he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְשַׁ֤ע מוֹאָב֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֥וֹת אַחְאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vypsh' mv'b byshr'l 'chry mvt 'ch'b
verses.translation: AND Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֨ל אֲחַזְיָ֜ה בְּעַ֣ד הַשְּׂבָכָ֗ה בַּעֲלִיָּת֛וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וַיָּ֑חַל וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֗ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ לְכ֣וּ דִרְשׁ֗וּ בְּבַ֤עַל זְבוּב֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְר֔וֹן אִם־אֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵחֳלִ֥י זֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vypl 'chzyh b'd hshbkhh b'lytv 'shr bshmrvn vychl vyshlch ml'khym vy'mr 'lhm lkhv drshv bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn 'm'chyh mchly zh {s}
verses.translation: And Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick; and he sent messengers, and said unto them: ‘Go, inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this sickness.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֗ה דִּבֶּר֙ אֶל־אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַתִּשְׁבִּ֔י ק֣וּם עֲלֵ֔ה לִקְרַ֖את מַלְאֲכֵ֣י מֶֽלֶךְ־שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הֲֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּם֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים לִדְרֹ֕שׁ בְּבַ֥עַל זְב֖וּב אֱלֹהֵ֥י עֶקְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vml'kh yhvh dbr 'l'lyh htshby qvm 'lh lqr't ml'khy mlkhshmrvn vdbr 'lhm hmbly 'yn'lhym byshr'l 'tm hlkhym ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn
verses.translation: But an angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite: ‘Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them: Is it because there is no God in Israel, that ye go to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָכֵן֙ כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הַמִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹא־תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אֵלִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vlkhn khh'mr yhvh hmth 'shr'lyt shm l'trd mmnh khy mvt tmvt vylkh 'lyh
verses.translation: Now therefore thus saith the LORD: Thou shalt not come down from the bed whither thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.’ And Elijah departed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשׁ֥וּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֵלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מַה־זֶּ֥ה שַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshvbv hml'khym 'lyv vy'mr 'lyhm mhzh shbtm
verses.translation: And the messengers returned unto him, and he said unto them: ‘Why is it that ye are returned?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו אִ֣ישׁ  עָלָ֣ה לִקְרָאתֵ֗נוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֵ֘ינוּ֮ לְכ֣וּ שׁ֘וּבוּ֮ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֣ח אֶתְכֶם֒ וְדִבַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתָּ֣ה שֹׁלֵ֔חַ לִדְרֹ֕שׁ בְּבַ֥עַל זְב֖וּב אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְר֑וֹן לָ֠כֵ֠ן הַמִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹא־תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה כִּי־מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'ysh  'lh lqr'tnv vy'mr 'lynv lkhv shvbv 'lhmlkh 'shrshlch 'tkhm vdbrtm 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh hmbly 'yn'lhym byshr'l 'th shlch ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn lkhn hmth 'shr'lyt shm l'trd mmnh khymvt tmvt
verses.translation: And they said unto him: ‘There came up a man to meet us, and said unto us: Go, return unto the king that sent you, and say unto him: Thus saith the LORD: Is it because there is no God in Israel, that thou sendest to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from the bed whither thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מֶ֚ה מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֖ה לִקְרַאתְכֶ֑ם וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhm mh mshpt h'ysh 'shr 'lh lqr'tkhm vydbr 'lykhm 'thdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘What manner of man was he that came up to meet you, and told you these words?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אִ֚ישׁ בַּ֣עַל שֵׂעָ֔ר וְאֵז֥וֹר ע֖וֹר אָז֣וּר בְּמׇתְנָ֑יו וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֵלִיָּ֥ה הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'ysh b'l sh'r v'zvr 'vr 'zvr bmtnyv vy'mr 'lyh htshby hv'
verses.translation: And they answered him: ‘He was a hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins.’ And he said: ‘It is Elijah the Tishbite.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛יו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑יו וַיַּ֣עַל אֵלָ֗יו וְהִנֵּה֙ יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֔ר וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו אִ֚ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דִּבֶּ֖ר רֵֽדָה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv shrchmshym vchmshyv vy'l 'lyv vhnh yshb 'lr'sh hhr vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym hmlkh dbr rdh
verses.translation: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him; and, behold, he sat on the top of the hill. And he spoke unto him: ‘O man of God, the king hath said: Come down.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנֶ֣ה אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיְדַבֵּר֮ אֶל־שַׂ֣ר הַחֲמִשִּׁים֒ וְאִם־אִ֤ישׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֔נִי תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֹתְךָ֖ וְאֶת־חֲמִשֶּׁ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתֹּ֥אכַל אֹת֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֲמִשָּֽׁיו׃
verses.translit: vy'nh 'lyhv vydbr 'lshr hchmshym v'm'ysh 'lhym 'ny trd 'sh mnhshmym vt'khl 'tkh v'tchmshykh vtrd 'sh mnhshmym vt'khl 'tv v'tchmshyv
verses.translation: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty: ‘If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty.’ And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜שׇׁב וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛יו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַחֵ֖ר וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑יו וַיַּ֙עַן֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו אִ֚ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים כֹּה־אָמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מְהֵרָ֥ה רֵֽדָה׃
verses.translit: vyshb vyshlch 'lyv shrchmshym 'chr vchmshyv vy'n vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym khh'mr hmlkh mhrh rdh
verses.translation: And again he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him: ‘O man of God, thus hath the king said: Come down quickly.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן אֵלִיָּה֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶם֒ אִם־אִ֤ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֔נִי תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֹתְךָ֖ וְאֶת־חֲמִשֶּׁ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתֹּ֥אכַל אֹת֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֲמִשָּֽׁיו׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyh vydbr 'lyhm 'm'ysh h'lhym 'ny trd 'sh mnhshmym vt'khl 'tkh v'tchmshykh vtrd 'sh'lhym mnhshmym vt'khl 'tv v'tchmshyv
verses.translation: And Elijah answered and said unto them: ‘If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty.’ And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֗שׇׁב וַיִּשְׁלַ֛ח שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שְׁלִשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑יו וַיַּ֡עַל וַיָּבֹא֩ שַׂר־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֨ים הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י וַיִּכְרַ֥ע עַל־בִּרְכָּ֣יו  לְנֶ֣גֶד אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיִּתְחַנֵּ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו אִ֚ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים תִּיקַר־נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֗י וְנֶ֨פֶשׁ עֲבָדֶ֥יךָֽ אֵ֛לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshb vyshlch shrchmshym shlshym vchmshyv vy'l vyb' shrhchmshym hshlyshy vykhr' 'lbrkhyv  lngd 'lyhv vytchnn 'lyv vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym tyqrn' npshy vnpsh 'bdykh 'lh chmshym b'ynykh
verses.translation: And again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him: ‘O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּ֠ה יָ֤רְדָה אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ֠תֹּ֠אכַל אֶת־שְׁנֵ֞י שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְאֶת־חֲמִשֵּׁיהֶ֑ם וְעַתָּ֕ה תִּיקַ֥ר נַפְשִׁ֖י בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnh yrdh 'sh mnhshmym vt'khl 'tshny shry hchmshym hr'shnym v'tchmshyhm v'th tyqr npshy b'ynykh {s}
verses.translation: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and consumed the two former captains of fifty with their fifties; but now let my life be precious in thy sight’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רֵ֣ד אוֹת֔וֹ אַל־תִּירָ֖א מִפָּנָ֑יו וַיָּ֛קׇם וַיֵּ֥רֶד אוֹת֖וֹ אֶל־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vydbr ml'kh yhvh 'l'lyhv rd 'vtv 'ltyr' mpnyv vyqm vyrd 'vtv 'lhmlkh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah: ‘Go down with him; be not afraid of him.’ And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה יַ֜עַן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ מַלְאָכִים֮ לִדְרֹשׁ֮ בְּבַ֣עַל זְבוּב֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְרוֹן֒ הֲֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִדְרֹ֖שׁ בִּדְבָר֑וֹ לָ֠כֵ֠ן הַמִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹא־תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה כִּי־מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'lyv khh'mr yhvh y'n 'shrshlcht ml'khym ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn hmbly 'yn'lhym byshr'l ldrsh bdbrv lkhn hmth 'shr'lyt shm l'trd mmnh khymvt tmvt
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of His word? therefore thou shalt not come down from the bed whether thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜מׇת כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוֹרָם֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו {פ} בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לִיהוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה כִּ֛י לֹא־הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vymt khdbr yhvh  'shrdbr 'lyhv vymlkh yhvrm tchtyv {p} bshnt shtym lyhvrm bnyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh khy l'hyh lv bn {s}
verses.translation: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram began to reign in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'chzyhv 'shr 'shh hlv'hmh khtvbym 'lspr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהַעֲל֤וֹת יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֵלִיָּ֛הוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁ֖ע מִן־הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy bh'lvt yhvh 't'lyhv bs'rh hshmym vylkh 'lyhv v'lysh' mnhglgl
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah by a whirlwind into heaven, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֜ע שֵֽׁב־נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי עַד־בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע חַי־יְהֹוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּרְד֖וּ בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv 'l'lysh' shbn' ph khy yhvh shlchny 'dbyt'l vy'mr 'lysh' chyyhvh vchynpshkh 'm''zbkh vyrdv byt'l
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto Elisha: ‘Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me as far as Beth-el.’ And Elisha said: ‘As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.’ So they went down to Beth-el.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֨וּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בֵּֽית־אֵל֮ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהֹוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃
verses.translit: vyts'v bnyhnby'ym 'shrbyt'l 'l'lysh' vy'mrv 'lyv hyd't khy hyvm yhvh lqch 't'dnykh m'l r'shkh vy'mr gm'ny yd'ty hchshv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him: ‘Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to-day?’ And he said: ‘Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע  שֵֽׁב־נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי יְרִיח֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lyhv 'lysh'  shbn' ph khy yhvh shlchny yrychv vy'mr chyyhvh vchynpshkh 'm''zbkh vyb'v yrychv
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto him: ‘Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho.’ And he said: ‘As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.’ So they came to Jericho.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בִּֽירִיחוֹ֮ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהֹוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃
verses.translit: vygshv bnyhnby'ym 'shrbyrychv 'l'lysh' vy'mrv 'lyv hyd't khy hyvm yhvh lqch 't'dnykh m'l r'shkh vy'mr gm'ny yd'ty hchshv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said unto him: ‘Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to-day?’ And he answered: ‘Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ שֵֽׁב־נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lyhv shbn' ph khy yhvh shlchny hyrdnh vy'mr chyyhvh vchynpshkh 'm''zbkh vylkhv shnyhm
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto him: ‘Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to the Jordan.’ And he said: ‘As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.’ And they two went on.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֤י הַנְּבִיאִים֙ הָֽלְכ֔וּ וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ מִנֶּ֖גֶד מֵרָח֑וֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם עָמְד֥וּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vchmshym 'ysh mbny hnby'ym hlkhv vy'mdv mngd mrchvq vshnyhm 'mdv 'lhyrdn
verses.translation: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood over against them afar off; and they two stood by the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶת־אַדַּרְתּ֤וֹ וַיִּגְלֹם֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֵּחָצ֖וּ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֑נָּה וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בֶּחָרָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'lyhv 't'drtv vyglm vykhh 'thmym vychtsv hnh vhnh vy'brv shnyhm bchrbh
verses.translation: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְעׇבְרָ֗ם וְאֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ אָמַ֤ר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע֙ שְׁאַל֙ מָ֣ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֶלָּקַ֣ח מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וִ֥יהִי נָ֛א פִּֽי־שְׁנַ֥יִם בְּרוּחֲךָ֖ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'brm v'lyhv 'mr 'l'lysh' sh'l mh ''shhlkh btrm 'lqch m'mkh vy'mr 'lysh' vyhy n' pyshnym brvchkh 'ly
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha: ‘Ask what I shall do for thee, before I am taken from thee.’ And Elisha said: ‘I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִקְשִׁ֣יתָ לִשְׁא֑וֹל אִם־תִּרְאֶ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לֻקָּ֤ח מֵֽאִתָּךְ֙ יְהִי־לְךָ֣ כֵ֔ן וְאִם־אַ֖יִן לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hqshyt lsh'vl 'mtr'h 'ty lqch m'tkh yhylkh khn v'm'yn l' yhyh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Thou hast asked a hard thing; nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הֵ֣מָּה הֹלְכִ֤ים הָלוֹךְ֙ וְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֤ה רֶֽכֶב־אֵשׁ֙ וְס֣וּסֵי אֵ֔שׁ וַיַּפְרִ֖דוּ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּ֙עַל֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy hmh hlkhym hlvkh vdbr vhnh rkhb'sh vsvsy 'sh vyprdv byn shnyhm vy'l 'lyhv bs'rh hshmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, which parted them both assunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֣ע רֹאֶ֗ה וְה֤וּא מְצַעֵק֙ אָבִ֣י  אָבִ֗י רֶ֤כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפָ֣רָשָׁ֔יו וְלֹ֥א רָאָ֖הוּ ע֑וֹד וַֽיַּחֲזֵק֙ בִּבְגָדָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָעֵ֖ם לִשְׁנַ֥יִם קְרָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lysh' r'h vhv' mts'q 'by  'by rkhb yshr'l vprshyv vl' r'hv 'vd vychzq bbgdyv vyqr'm lshnym qr'ym
verses.translation: And Elisha saw it, and he cried: ‘My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and the horsemen thereof! ’ And he saw him no more; and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙רֶם֙ אֶת־אַדֶּ֣רֶת אֵלִיָּ֔הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָפְלָ֖ה מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֥שׇׁב וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyrm 't'drt 'lyhv 'shr nplh m'lyv vyshb vy'md 'lshpt hyrdn
verses.translation: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־אַדֶּ֨רֶת אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֲשֶׁר־נָפְלָ֤ה מֵֽעָלָיו֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אַיֵּ֕ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ אַף־ה֣וּא  וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַמַּ֗יִם וַיֵּֽחָצוּ֙ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֔נָּה וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: vyqch 't'drt 'lyhv 'shrnplh m'lyv vykhh 'thmym vy'mr 'yh yhvh 'lhy 'lyhv 'fhv'  vykhh 'thmym vychtsv hnh vhnh vy'br 'lysh'
verses.translation: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said: ‘Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?’ and when he also had smitten the waters, they were divided hither and thither; and Elisha went over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֻ֨הוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־בִּֽירִיחוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָ֛חָה ר֥וּחַ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ עַל־אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyr'hv bnyhnby'ym 'shrbyrychv mngd vy'mrv nchh rvch 'lyhv 'l'lysh' vyb'v lqr'tv vyshtchvvlv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And when the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho some way off saw him, they said: ‘The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha.’ And they came to meet him, and bowed down to the ground before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֡יו הִנֵּה־נָ֣א יֵֽשׁ־אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֩יךָ֩ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּנֵי־חַ֗יִל יֵ֣לְכוּ נָא֮ וִיבַקְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶ֒יךָ֒ פֶּן־נְשָׂאוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד הֶהָרִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּאַחַ֣ת (הגיאות) [הַגֵּיאָי֑וֹת] וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֥א תִשְׁלָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv hnhn' ysh't'bdykh chmshym 'nshym bnychyl ylkhv n' vybqshv 't'dnykh pnnsh'v rvch yhvh vyshlkhhv b'chd hhrym 'v b'cht (hgy'vt) [hgy'yvt] vy'mr l' tshlchv
verses.translation: And they said unto him: ‘Behold now, there are with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master; lest peradventure the spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley.’ And he said: ‘Ye shall not send.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־ב֥וֹ עַד־בֹּ֖שׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלָ֑חוּ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־יָמִ֖ים וְלֹ֥א מְצָאֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyptsrvbv 'dbsh vy'mr shlchv vyshlchv chmshym 'ysh vybqshv shlshhymym vl' mts'hv
verses.translation: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said: ‘Send.’ They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֵלָ֔יו וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּירִיח֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הֲלֹֽא־אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם אַל־תֵּלֵֽכוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshbv 'lyv vhv' yshb byrychv vy'mr 'lhm hl''mrty 'lykhm 'ltlkhv {s}
verses.translation: And they came back to him, while he tarried at Jericho; and he said unto them: ‘Did I not say unto you: Go not?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָעִיר֙ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה־נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָעִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י רֹאֶ֑ה וְהַמַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְהָאָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy h'yr 'l'lysh' hnhn' mvshb h'yr tvb kh'shr 'dny r'h vhmym r'ym vh'rts mshkhlt
verses.translation: And the men of the city said unto Elisha: ‘Behold, we pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth; but the water is bad, and the land miscarrieth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קְחוּ־לִי֙ צְלֹחִ֣ית חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וְשִׂ֥ימוּ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיִּקְח֖וּ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qchvly tslchyt chdshh vshymv shm mlch vyqchv 'lyv
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein.’ And they brought it to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אֶל־מוֹצָ֣א הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה רִפִּ֙אתִי֙ לַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מִשָּׁ֛ם ע֖וֹד מָ֥וֶת וּמְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lmvts' hmym vyshlkhshm mlch vy'mr khh'mr yhvh rp'ty lmym h'lh l'yhyh mshm 'vd mvt vmshkhlt
verses.translation: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast salt therein, and said: ‘Thus saith the LORD: I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or miscarrying.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָפ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּדְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָׁ֖ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyrpv hmym 'd hyvm hzh khdbr 'lysh' 'shr dbr {p}
verses.translation: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְה֣וּא  עֹלֶ֣ה בַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וּנְעָרִ֤ים קְטַנִּים֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן־הָעִ֔יר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־בוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵ֖חַ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshm byt'l vhv'  'lh bdrkh vn'rym qtnym yts'v mnh'yr vytqlsvbv vy'mrv lv 'lh qrch 'lh qrch
verses.translation: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el; and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him: ‘Go up, thou baldhead; go up, thou baldhead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן אַֽחֲרָיו֙ וַיִּרְאֵ֔ם וַֽיְקַלְלֵ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וַתֵּצֶ֜אנָה שְׁתַּ֤יִם דֻּבִּים֙ מִן־הַיַּ֔עַר וַתְּבַקַּ֣עְנָה מֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנֵ֖י יְלָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vypn 'chryv vyr'm vyqllm bshm yhvh vtts'nh shtym dbym mnhy'r vtbq'nh mhm 'rb'ym vshny yldym
verses.translation: And he looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she-bears out of the wood, and tore forty and two children of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם אֶל־הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וּמִשָּׁ֖ם שָׁ֥ב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkh mshm 'lhr hkhrml vmshm shb shmrvn {p}
verses.translation: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן־אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhvrm bn'ch'b mlkh 'lyshr'l bshmrvn bshnt shmnh 'shrh lyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh vymlkh shtym'shrh shnh
verses.translation: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֥א כְאָבִ֖יו וּכְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'shh hr' b'yny yhvh rq l' kh'byv vkh'mv vysr 'tmtsbt hb'l 'shr 'shh 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother; for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֠ק בְּחַטֹּ֞אות יָרׇבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבֵ֑ק לֹא־סָ֖ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rq bcht'vt yrb'm bnnbt 'shrhchty' 'tyshr'l dbq l'sr mmnh {p}
verses.translation: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵישַׁ֥ע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָ֖ב הָיָ֣ה נֹקֵ֑ד וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לְמֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאָה־אֶ֣לֶף כָּרִ֔ים וּמֵ֥אָה אֶ֖לֶף אֵילִ֥ים צָֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: vmysh' mlkhmv'b hyh nqd vhshyb lmlkhyshr'l m'h'lf khrym vm'h 'lf 'ylym tsmr
verses.translation: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep-master; and he rendered unto the king of Israel the wool of a hundred thousand lambs, and of a hundred thousand rams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כְּמ֣וֹת אַחְאָ֑ב וַיִּפְשַׁ֥ע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָ֖ב בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy khmvt 'ch'b vypsh' mlkhmv'b bmlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מִשֹּׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyts' hmlkh yhvrm byvm hhv' mshmrvn vypqd 'tkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֡לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע בִּ֔י הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛י אֶל־מוֹאָ֖ב לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽעֱלֶ֔ה כָּמ֧וֹנִי כָמ֛וֹךָ כְּעַמִּ֥י כְעַמֶּ֖ךָ כְּסוּסַ֥י כְּסוּסֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vylkh vyshlch 'lyhvshpt mlkhyhvdh l'mr mlkh mv'b psh' by htlkh 'ty 'lmv'b lmlchmh vy'mr ''lh khmvny khmvkh kh'my kh'mkh khsvsy khsvsykh
verses.translation: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying: ‘The king of Moab hath rebelled against me; wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle?’ And he said: ‘I will go up; I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי־זֶ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ נַעֲלֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'yzh hdrkh n'lh vy'mr drkh mdbr 'dvm
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Which way shall we go up?’ And he answered: ‘The way of the wilderness of Edom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֩לֶךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּמֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וַיָּסֹ֕בּוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־הָיָ֨ה מַ֧יִם לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vylkh mlkh yshr'l vmlkhyhvdh vmlkh 'dvm vysbv drkh shb't ymym vl'hyh mym lmchnh vlbhmh 'shr brglyhm
verses.translation: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom; and they made a circuit of seven days’journey; and there was no water for the host, nor for the beasts that followed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲהָ֕הּ כִּי־קָרָ֣א יְהֹוָ֗ה לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־מוֹאָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'hh khyqr' yhvh lshlsht hmlkhym h'lh ltt 'vtm bydmv'b {s}
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said: ‘Alas! for the LORD hath called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הַאֵ֨ין פֹּ֤ה נָבִיא֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְנִדְרְשָׁ֥ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה מֵאוֹת֑וֹ וַ֠יַּ֠עַן אֶחָ֞ד מֵעַבְדֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר פֹּ֚ה אֱלִישָׁ֣ע בֶּן־שָׁפָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר־יָ֥צַק מַ֖יִם עַל־יְדֵ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt h'yn ph nby' lyhvh vndrshh 'tyhvh m'vtv vy'n 'chd m'bdy mlkhyshr'l vy'mr ph 'lysh' bnshpt 'shrytsq mym 'lydy 'lyhv
verses.translation: But Jehoshaphat said: ‘Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?’ And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said: ‘Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט יֵ֥שׁ אוֹת֖וֹ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּרְד֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו מֶ֧לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וּמֶ֥לֶךְ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt ysh 'vtv dbryhvh vyrdv 'lyv mlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt vmlkh 'dvm
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said: ‘The word of the LORD is with him.’ So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֜ע אֶל־מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַה־לִּ֣י וָלָ֔ךְ לֵ֚ךְ אֶל־נְבִיאֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ וְאֶל־נְבִיאֵ֖י אִמֶּ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַ֗ל כִּֽי־קָרָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lysh' 'lmlkh yshr'l mhly vlkh lkh 'lnby'y 'bykh v'lnby'y 'mkh vy'mr lv mlkh yshr'l 'l khyqr' yhvh lshlsht hmlkhym h'lh ltt 'vtm bydmv'b
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel: ‘What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother.’ And the king of Israel said unto him: ‘Nay; for the LORD hath called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֗ע חַי־יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְפָנָ֔יו כִּ֗י לוּלֵ֛י פְּנֵ֛י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י נֹשֵׂ֑א אִם־אַבִּ֥יט אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְאִם־אֶרְאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lysh' chyyhvh tsb'vt 'shr 'mdty lpnyv khy lvly pny yhvshpt mlkhyhvdh 'ny nsh' 'm'byt 'lykh v'm'r'kh
verses.translation: And Elisha said: ‘As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה קְחוּ־לִ֣י מְנַגֵּ֑ן וְהָיָה֙ כְּנַגֵּ֣ן הַֽמְנַגֵּ֔ן וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖יו יַד־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th qchvly mngn vhyh khngn hmngn vthy 'lyv ydyhvh
verses.translation: But now bring me a minstrel.’ And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה עָשֹׂ֛ה הַנַּ֥חַל הַזֶּ֖ה גֵּבִ֥ים ׀ גֵּבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'shh hnchl hzh gbym  gbym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Make this valley full of trenches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹא־תִרְא֥וּ ר֙וּחַ֙ וְלֹא־תִרְא֣וּ גֶ֔שֶׁם וְהַנַּ֥חַל הַה֖וּא יִמָּ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם וּשְׁתִיתֶ֛ם אַתֶּ֥ם וּמִקְנֵיכֶ֖ם וּֽבְהֶמְתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh l'tr'v rvch vl'tr'v gshm vhnchl hhv' yml' mym vshtytm 'tm vmqnykhm vbhmtkhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain, yet that valley shall be filled with water; and ye shall drink, both ye and your cattle and your beasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָקַ֥ל זֹ֖את בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְנָתַ֥ן אֶת־מוֹאָ֖ב בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vnql z't b'yny yhvh vntn 'tmv'b bydkhm
verses.translation: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD; He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם כׇּל־עִ֤יר מִבְצָר֙ וְכׇל־עִ֣יר מִבְח֔וֹר וְכׇל־עֵ֥ץ טוֹב֙ תַּפִּ֔ילוּ וְכׇל־מַעְיְנֵי־מַ֖יִם תִּסְתֹּ֑מוּ וְכֹל֙ הַחֶלְקָ֣ה הַטּוֹבָ֔ה תַּכְאִ֖בוּ בָּאֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhkhytm khl'yr mbtsr vkhl'yr mbchvr vkhl'ts tvb tpylv vkhlm'ynymym tstmv vkhl hchlqh htvbh tkh'bv b'bnym
verses.translation: And ye shall smite every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all fountains of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־מַ֥יִם בָּאִ֖ים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr kh'lvt hmnchh vhnhmym b'ym mdrkh 'dvm vtml' h'rts 'thmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning, about the time of making the offering, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מוֹאָב֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּי־עָל֥וּ הַמְּלָכִ֖ים לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑ם וַיִּצָּעֲק֗וּ מִכֹּ֨ל חֹגֵ֤ר חֲגֹרָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיַּעַמְד֖וּ עַֽל־הַגְּבֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vkhlmv'b shm'v khy'lv hmlkhym lhlchm bm vyts'qv mkhl chgr chgrh vm'lh vy'mdv 'lhgbvl
verses.translation: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood on the border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ זָרְחָ֣ה עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּרְא֨וּ מוֹאָ֥ב מִנֶּ֛גֶד אֶת־הַמַּ֖יִם אֲדֻמִּ֥ים כַּדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshkhymv bbqr vhshmsh zrchh 'lhmym vyr'v mv'b mngd 'thmym 'dmym khdm
verses.translation: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water some way off as red as blood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ דָּ֣ם זֶ֔ה הׇחֳרֵ֤ב נֶֽחֶרְבוּ֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים וַיַּכּ֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְעַתָּ֥ה לַשָּׁלָ֖ל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv dm zh hchrb nchrbv hmlkhym vykhv 'ysh 'tr'hv v'th lshll mv'b
verses.translation: and they said: ‘This is blood: the kings have surely fought together, and they have smitten each man his fellow; now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֘אוּ֮ אֶל־מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּ אֶת־מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם (ויבו) [וַיַּ֨כּוּ־]בָ֔הּ וְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lmchnh yshr'l vyqmv yshr'l vykhv 'tmv'b vynsv mpnyhm (vybv) [vykhv]bh vhkhvt 'tmv'b
verses.translation: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them. And they smote the land, even Moab, mightily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֣ים יַהֲרֹ֡סוּ וְכׇל־חֶלְקָ֣ה ט֠וֹבָ֠ה יַשְׁלִ֨יכוּ אִישׁ־אַבְנ֜וֹ וּמִלְא֗וּהָ וְכׇל־מַעְיַן־מַ֤יִם יִסְתֹּ֙מוּ֙ וְכׇל־עֵֽץ־ט֣וֹב יַפִּ֔ילוּ עַד־הִשְׁאִ֧יר אֲבָנֶ֛יהָ בַּקִּ֖יר חֲרָ֑שֶׂת וַיָּסֹ֥בּוּ הַקַּלָּעִ֖ים וַיַּכּֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: vh'rym yhrsv vkhlchlqh tvbh yshlykhv 'ysh'bnv vml'vh vkhlm'ynmym ystmv vkhl'tstvb ypylv 'dhsh'yr 'bnyh bqyr chrsht vysbv hql'ym vykhvh
verses.translation: And they beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land they cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the fountains of water, and felled all the good trees; until there was left only Kir-hareseth with the stones of the wall thereof; so the slingers encompassed it, and smote it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב כִּֽי־חָזַ֥ק מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֣ח א֠וֹת֠וֹ שְׁבַע־מֵא֨וֹת אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֗רֶב לְהַבְקִ֛יעַ אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱד֖וֹם וְלֹ֥א יָכֹֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vyr' mlkh mv'b khychzq mmnv hmlchmh vyqch 'vtv shb'm'vt 'ysh shlf chrb lhbqy' 'lmlkh 'dvm vl' ykhlv
verses.translation: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew sword, to break through unto the king of Edom; but they could not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־בְּנ֨וֹ הַבְּכ֜וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֗יו וַיַּעֲלֵ֤הוּ עֹלָה֙ עַל־הַ֣חֹמָ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י קֶצֶף־גָּד֖וֹל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵעָלָ֔יו וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqch 'tbnv hbkhvr 'shrymlkh tchtyv vy'lhv 'lh 'lhchmh vyhy qtsfgdvl 'lyshr'l vys'v m'lyv vyshbv l'rts {p}
verses.translation: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt-offering upon the wall. And there came great wrath upon Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֣ת מִנְּשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־הַ֠נְּבִיאִ֠ים צָעֲקָ֨ה אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֜ע לֵאמֹ֗ר עַבְדְּךָ֤ אִישִׁי֙ מֵ֔ת וְאַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֣י עַבְדְּךָ֔ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֖א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהַ֨נֹּשֶׁ֔ה בָּ֗א לָקַ֜חַת אֶת־שְׁנֵ֧י יְלָדַ֛י ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shh 'cht mnshy bnyhnby'ym ts'qh 'l'lysh' l'mr 'bdkh 'yshy mt v'th yd't khy 'bdkh hyh yr' 'tyhvh vhnshh b' lqcht 'tshny yldy lv l'bdym
verses.translation: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying: ‘Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD; and the creditor is come to take unto him my two children to be bondmen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֱלִישָׁע֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ הַגִּ֣ידִי לִ֔י מַה־יֶּשׁ־[לָ֖ךְ] (לכי) בַּבָּ֑יִת וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣ין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ֥ כֹל֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־אָס֥וּךְ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'lysh' mh ''shhlkh hgydy ly mhysh[lkh] (lkhy) bbyt vt'mr 'yn lshpchtkh khl bbyt khy 'm'svkh shmn
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto her: ‘What shall I do for thee? tell me; what hast thou in the house?’ And she said: ‘Thy handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִ֨י שַׁאֲלִי־לָ֤ךְ כֵּלִים֙ מִן־הַח֔וּץ מֵאֵ֖ת כׇּל־[שְׁכֵנָ֑יִךְ] (שכנכי) כֵּלִ֥ים רֵקִ֖ים אַל־תַּמְעִֽיטִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhy sh'lylkh khlym mnhchvts m't khl[shkhnykh] (shkhnkhy) khlym rqym 'ltm'yty
verses.translation: Then he said: ‘Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֗את וְסָגַ֤רְתְּ הַדֶּ֙לֶת֙ בַּעֲדֵ֣ךְ וּבְעַד־בָּנַ֔יִךְ וְיָצַ֕קְתְּ עַ֥ל כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְהַמָּלֵ֖א תַּסִּֽיעִי׃
verses.translit: vb't vsgrt hdlt b'dkh vb'dbnykh vytsqt 'l khlhkhlym h'lh vhml' tsy'y
verses.translation: And thou shalt go in, and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and pour out into all those vessels; and thou shalt set aside that which is full.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽאִתּ֔וֹ וַתִּסְגֹּ֣ר הַדֶּ֔לֶת בַּעֲדָ֖הּ וּבְעַ֣ד בָּנֶ֑יהָ הֵ֛ם מַגִּישִׁ֥ים אֵלֶ֖יהָ וְהִ֥יא (מיצקת) [מוֹצָֽקֶת]׃
verses.translit: vtlkh m'tv vtsgr hdlt b'dh vb'd bnyh hm mgyshym 'lyh vhy' (mytsqt) [mvtsqt]
verses.translation: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons; they brought the vessels to her, and she poured out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כִּמְלֹ֣את הַכֵּלִ֗ים וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־בְּנָהּ֙ הַגִּ֨ישָׁה אֵלַ֥י עוֹד֙ כֶּ֔לִי וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד כֶּ֑לִי וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khml't hkhlym vt'mr 'lbnh hgyshh 'ly 'vd khly vy'mr 'lyh 'yn 'vd khly vy'md hshmn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son: ‘Bring me yet a vessel.’ And he said unto her: ‘There is not a vessel more.’ And the oil stayed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֗א וַתַּגֵּד֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִי֙ מִכְרִ֣י אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְשַׁלְּמִ֖י אֶת־[נִשְׁיֵ֑ךְ] (נשיכי) וְאַ֣תְּ (בניכי) [וּבָנַ֔יִךְ] תִּֽחְיִ֖י בַּנּוֹתָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtb' vtgd l'ysh h'lhym vy'mr lkhy mkhry 'thshmn vshlmy 't[nshykh] (nshykhy) v't (bnykhy) [vbnykh] tchyy bnvtr {p}
verses.translation: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said: ‘Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy sons of the rest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י הַיּ֜וֹם וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אֶל־שׁוּנֵ֗ם וְשָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתַּחֲזֶק־בּ֖וֹ לֶאֱכׇל־לָ֑חֶם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִדֵּ֣י עׇבְר֔וֹ יָסֻ֥ר שָׁ֖מָּה לֶאֱכׇל־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vy'br 'lysh' 'lshvnm vshm 'shh gdvlh vtchzqbv l'khllchm vyhy mdy 'brv ysr shmh l'khllchm
verses.translation: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־אִישָׁ֔הּ הִנֵּה־נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קָד֣וֹשׁ ה֑וּא עֹבֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖ינוּ תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l'yshh hnhn' yd'ty khy 'ysh 'lhym qdvsh hv' 'br 'lynv tmyd
verses.translation: And she said unto her husband: ‘Behold now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God, that passeth by us continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּ֤א עֲלִיַּת־קִיר֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְנָשִׂ֨ים ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם מִטָּ֥ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֖ן וְכִסֵּ֣א וּמְנוֹרָ֑ה וְהָיָ֛ה בְּבֹא֥וֹ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ יָס֥וּר שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: n'shhn' 'lytqyr qtnh vnshym lv shm mth vshlchn vkhs' vmnvrh vhyh bb'v 'lynv ysvr shmh
verses.translation: Let us make, I pray thee, a little chamber on the roof; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick; and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם וַיָּ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה וַיָּ֥סַר אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּ֖ה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb' shmh vysr 'lh'lyh vyshkhbshmh
verses.translation: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the upper chamber and lay there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ קְרָ֖א לַשּׁוּנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את וַיִּ֨קְרָא־לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lgychzy n'rv qr' lshvnmyt hz't vyqr'lh vt'md lpnyv
verses.translation: And he said to Gehazi his servant: ‘Call this Shunammite.’ And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֱמׇר־נָ֣א אֵלֶ֘יהָ֮ הִנֵּ֣ה חָרַ֣דְתְּ ׀ אֵלֵ֘ינוּ֮ אֶת־כׇּל־הַחֲרָדָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ מֶ֚ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔ךְ הֲיֵ֤שׁ לְדַבֶּר־לָךְ֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ א֖וֹ אֶל־שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וַתֹּ֕אמֶר בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמִּ֖י אָנֹכִ֥י יֹשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'mrn' 'lyh hnh chrdt  'lynv 'tkhlhchrdh hz't mh l'shvt lkh hysh ldbrlkh 'lhmlkh 'v 'lshr htsb' vt'mr btvkh 'my 'nkhy yshbt
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘Say now unto her: Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host?’ And she answered: ‘I dwell among mine own people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר וּמֶ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י אֲבָ֛ל בֵּ֥ן אֵֽין־לָ֖הּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ זָקֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr vmh l'shvt lh vy'mr gychzy 'bl bn 'ynlh v'yshh zqn
verses.translation: And he said: ‘What then is to be done for her?’ And Gehazi answered: ‘Verily she hath no son, and her husband is old.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר קְרָא־לָ֑הּ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּפָּֽתַח׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qr'lh vyqr'lh vt'md bptch
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Call her.’ And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה (אתי) [אַ֖תְּ] חֹבֶ֣קֶת בֵּ֑ן וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־אֲדֹנִי֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל־תְּכַזֵּ֖ב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lmv'd hzh kh't chyh ('ty) ['t] chbqt bn vt'mr 'l'dny 'ysh h'lhym 'ltkhzb bshpchtkh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘At this season, when the time cometh round, thou shalt embrace a son.’ And she said: ‘Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thy handmaid.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֥הַר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: vthr h'shh vtld bn lmv'd hzh kh't chyh 'shrdbr 'lyh 'lysh'
verses.translation: And the woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came round, as Elisha had said unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל הַיָּ֑לֶד וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֶל־אָבִ֖יו אֶל־הַקֹּצְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vygdl hyld vyhy hyvm vyts' 'l'byv 'lhqtsrym
verses.translation: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־אָבִ֖יו רֹאשִׁ֣י ׀ רֹאשִׁ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔עַר שָׂאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l'byv r'shy  r'shy vy'mr 'lhn'r sh'hv 'l'mv
verses.translation: And he said unto his father: ‘My head, my head.’ And he said to his servant: ‘Carry him to his mother.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֨שָּׂאֵ֔הוּ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב עַל־בִּרְכֶּ֛יהָ עַד־הַֽצׇּהֳרַ֖יִם וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vysh'hv vyby'hv 'l'mv vyshb 'lbrkhyh 'dhtshrym vymt
verses.translation: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֙עַל֙ וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵ֔הוּ עַל־מִטַּ֖ת אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּסְגֹּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vt'l vtshkhbhv 'lmtt 'ysh h'lhym vtsgr b'dv vtts'
verses.translation: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָא֮ אֶל־אִישָׁהּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֨ה נָ֥א לִי֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ת הָאֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְאָר֛וּצָה עַד־אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאָשֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.translit: vtqr' 'l'yshh vt'mr shlchh n' ly 'chd mnhn'rym v'cht h'tnvt v'rvtsh 'd'ysh h'lhym v'shvbh
verses.translation: And she called unto her husband, and said: ‘Send me, I pray thee, one of the servants, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come back.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מַ֠דּ֠וּעַ (אתי) [אַ֣תְּ] (הלכתי) [הֹלֶ֤כֶת] אֵלָיו֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹא־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וְלֹ֣א שַׁבָּ֑ת וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mdv' ('ty) ['t] (hlkhty) [hlkht] 'lyv hyvm l'chdsh vl' shbt vt'mr shlvm
verses.translation: And he said: Wherefore wilt thou go to him today? it is neither new moon nor sabbath.’ And she said: ‘It shall be well.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ הָאָת֔וֹן וַתֹּ֥אמֶר אֶֽל־נַעֲרָ֖הּ נְהַ֣ג וָלֵ֑ךְ אַל־תַּעֲצׇר־לִ֣י לִרְכֹּ֔ב כִּ֖י אִם־אָמַ֥רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vtchbsh h'tvn vt'mr 'ln'rh nhg vlkh 'lt'tsrly lrkhb khy 'm'mrty lkh
verses.translation: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant: ‘Drive, and go forward; slacken me not the riding, except I bid thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶךְ וַתָּבֹ֛א אֶל־אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וַ֠יְהִ֠י כִּרְא֨וֹת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים אֹתָהּ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ הִנֵּ֖ה הַשּׁוּנַמִּ֥ית הַלָּֽז׃
verses.translit: vtlkh vtb' 'l'ysh h'lhym 'lhr hkhrml vyhy khr'vt 'yshh'lhym 'th mngd vy'mr 'lgychzy n'rv hnh hshvnmyt hlz
verses.translation: So she went, and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant: ‘Behold, yonder is that Shunammite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּה֮ רֽוּץ־נָ֣א לִקְרָאתָהּ֒ וֶאֱמׇר־לָ֗הּ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לָ֛ךְ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לְאִישֵׁ֖ךְ הֲשָׁל֣וֹם לַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'th rvtsn' lqr'th v'mrlh hshlvm lkh hshlvm l'yshkh hshlvm lyld vt'mr shlvm
verses.translation: Run, I pray thee, now to meet her, and say unto her: Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child?’ And she answered: ‘It is well.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֞א אֶל־אִ֤ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־הָהָ֔ר וַֽתַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ גֵּיחֲזִ֜י לְהׇדְפָ֗הּ וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ אִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים הַרְפֵּה־לָהּ֙ כִּֽי־נַפְשָׁ֣הּ מָֽרָה־לָ֔הּ וַֽיהֹוָה֙ הֶעְלִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְלֹ֥א הִגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vtb' 'l'ysh h'lhym 'lhhr vtchzq brglyv vygsh gychzy lhdph vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym hrphlh khynpshh mrhlh vyhvh h'lym mmny vl' hgyd ly
verses.translation: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. And Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said: ‘Let her alone; for her soul is bitter within her; and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר הֲשָׁאַ֥לְתִּי בֵ֖ן מֵאֵ֣ת אֲדֹנִ֑י הֲלֹ֣א אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹ֥א תַשְׁלֶ֖ה אֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr hsh'lty bn m't 'dny hl' 'mrty l' tshlh 'ty
verses.translation: Then she said: ‘Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say: Do not deceive me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִ֜י חֲגֹ֣ר מׇתְנֶ֗יךָ וְקַ֨ח מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֮ וָלֵךְ֒ כִּי־תִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א תְבָרְכֶ֔נּוּ וְכִֽי־יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑נּוּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֖י עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lgychzy chgr mtnykh vqch msh'nty bydkh vlkh khytmts' 'ysh l' tbrkhnv vkhyybrkhkh 'ysh l' t'nnv vshmt msh'nty 'lpny hn'r
verses.translation: Then he said to Gehazi: ‘Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thy hand, and go thy way; if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not; and lay my staff upon the face of the child.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ם הַנַּ֔עַר חַי־יְהֹוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּ֖קׇם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'm hn'r chyyhvh vchynpshkh 'm''zbkh vyqm vylkh 'chryh
verses.translation: And the mother of the child said: ‘As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.’ And he arose, and followed her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֵחֲזִ֞י עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּשְׁעֶ֙נֶת֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַנַּ֔עַר וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְאֵ֣ין קָ֑שֶׁב וַיָּ֤שׇׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיַּגֶּד־ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א הֵקִ֖יץ הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vgchzy 'br lpnyhm vyshm 'thmsh'nt 'lpny hn'r v'yn qvl v'yn qshb vyshb lqr'tv vygdlv l'mr l' hqyts hn'r
verses.translation: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he returned to meet him, and told him, saying: ‘The child is not awaked.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֱלִישָׁ֖ע הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנַּ֙עַר֙ מֵ֔ת מֻשְׁכָּ֖ב עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lysh' hbyth vhnh hn'r mt mshkhb 'lmttv
verses.translation: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר הַדֶּ֖לֶת בְּעַ֣ד שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyb' vysgr hdlt b'd shnyhm vytpll 'lyhvh
verses.translation: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עַל־הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיָּ֩שֶׂם֩ פִּ֨יו עַל־פִּ֜יו וְעֵינָ֤יו עַל־עֵינָיו֙ וְכַפָּ֣יו עַל־כַּפָּ֔ו וַיִּגְהַ֖ר עָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֖חׇם בְּשַׂ֥ר הַיָּֽלֶד׃
verses.translit: vy'l vyshkhb 'lhyld vyshm pyv 'lpyv v'ynyv 'l'ynyv vkhpyv 'lkhpv vyghr 'lyv vychm bshr hyld
verses.translation: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands; and he stretched himself upon him; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜שׇׁב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּבַּ֗יִת אַחַ֥ת הֵ֙נָּה֙ וְאַחַ֣ת הֵ֔נָּה וַיַּ֖עַל וַיִּגְהַ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וַיְזוֹרֵ֤ר הַנַּ֙עַר֙ עַד־שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּפְקַ֥ח הַנַּ֖עַר אֶת־עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshb vylkh bbyt 'cht hnh v'cht hnh vy'l vyghr 'lyv vyzvrr hn'r 'dshb' p'mym vypqch hn'r 't'ynyv
verses.translation: Then he returned, and walked in the house once to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him; and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִ֗י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ קְרָא֙ אֶל־הַשֻּׁנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַיִּקְרָאֶ֖הָ וַתָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׂאִ֥י בְנֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lgychzy vy'mr qr' 'lhshnmyt hz't vyqr'h vtb' 'lyv vy'mr sh'y bnkh
verses.translation: And he called Gehazi, and said: ‘Call this Shunammite.’ So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said: ‘Take up thy son.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹא֙ וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָה וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־בְּנָ֖הּ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtb' vtpl 'lrglyv vtshtchv 'rtsh vtsh' 'tbnh vtts' {p}
verses.translation: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed down to the ground; and she took up her son, and went out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֞ע שָׁ֤ב הַגִּלְגָּ֙לָה֙ וְהָרָעָ֣ב בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּבְנֵי֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים יֹשְׁבִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְנַעֲר֗וֹ שְׁפֹת֙ הַסִּ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּבַשֵּׁ֥ל נָזִ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lysh' shb hglglh vhr'b b'rts vbny hnby'ym yshbym lpnyv vy'mr ln'rv shpt hsyr hgdvlh vbshl nzyd lbny hnby'ym
verses.translation: And Elisha came again to Gilgal; and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said unto his servant: ‘Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֶחָ֣ד אֶל־הַשָּׂדֶה֮ לְלַקֵּ֣ט אֹרֹת֒ וַיִּמְצָא֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שָׂדֶ֔ה וַיְלַקֵּ֥ט מִמֶּ֛נּוּ פַּקֻּעֹ֥ת שָׂדֶ֖ה מְלֹ֣א בִגְד֑וֹ וַיָּבֹ֗א וַיְפַלַּ֛ח אֶל־סִ֥יר הַנָּזִ֖יד כִּי־לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'chd 'lhshdh llqt 'rt vymts' gpn shdh vylqt mmnv pq't shdh ml' bgdv vyb' vyplch 'lsyr hnzyd khyl' yd'v
verses.translation: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage; for they knew them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽצְק֥וּ לַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֶאֱכ֑וֹל וַ֠יְהִ֠י כְּאׇכְלָ֨ם מֵהַנָּזִ֜יד וְהֵ֣מָּה צָעָ֗קוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מָ֤וֶת בַּסִּיר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.translit: vytsqv l'nshym l'khvl vyhy kh'khlm mhnzyd vhmh ts'qv vy'mrv mvt bsyr 'ysh h'lhym vl' ykhlv l'khl
verses.translation: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said: ‘O man of God, there is death in the pot.’ And they could not eat thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ וּקְחוּ־קֶ֔מַח וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־הַסִּ֑יר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר צַ֤ק לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה דָּבָ֥ר רָ֖ע בַּסִּֽיר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr vqchvqmch vyshlkh 'lhsyr vy'mr tsq l'm vy'khlv vl' hyh dbr r' bsyr {s}
verses.translation: But he said: ‘Then bring meal.’ And he cast it into the pot; and he said: ‘Pour out for the people, that they may eat.’ And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ בָּ֜א מִבַּ֣עַל שָׁלִ֗שָׁה וַיָּבֵא֩ לְאִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לֶ֤חֶם בִּכּוּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִֽים־לֶ֣חֶם שְׂעֹרִ֔ים וְכַרְמֶ֖ל בְּצִקְלֹנ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר תֵּ֥ן לָעָ֖ם וְיֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh b' mb'l shlshh vyb' l'ysh h'lhym lchm bkhvrym 'shrymlchm sh'rym vkhrml btsqlnv vy'mr tn l'm vy'khlv
verses.translation: And there came a man from Baal-shalishah, and brought the man of God bread of the first-fruits, twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of corn in his sack. And he said: ‘Give unto the people, that they may eat.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ מָ֚ה אֶתֵּ֣ן זֶ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י מֵ֣אָה אִ֑ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תֵּ֤ן לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אָכֹ֥ל וְהוֹתֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshrtv mh 'tn zh lpny m'h 'ysh vy'mr tn l'm vy'khlv khy khh 'mr yhvh 'khl vhvtr
verses.translation: And his servant said: ‘How should I set this before a hundred men?’ But he said: ‘Give the people, that they may eat; for thus saith the LORD: They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ וַיּוֹתִ֖רוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytn lpnyhm vy'khlv vyvtrv khdbr yhvh {p}
verses.translation: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠נַעֲמָ֠ן שַׂר־צְבָ֨א מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָ֜ם הָיָ֣ה אִישׁ֩ גָּד֨וֹל לִפְנֵ֤י אֲדֹנָיו֙ וּנְשֻׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים כִּי־ב֛וֹ נָתַן־יְהֹוָ֥ה תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה לַאֲרָ֑ם וְהָאִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל מְצֹרָֽע׃
verses.translit: vn'mn shrtsb' mlkh'rm hyh 'ysh gdvl lpny 'dnyv vnsh' pnym khybv ntnyhvh tshv'h l'rm vh'ysh hyh gbvr chyl mtsr'
verses.translation: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Aram, was a great man with his master, and held in esteem, because by him the LORD had given victory unto Aram; he was also a mighty man of valour, but he was a leper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲרָם֙ יָצְא֣וּ גְדוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁבּ֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נַעֲרָ֣ה קְטַנָּ֑ה וַתְּהִ֕י לִפְנֵ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת נַעֲמָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'rm yts'v gdvdym vyshbv m'rts yshr'l n'rh qtnh vthy lpny 'sht n'mn
verses.translation: And the Arameans had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־גְּבִרְתָּ֔הּ אַחֲלֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י לִפְנֵ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן אָ֛ז יֶאֱסֹ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ מִצָּרַעְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lgbrth 'chly 'dny lpny hnby' 'shr bshmrvn 'z y'sf 'tv mtsr'tv
verses.translation: And she said unto her mistress: ‘Would that my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! then would he recover him of his leprosy.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לַאדֹנָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּזֹ֤את וְכָזֹאת֙ דִּבְּרָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵאֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyb' vygd l'dnyv l'mr khz't vkhz't dbrh hn'rh 'shr m'rts yshr'l
verses.translation: And he went in, and told his lord, saying: ‘Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָם֙ לֶךְ־בֹּ֔א וְאֶשְׁלְחָ֥ה סֵ֖פֶר אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֩לֶךְ֩ וַיִּקַּ֨ח בְּיָד֜וֹ עֶ֣שֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי־כֶ֗סֶף וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ זָהָ֔ב וְעֶ֖שֶׂר חֲלִיפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh'rm lkhb' v'shlchh spr 'lmlkh yshr'l vylkh vyqch bydv 'shr khkhrykhsf vshsht 'lpym zhb v'shr chlypvt bgdym
verses.translation: And the king of Aram said: ‘Go now, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel.’ And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּב֨וֹא הַסֵּ֤פֶר הַזֶּה֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־נַעֲמָ֣ן עַבְדִּ֔י וַאֲסַפְתּ֖וֹ מִצָּרַעְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' hspr 'lmlkh yshr'l l'mr v'th khbv' hspr hzh 'lykh hnh shlchty 'lykh 'tn'mn 'bdy v'sptv mtsr'tv
verses.translation: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying: ‘And now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כִּקְרֹא֩ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־הַסֵּ֜פֶר וַיִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַאֱלֹהִ֥ים אָ֙נִי֙ לְהָמִ֣ית וּֽלְהַחֲי֔וֹת כִּי־זֶה֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֵלַ֔י לֶאֱסֹ֥ף אִ֖ישׁ מִצָּרַעְתּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י אַךְ־דְּעוּ־נָא֙ וּרְא֔וּ כִּֽי־מִתְאַנֶּ֥ה ה֖וּא לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy khqr' mlkhyshr'l 'thspr vyqr' bgdyv vy'mr h'lhym 'ny lhmyt vlhchyvt khyzh shlch 'ly l'sf 'ysh mtsr'tv khy 'khd'vn' vr'v khymt'nh hv' ly
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said: ‘Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? but consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh an occasion against me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ  אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּֽי־קָרַ֤ע מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר לָ֥מָּה קָרַ֖עְתָּ בְּגָדֶ֑יךָ יָבֹא־נָ֣א אֵלַ֔י וְיֵדַ֕ע כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ נָבִ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'  'lysh' 'yshh'lhym khyqr' mlkhyshr'l 'tbgdyv vyshlch 'lhmlkh l'mr lmh qr't bgdykh yb'n' 'ly vyd' khy ysh nby' byshr'l
verses.translation: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying: ‘Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א נַעֲמָ֖ן בְּסוּסָ֣ו וּבְרִכְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד פֶּֽתַח־הַבַּ֖יִת לֶאֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: vyb' n'mn bsvsv vbrkhbv vy'md ptchhbyt l'lysh'
verses.translation: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛יו אֱלִישָׁ֖ע מַלְאָ֣ךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר הָל֗וֹךְ וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ שֶֽׁבַע־פְּעָמִים֙ בַּיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְיָשֹׁ֧ב בְּשָׂרְךָ֛ לְךָ֖ וּטְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv 'lysh' ml'kh l'mr hlvkh vrchtst shb'p'mym byrdn vyshb bshrkh lkh vthr
verses.translation: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying: ‘Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come back to thee, and thou shalt be clean.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֥ף נַעֲמָ֖ן וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ הִנֵּ֨ה אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֵלַ֣י  יֵצֵ֣א יָצ֗וֹא וְעָמַד֙ וְקָרָא֙ בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם וְאָסַ֥ף הַמְּצֹרָֽע׃
verses.translit: vyqtsf n'mn vylkh vy'mr hnh 'mrty 'ly  yts' ytsv' v'md vqr' bshmyhvh 'lhyv vhnyf ydv 'lhmqvm v'sf hmtsr'
verses.translation: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said: ‘Behold, I thought: He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֡א טוֹב֩ (אבנה) [אֲמָנָ֨ה] וּפַרְפַּ֜ר נַהֲר֣וֹת דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק מִכֹּל֙ מֵימֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹֽא־אֶרְחַ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם וְטָהָ֑רְתִּי וַיִּ֖פֶן וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּחֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hl' tvb ('bnh) ['mnh] vprpr nhrvt dmshq mkhl mymy yshr'l hl''rchts bhm vthrty vypn vylkh bchmh
verses.translation: Are not Amanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean?’ So he turned, and went away in a rage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֣וּ עֲבָדָיו֮ וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָיו֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אָבִי֙ דָּבָ֣ר גָּד֗וֹל הַנָּבִ֛יא דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ הֲל֣וֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְאַ֛ף כִּי־אָמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רְחַ֥ץ וּטְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vygshv 'bdyv vydbrv 'lyv vy'mrv 'by dbr gdvl hnby' dbr 'lykh hlv' t'shh v'f khy'mr 'lykh rchts vthr
verses.translation: And his servants came near, and spoke unto him, and said: ‘My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee: Wash, and be clean?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗רֶד וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל בַּיַּרְדֵּן֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים כִּדְבַ֖ר אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּ֣שׇׁב בְּשָׂר֗וֹ כִּבְשַׂ֛ר נַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן וַיִּטְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyrd vytbl byrdn shb' p'mym khdbr 'ysh h'lhym vyshb bshrv khbshr n'r qtn vythr
verses.translation: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh came back like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩שׇׁב֩ אֶל־אִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים ה֣וּא וְכׇֽל־מַחֲנֵ֗הוּ וַיָּבֹא֮ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָיו֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה־נָ֤א יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֖י אִם־בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֛ה קַח־נָ֥א בְרָכָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ת עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'l'ysh h'lhym hv' vkhlmchnhv vyb' vy'md lpnyv vy'mr hnhn' yd'ty khy 'yn 'lhym bkhlh'rts khy 'mbyshr'l v'th qchn' brkhh m't 'bdkh
verses.translation: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said: ‘Behold now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel; now therefore, I pray thee, take a present of thy servant.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־עָמַ֥דְתִּי לְפָנָ֖יו אִם־אֶקָּ֑ח וַיִּפְצַר־בּ֥וֹ לָקַ֖חַת וַיְמָאֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chyyhvh 'shr'mdty lpnyv 'm'qch vyptsrbv lqcht vym'n
verses.translation: But he said: ‘As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none.’ And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ נַעֲמָן֒ וָלֹ֕א יֻתַּן־נָ֣א לְעַבְדְּךָ֔ מַשָּׂ֥א צֶמֶד־פְּרָדִ֖ים אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֡י לֽוֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה֩ ע֨וֹד עַבְדְּךָ֜ עֹלָ֤ה וָזֶ֙בַח֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם־לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr n'mn vl' ytnn' l'bdkh msh' tsmdprdym 'dmh khy lv'y'shh 'vd 'bdkh 'lh vzbch l'lhym 'chrym khy 'mlyhvh
verses.translation: And Naaman said: ‘If not, yet I pray thee let there be given to thy servant two mules’burden of earth; for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt-offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה יִסְלַ֥ח יְהֹוָ֖ה לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּב֣וֹא אֲדֹנִ֣י בֵית־רִמּוֹן֩ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֨ת שָׁ֜מָּה וְה֣וּא  נִשְׁעָ֣ן עַל־יָדִ֗י וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֙יתִי֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן בְּהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָ֙תִי֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן יִסְלַח־(נא)־יְהֹוָ֥ה לְעַבְדְּךָ֖ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: ldbr hzh yslch yhvh l'bdkh bbv' 'dny bytrmvn lhshtchvt shmh vhv'  nsh'n 'lydy vhshtchvyty byt rmn bhshtchvyty byt rmn yslch(n')yhvh l'bdkh bdbr hzh
verses.translation: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant: when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I prostrate myself in the house of Rimmon, when I prostrate myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ לֵ֣ךְ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מֵאִתּ֖וֹ כִּבְרַת־אָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr lv lkh lshlvm vylkh m'tv khbrt'rts {s}
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘Go in peace.’ So he departed from him some way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י נַ֘עַר֮ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים֒ הִנֵּ֣ה  חָשַׂ֣ךְ אֲדֹנִ֗י אֶֽת־נַעֲמָ֤ן הָאֲרַמִּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה מִקַּ֥חַת מִיָּד֖וֹ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֑יא חַי־יְהֹוָה֙ כִּֽי־אִם־רַ֣צְתִּי אַחֲרָ֔יו וְלָקַחְתִּ֥י מֵאִתּ֖וֹ מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr gychzy n'r 'lysh' 'yshh'lhym hnh  chshkh 'dny 'tn'mn h'rmy hzh mqcht mydv 't 'shrhby' chyyhvh khy'mrtsty 'chryv vlqchty m'tv m'vmh
verses.translation: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said: ‘Behold, my master hath spared this Naaman the Aramean, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought; as the LORD liveth, I will surely run after him, and take somewhat of him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְדֹּ֥ף גֵּיחֲזִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י נַעֲמָ֑ן וַיִּרְאֶ֤ה נַֽעֲמָן֙ רָ֣ץ אַחֲרָ֔יו וַיִּפֹּ֞ל מֵעַ֧ל הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לִקְרָאת֖וֹ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הֲשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyrdf gychzy 'chry n'mn vyr'h n'mn rts 'chryv vypl m'l hmrkhbh lqr'tv vy'mr hshlvm
verses.translation: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw one running after him, he alighted from the chariot to meet him, and said: ‘Is all well?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  שָׁל֗וֹם אֲדֹנִי֮ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי לֵאמֹר֒ הִנֵּ֣ה עַתָּ֡ה זֶ֠ה בָּ֣אוּ אֵלַ֧י שְׁנֵֽי־נְעָרִ֛ים מֵהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים תְּנָה־נָּ֤א לָהֶם֙ כִּכַּר־כֶּ֔סֶף וּשְׁתֵּ֖י חֲלִפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  shlvm 'dny shlchny l'mr hnh 'th zh b'v 'ly shnyn'rym mhr 'prym mbny hnby'ym tnhn' lhm khkhrkhsf vshty chlpvt bgdym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘All is well. My master hath sent me, saying: Behold, even now there are come to me from the hill-country of Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets; give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of raiment.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נַעֲמָ֔ן הוֹאֵ֖ל קַ֣ח כִּכָּרָ֑יִם וַיִּפְרׇץ־בּ֗וֹ וַיָּ֩צַר֩ כִּכְּרַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף בִּשְׁנֵ֣י חֲרִטִ֗ים וּשְׁתֵּי֙ חֲלִפ֣וֹת בְּגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֣י נְעָרָ֔יו וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr n'mn hv'l qch khkhrym vyprtsbv vytsr khkhrym khsf bshny chrtym vshty chlpvt bgdym vytn 'lshny n'ryv vysh'v lpnyv
verses.translation: And Naaman said: ‘Be content, take two talents.’ And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of raiment, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bore them before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הָעֹ֔פֶל וַיִּקַּ֥ח מִיָּדָ֖ם וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד בַּבָּ֑יִת וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lh'pl vyqch mydm vypqd bbyt vyshlch 'th'nshym vylkhv
verses.translation: And when he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and deposited them in the house; and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּא־בָא֙ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע (מאן) [מֵאַ֖יִן] גֵּחֲזִ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹא־הָלַ֥ךְ עַבְדְּךָ֖ אָ֥נֶה וָאָֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vhv'b' vy'md 'l'dnyv vy'mr 'lyv 'lysh' (m'n) [m'yn] gchzy vy'mr l'hlkh 'bdkh 'nh v'nh
verses.translation: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him: ‘Whence comest thou, Gehazi?’ And he said: ‘Thy servant went no whither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ לֹֽא־לִבִּ֣י הָלַ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר הָפַךְ־אִ֛ישׁ מֵעַ֥ל מֶרְכַּבְתּ֖וֹ לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ הַעֵ֞ת לָקַ֤חַת אֶת־הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְלָקַ֣חַת בְּגָדִ֔ים וְזֵיתִ֤ים וּכְרָמִים֙ וְצֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר וַעֲבָדִ֖ים וּשְׁפָחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv l'lby hlkh kh'shr hpkh'ysh m'l mrkhbtv lqr'tkh h't lqcht 'thkhsf vlqcht bgdym vzytym vkhrmym vts'n vbqr v'bdym vshpchvt
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘Went not my heart [with thee], when the man turned back from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards and vineyards, and sheep and oxen, and men-servants and maid-servants?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָרַ֤עַת נַֽעֲמָן֙ תִּֽדְבַּק־בְּךָ֔ וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵ֥א מִלְּפָנָ֖יו מְצֹרָ֥ע כַּשָּֽׁלֶג׃
verses.translit: vtsr't n'mn tdbqbkh vbzr'kh l'vlm vyts' mlpnyv mtsr' khshlg
verses.translation: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever.’ And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֑ע הִנֵּה־נָ֣א הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֜חְנוּ יֹשְׁבִ֥ים שָׁ֛ם לְפָנֶ֖יךָ צַ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv bnyhnby'ym 'l'lysh' hnhn' hmqvm 'shr 'nchnv yshbym shm lpnykh tsr mmnv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha: ‘Behold now, the place where we dwell before thee is too strait for us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֵלְכָה־נָּ֣א עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְנִקְחָ֤ה מִשָּׁם֙ אִ֚ישׁ קוֹרָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְנַעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֥נוּ שָׁ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לָשֶׁ֣בֶת שָׁ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: nlkhhn' 'dhyrdn vnqchh mshm 'ysh qvrh 'cht vn'shhlnv shm mqvm lshbt shm vy'mr lkhv
verses.translation: Let us go, we pray thee, unto the Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell.’ And he answered: ‘Go ye.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד ה֥וֹאֶל נָ֖א וְלֵ֣ךְ אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֥י אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'chd hv'l n' vlkh 't'bdykh vy'mr 'ny 'lkh
verses.translation: And one said: ‘Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants.’ And he answered: ‘I will go.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
