verses.original: לוּלֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הוֹתִ֥יר לָ֛נוּ שָׂרִ֖יד כִּמְעָ֑ט כִּסְדֹ֣ם הָיִ֔ינוּ לַעֲמֹרָ֖ה דָּמִֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lvly yhvh tsb'vt hvtyr lnv shryd khm't khsdm hyynv l'mrh dmynv {p}
verses.translation: Except the LORD of hosts Had left unto us a very small remnant, We should have been as Sodom, We should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'v dbryhvh qtsyny sdm h'zynv tvrt 'lhynv 'm 'mrh
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD, Ye rulers of Sodom; Give ear unto the law of our God, Ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָּה־לִּ֤י רֹב־זִבְחֵיכֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְחֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים וְדַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּכְבָשִׂ֛ים וְעַתּוּדִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
verses.translit: lmhly rbzbchykhm y'mr yhvh shb'ty 'lvt 'ylym vchlb mry'ym vdm prym vkhbshym v'tvdym l' chptsty
verses.translation: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto Me? Saith the LORD; I am full of the burnt-offerings of rams, And the fat of fed beasts; And I delight not in the blood Of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵֽרָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑י מִֽי־בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy tb'v lr'vt pny mybqsh z't mydkhm rms chtsry
verses.translation: When ye come to appear before Me, Who hath required this at your hand, To trample My courts?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ הָבִיא֙ מִנְחַת־שָׁ֔וְא קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַעֲצָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' tvsypv hby' mnchtshv' qtrt tv'bh hy' ly chdsh vshbt qr' mqr' l''vkhl 'vn v'tsrh
verses.translation: Bring no more vain oblations; It is an offering of abomination unto Me; New moon and sabbath, the holding of convocations— I cannot endure iniquity along with the solemn assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇדְשֵׁיכֶ֤ם וּמֽוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֙ שָֽׂנְאָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלַ֖י לָטֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃
verses.translit: chdshykhm vmv'dykhm shn'h npshy hyv 'ly ltrch nl'yty nsh'
verses.translation: Your new moons and your appointed seasons My soul hateth; They are a burden unto Me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵיכֶ֖ם דָּמִ֥ים מָלֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vbprshkhm khpykhm ''lym 'yny mkhm gm khytrbv tplh 'ynny shm' ydykhm dmym ml'v
verses.translation: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide Mine eyes from you; Yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear; Your hands are full of blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַֽחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: rchtsv hzkhv hsyrv r' m'llykhm mngd 'yny chdlv hr'
verses.translation: Wash you, make you clean, Put away the evil of your doings From before Mine eyes, Cease to do evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lmdv hytb drshv mshpt 'shrv chmvts shptv ytvm rybv 'lmnh {s}
verses.translation: Learn to do well; Seek justice, relieve the oppressed, Judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכוּ־נָ֛א וְנִוָּכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה אִם־יִהְי֨וּ חֲטָאֵיכֶ֤ם כַּשָּׁנִים֙ כַּשֶּׁ֣לֶג יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ אִם־יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַתּוֹלָ֖ע כַּצֶּ֥מֶר יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhvn' vnvkhchh y'mr yhvh 'myhyv cht'ykhm khshnym khshlg ylbynv 'my'dymv khtvl' khtsmr yhyv
verses.translation: Come now, and let us reason together, Saith the LORD; Though your sins be as scarlet, They shall be as white as snow; Though they be red like crimson, They shall be as wool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תֹּאב֖וּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם ט֥וּב הָאָ֖רֶץ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mt'bv vshm'tm tvb h'rts t'khlv
verses.translation: If ye be willing and obedient, Ye shall eat the good of the land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּמְרִיתֶ֑ם חֶ֣רֶב תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mtm'nv vmrytm chrb t'khlv khy py yhvh dbr {p}
verses.translation: But if ye refuse and rebel, Ye shall be devoured with the sword; For the mouth of the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְזוֹנָ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖הּ וְעַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ykhh hyth lzvnh qryh n'mnh ml'ty mshpt tsdq ylyn bh v'th mrtschym
verses.translation: How is the faithful city Become a harlot! She that was full of justice, Righteousness lodged in her, But now murderers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּסְפֵּ֖ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְסִיגִ֑ים סׇבְאֵ֖ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khspkh hyh lsygym sb'kh mhvl bmym
verses.translation: Thy silver is become dross, Thy wine mixed with water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣יִךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְחַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּוֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְרֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים יָתוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ וְרִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹא־יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shrykh svrrym vchbry gnbym khlv 'hb shchd vrdf shlmnym ytvm l' yshptv vryb 'lmnh l'ybv' 'lyhm {s}
verses.translation: Thy princes are rebellious, And companions of thieves; Every one loveth bribes, And followeth after rewards; They judge not the fatherless, Neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻ֤ם הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃
verses.translit: lkhn n'm h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt 'byr yshr'l hvy 'nchm mtsry v'nqmh m'vyby
verses.translation: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, The Mighty One of Israel: Ah, I will ease Me of Mine adversaries, And avenge Me of Mine enemies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כׇּל־בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: v'shybh ydy 'lykh v'tsrf khbr sygykh v'syrh khlbdylykh
verses.translation: And I will turn My hand upon thee, And purge away thy dross as with lye, And will take away all thine alloy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּבָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְיֹעֲצַ֖יִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּ֑ה אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַצֶּ֔דֶק קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shybh shptykh khbr'shnh vy'tsykh khbtchlh 'chrykhn yqr' lkh 'yr htsdq qryh n'mnh
verses.translation: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, And thy counsellors as at the beginning; Afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, The faithful city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: tsyvn bmshpt tpdh vshbyh btsdqh
verses.translation: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, And they that return of her with righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֧בֶר פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְחַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְעֹזְבֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vshbr psh'ym vcht'ym ychdv v'zby yhvh ykhlv
verses.translation: But the destruction of the transgressors and the sinners shall be together, And they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵאֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְתַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵהַגַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy ybshv m'ylym 'shr chmdtm vtchprv mhgnvt 'shr bchrtm
verses.translation: For they shall be ashamed of the terebinths which ye have desired, And ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּאֵלָ֖ה נֹבֶ֣לֶת עָלֶ֑הָ וּֽכְגַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־מַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy thyv kh'lh nblt 'lh vkhgnh 'shrmym 'yn lh
verses.translation: For ye shall be as a terebinth whose leaf fadeth, And as a garden that hath no water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הֶחָסֹן֙ לִנְעֹ֔רֶת וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לְנִיצ֑וֹץ וּבָעֲר֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh hchsn ln'rt vp'lv lnytsvts vb'rv shnyhm ychdv v'yn mkhbh {p}
verses.translation: And the strong shall be as tow, And his work as a spark; And they shall both burn together, And none shall quench them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אָמ֑וֹץ עַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr chzh ysh'yhv bn'mvts 'lyhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֖א מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh  b'chryt hymym nkhvn yhyh hr bytyhvh br'sh hhrym vnsh' mgb'vt vnhrv 'lyv khlhgvym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the end of days, That the mountain of the LORD’S house Shall be established as the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ  וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhlkhv 'mym rbym v'mrv lkhv  vn'lh 'lhryhvh 'lbyt 'lhy y'qb vyrnv mdrkhyv vnlkhh b'rchtyv khy mtsyvn tts' tvrh vdbryhvh myrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And many peoples shall go and say: ‘Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; And He will teach us of His ways, And we will walk in His paths.’ For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהוֹכִ֖יחַ לְעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא־יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹֽא־יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshpt byn hgvym vhvkhych l'mym rbym vkhttv chrbvtm l'tym vchnytvtyhm lmzmrvt l'ysh' gvy 'lgvy chrb vl'ylmdv 'vd mlchmh {p}
verses.translation: And He shall judge between the nations, And shall decide for many peoples; And they shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruninghooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֖ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּא֥וֹר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: byt y'qb lkhv vnlkhh b'vr yhvh
verses.translation: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk In the light of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י נָטַ֗שְׁתָּה עַמְּךָ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֤י מָֽלְאוּ֙ מִקֶּ֔דֶם וְעֹנְנִ֖ים כַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּבְיַלְדֵ֥י נׇכְרִ֖ים יַשְׂפִּֽיקוּ׃
verses.translit: khy ntshth 'mkh byt y'qb khy ml'v mqdm v'nnym khplshtym vbyldy nkhrym yshpyqv
verses.translation: For Thou hast forsaken Thy people the house of Jacob; For they are replenished from the east, And with soothsayers like the Philistines, And they please themselves in the brood of aliens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְאֹצְרֹתָ֑יו וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ סוּסִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְמַרְכְּבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vtml' 'rtsv khsf vzhb v'yn qtsh l'tsrtyv vtml' 'rtsv svsym v'yn qtsh lmrkhbtyv
verses.translation: Their land also is full of silver and gold, Neither is there any end of their treasures; Their land also is full of horses, Neither is there any end of their chariots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א אַרְצ֖וֹ אֱלִילִ֑ים לְמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֔וּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vtml' 'rtsv 'lylym lm'shh ydyv yshtchvv l'shr 'shv 'tsb'tyv
verses.translation: Their land also is full of idols; Every one worshippeth the work of his own hands, That which his own fingers have made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־תִּשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshch 'dm vyshpl'ysh v'ltsh' lhm
verses.translation: And man boweth down, And man lowereth himself; And Thou canst not bear with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּ֣וֹא בַצּ֔וּר וְהִטָּמֵ֖ן בֶּעָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵי֙ פַּ֣חַד יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמֵהֲדַ֖ר גְּאֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bv' btsvr vhtmn b'pr mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'nv
verses.translation: Enter into the rock, And hide thee in the dust, From before the terror of the LORD, And from the glory of His majesty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינֵ֞י גַּבְה֤וּת אָדָם֙ שָׁפֵ֔ל וְשַׁ֖ח ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהֹוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yny gbhvt 'dm shpl vshch rvm 'nshym vnshgb yhvh lbdv byvm hhv' {p}
verses.translation: The lofty looks of man shall be brought low, And the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, And the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י י֞וֹם לַיהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת עַ֥ל כׇּל־גֵּאֶ֖ה וָרָ֑ם וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־נִשָּׂ֥א וְשָׁפֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy yvm lyhvh tsb'vt 'l khlg'h vrm v'l khlnsh' vshpl
verses.translation: For the LORD of hosts hath a day Upon all that is proud and lofty, And upon all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֙ כׇּל־אַרְזֵ֣י הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן הָרָמִ֖ים וְהַנִּשָּׂאִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־אַלּוֹנֵ֥י הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: v'l khl'rzy hlbnvn hrmym vhnsh'ym v'l khl'lvny hbshn
verses.translation: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon That are high and lifted up, And upon all the oaks of Bashan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הֶהָרִ֣ים הָרָמִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הַגְּבָע֥וֹת הַנִּשָּׂאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'l khlhhrym hrmym v'l khlhgb'vt hnsh'vt
verses.translation: And upon all the high mountains, And upon all the hills that are lifted up;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־מִגְדָּ֣ל גָּבֹ֑הַּ וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־חוֹמָ֥ה בְצוּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'l khlmgdl gbh v'l khlchvmh btsvrh
verses.translation: And upon every lofty tower, And upon every fortified wall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־שְׂכִיּ֥וֹת הַחֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'l khl'nyvt trshysh v'l khlshkhyvt hchmdh
verses.translation: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, And upon all delightful imagery.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁח֙ גַּבְה֣וּת הָאָדָ֔ם וְשָׁפֵ֖ל ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהֹוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vshch gbhvt h'dm vshpl rvm 'nshym vnshgb yhvh lbdv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, And the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; And the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֱלִילִ֖ים כָּלִ֥יל יַחֲלֹֽף׃
verses.translit: vh'lylym khlyl ychlf
verses.translation: And the idols shall utterly pass away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֙אוּ֙ בִּמְעָר֣וֹת צֻרִ֔ים וּבִמְחִלּ֖וֹת עָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהֹוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vb'v bm'rvt tsrym vbmchlvt 'pr mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'vnv bqvmv l'rts h'rts
verses.translation: And men shall go into the caves of the rocks, And into the holes of the earth, From before the terror of the LORD, And from the glory of His majesty, When He ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יַשְׁלִ֣יךְ הָאָדָ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת אֱלִילֵ֣י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָֽשׂוּ־לוֹ֙ לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לַחְפֹּ֥ר פֵּר֖וֹת וְלָעֲטַלֵּפִֽים׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yshlykh h'dm 't 'lyly khspv v't 'lyly zhbv 'shr 'shvlv lhshtchvt lchpr prvt vl'tlpym
verses.translation: In that day a man shall cast away His idols of silver, and his idols of gold, Which they made for themselves to worship, To the moles and to the bats;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָבוֹא֙ בְּנִקְר֣וֹת הַצֻּרִ֔ים וּבִסְעִפֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהֹוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: lbv' bnqrvt htsrym vbs'py hsl'ym mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'vnv bqvmv l'rts h'rts
verses.translation: To go into the clefts of the rocks, And into the crevices of the crags, From before the terror of the LORD, And from the glory of His majesty, When he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִדְל֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְשָׁמָ֖ה בְּאַפּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־בַמֶּ֥ה נֶחְשָׁ֖ב הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: chdlv lkhm mnh'dm 'shr nshmh b'pv khybmh nchshb hv' {p}
verses.translation: Cease ye from man, in whose nostrils is a breath; For how little is he to be accounted!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה הָאָד֜וֹן יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת מֵסִ֤יר מִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ וּמִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה מַשְׁעֵ֖ן וּמַשְׁעֵנָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל מִשְׁעַן־לֶ֔חֶם וְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁעַן־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khy hnh h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt msyr myrvshl͏m vmyhvdh msh'n vmsh'nh khl msh'nlchm vkhl msh'nmym
verses.translation: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, Doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah Stay and staff, Every stay of bread, and every stay of water;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גִּבּ֖וֹר וְאִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה שׁוֹפֵ֥ט וְנָבִ֖יא וְקֹסֵ֥ם וְזָקֵֽן׃
verses.translit: gbvr v'ysh mlchmh shvpt vnby' vqsm vzqn
verses.translation: The mighty man, and the man of war; The judge, and the prophet, And the diviner, and the elder;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וּנְשׂ֣וּא פָנִ֑ים וְיוֹעֵ֛ץ וַחֲכַ֥ם חֲרָשִׁ֖ים וּנְב֥וֹן לָֽחַשׁ׃
verses.translit: shrchmshym vnshv' pnym vyv'ts vchkhm chrshym vnbvn lchsh
verses.translation: The captain of fifty, and the man of rank, And the counsellor, and the cunning charmer, and the skilful enchanter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י נְעָרִ֖ים שָׂרֵיהֶ֑ם וְתַעֲלוּלִ֖ים יִמְשְׁלוּ־בָֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty n'rym shryhm vt'lvlym ymshlvbm
verses.translation: And I will give children to be their princes, And babes shall rule over them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִגַּ֣שׂ הָעָ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּאִ֖ישׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ יִרְהֲב֗וּ הַנַּ֙עַר֙ בַּזָּקֵ֔ן וְהַנִּקְלֶ֖ה בַּנִּכְבָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vngsh h'm 'ysh b'ysh v'ysh br'hv yrhbv hn'r bzqn vhnqlh bnkhbd
verses.translation: And the people shall oppress one another, Every man his fellow, and every man his neighbour; The child shall behave insolently against the aged, And the base against the honourable,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־יִתְפֹּ֨שׂ אִ֤ישׁ בְּאָחִיו֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו שִׂמְלָ֣ה לְכָ֔ה קָצִ֖ין תִּֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑נוּ וְהַמַּכְשֵׁלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khyytpsh 'ysh b'chyv byt 'byv shmlh lkhh qtsyn thyhlnv vhmkhshlh hz't tcht ydkh
verses.translation: For a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father: ‘Thou hast a mantle, Be thou our ruler, And let this ruin be under thy hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׂא֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֤וּא ׀ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־אֶהְיֶ֣ה חֹבֵ֔שׁ וּבְבֵיתִ֕י אֵ֥ין לֶ֖חֶם וְאֵ֣ין שִׂמְלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְשִׂימֻ֖נִי קְצִ֥ין עָֽם׃
verses.translit: ysh' byvm hhv'  l'mr l''hyh chbsh vbbyty 'yn lchm v'yn shmlh l' tshymny qtsyn 'm
verses.translation: In that day shall he swear, saying: ‘I will not be a healer; For in my house is neither bread nor a mantle; Ye shall not make me ruler of a people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָֽשְׁלָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וִיהוּדָ֖ה נָפָ֑ל כִּֽי־לְשׁוֹנָ֤ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה לַמְר֖וֹת עֵנֵ֥י כְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy khshlh yrvshl͏m vyhvdh npl khylshvnm vm'llyhm 'lyhvh lmrvt 'ny khbvdv
verses.translation: For Jerusalem is ruined, And Judah is fallen; Because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, To provoke the eyes of His glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכָּרַ֤ת פְּנֵיהֶם֙ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם כִּסְדֹ֥ם הִגִּ֖ידוּ לֹ֣א כִחֵ֑דוּ א֣וֹי לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם כִּי־גָמְל֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hkhrt pnyhm 'nth bm vcht'tm khsdm hgydv l' khchdv 'vy lnpshm khygmlv lhm r'h
verses.translation: The show of their countenance doth witness against them; And they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! For they have wrought evil unto themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ צַדִּ֖יק כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּֽי־פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיהֶ֖ם יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mrv tsdyq khytvb khypry m'llyhm y'khlv
verses.translation: Say ye of the righteous, that it shall be well with him; For they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֖וֹי לְרָשָׁ֣ע רָ֑ע כִּֽי־גְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖יו יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'vy lrsh' r' khygmvl ydyv y'shh lv
verses.translation: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him; For the work of his hands shall be done to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּי֙ נֹגְשָׂ֣יו מְעוֹלֵ֔ל וְנָשִׁ֖ים מָ֣שְׁלוּ ב֑וֹ עַמִּי֙ מְאַשְּׁרֶ֣יךָ מַתְעִ֔ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ אֹרְחֹתֶ֖יךָ בִּלֵּֽעוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'my ngshyv m'vll vnshym mshlv bv 'my m'shrykh mt'ym vdrkh 'rchtykh bl'v {p}
verses.translation: As for My people, a babe is their master, And women rule over them. O My people, they that lead thee cause thee to err, And destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִצָּ֥ב לָרִ֖יב יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעֹמֵ֖ד לָדִ֥ין עַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: ntsb lryb yhvh v'md ldyn 'mym
verses.translation: The LORD standeth up to plead, And standeth to judge the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יָב֔וֹא עִם־זִקְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹ וְשָׂרָ֑יו וְאַתֶּם֙ בִּעַרְתֶּ֣ם הַכֶּ֔רֶם גְּזֵלַ֥ת הֶעָנִ֖י בְּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh bmshpt ybv' 'mzqny 'mv vshryv v'tm b'rtm hkhrm gzlt h'ny bbtykhm
verses.translation: The LORD will enter into judgment With the elders of His people, and the princes thereof: ‘It is ye that have eaten up the vineyard; The spoil of the poor is in your houses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (מלכם) [מַה־לָּכֶם֙] תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔י וּפְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים תִּטְחָ֑נוּ נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: (mlkhm) [mhlkhm] tdkh'v 'my vpny 'nyym ttchnv n'm'dny yhvh tsb'vt {s}
verses.translation: What mean ye that ye crush My people, And grind the face of the poor?’ Saith the Lord, the GOD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֗ה יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י גָֽבְהוּ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֔וֹן וַתֵּלַ֙כְנָה֙ (נטוות) [נְטוּי֣וֹת] גָּר֔וֹן וּֽמְשַׂקְּר֖וֹת עֵינָ֑יִם הָל֤וֹךְ וְטָפֹף֙ תֵּלַ֔כְנָה וּבְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם תְּעַכַּֽסְנָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh y'n khy gbhv bnvt tsyvn vtlkhnh (ntvvt) [ntvyvt] grvn vmshqrvt 'ynym hlvkh vtpf tlkhnh vbrglyhm t'khsnh
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, And walk with stretched-forth necks And wanton eyes, Walking and mincing as they go, And making a tinkling with their feet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׂפַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָ֔י קׇדְקֹ֖ד בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֑וֹן וַיהֹוָ֖ה פׇּתְהֵ֥ן יְעָרֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshpch 'dny qdqd bnvt tsyvn vyhvh pthn y'rh {s}
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab The crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, And the LORD will lay bare their secret parts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יָסִ֣יר אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֣ת תִּפְאֶ֧רֶת הָעֲכָסִ֛ים וְהַשְּׁבִיסִ֖ים וְהַשַּׂהֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysyr 'dny 't tp'rt h'khsym vhshbysym vhshhrnym
verses.translation: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their anklets, and the fillets, and the crescents;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּטִפ֥וֹת וְהַשֵּׁיר֖וֹת וְהָרְעָלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hntpvt vhshyrvt vhr'lvt
verses.translation: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the veils;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַפְּאֵרִ֤ים וְהַצְּעָדוֹת֙ וְהַקִּשֻּׁרִ֔ים וּבָתֵּ֥י הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ וְהַלְּחָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: hp'rym vhts'dvt vhqshrym vbty hnpsh vhlchshym
verses.translation: the headtires, and the armlets, and the sashes, and the corselets, and the amulets;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַטַּבָּע֖וֹת וְנִזְמֵ֥י הָאָֽף׃
verses.translit: htb'vt vnzmy h'f
verses.translation: the rings, and the nose-jewels;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּֽחֲלָצוֹת֙ וְהַמַּ֣עֲטָפ֔וֹת וְהַמִּטְפָּח֖וֹת וְהָחֲרִיטִֽים׃
verses.translit: hmchltsvt vhm'tpvt vhmtpchvt vhchrytym
verses.translation: the aprons, and the mantelets, and the cloaks, and the girdles;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְיֹנִים֙ וְהַסְּדִינִ֔ים וְהַצְּנִיפ֖וֹת וְהָרְדִידִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhglynym vhsdynym vhtsnypvt vhrdydym
verses.translation: and the gauze robes, and the fine linen, and the turbans, and the mantles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ תַ֨חַת בֹּ֜שֶׂם מַ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֗ה וְתַ֨חַת חֲגוֹרָ֤ה נִקְפָּה֙ וְתַ֨חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה מִקְשֶׁה֙ קׇרְחָ֔ה וְתַ֥חַת פְּתִיגִ֖יל מַחֲגֹ֣רֶת שָׂ֑ק כִּי־תַ֖חַת יֹֽפִי׃
verses.translit: vhyh tcht bshm mq yhyh vtcht chgvrh nqph vtcht m'shh mqshh qrchh vtcht ptygyl mchgrt shq khytcht ypy
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that Instead of sweet spices there shall be rottenness; And instead of a girdle rags; And instead of curled hair baldness; And instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; Branding instead of beauty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְתַ֖יִךְ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וּגְבוּרָתֵ֖ךְ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: mtykh bchrb yplv vgbvrtkh bmlchmh
verses.translation: Thy men shall fall by the sword, And thy mighty in the war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנ֥וּ וְאָבְל֖וּ פְּתָחֶ֑יהָ וְנִקָּ֖תָה לָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: v'nv v'blv ptchyh vnqth l'rts tshb
verses.translation: And her gates shall lament and mourn; And utterly bereft she shall sit upon the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶחֱזִ֩יקוּ֩ שֶׁ֨בַע נָשִׁ֜ים בְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַחְמֵ֣נוּ נֹאכֵ֔ל וְשִׂמְלָתֵ֖נוּ נִלְבָּ֑שׁ רַ֗ק יִקָּרֵ֤א שִׁמְךָ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אֱסֹ֖ף חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhchzyqv shb' nshym b'ysh 'chd byvm hhv' l'mr lchmnv n'khl vshmltnv nlbsh rq yqr' shmkh 'lynv 'sf chrptnv {s}
verses.translation: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying: ‘We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel; only let us be called by thy name; take thou away our reproach.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ צֶ֣מַח יְהֹוָ֔ה לִצְבִ֖י וּלְכָב֑וֹד וּפְרִ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לִפְלֵיטַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh tsmch yhvh ltsby vlkhbvd vpry h'rts lg'vn vltp'rt lplytt yshr'l
verses.translation: In that day shall the growth of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, And the fruit of the land excellent and comely For them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  הַנִּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם קָד֖וֹשׁ יֵאָ֣מֶר ל֑וֹ כׇּל־הַכָּת֥וּב לַחַיִּ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhyh  hnsh'r btsyvn vhnvtr byrvshl͏m qdvsh y'mr lv khlhkhtvb lchyym byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written unto life in Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ם  רָחַ֣ץ אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֚ת צֹאַ֣ת בְּנוֹת־צִיּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־דְּמֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם יָדִ֣יחַ מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ בְּר֥וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבְר֥וּחַ בָּעֵֽר׃
verses.translit: 'm  rchts 'dny 't ts't bnvttsyvn v'tdmy yrvshl͏m ydych mqrbh brvch mshpt vbrvch b'r
verses.translation: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof, by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָרָ֣א יְהֹוָ֡ה עַל֩ כׇּל־מְכ֨וֹן הַר־צִיּ֜וֹן וְעַל־מִקְרָאֶ֗הָ עָנָ֤ן ׀ יוֹמָם֙ וְעָשָׁ֔ן וְנֹ֛גַהּ אֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה כִּ֥י עַל־כׇּל־כָּב֖וֹד חֻפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbr' yhvh 'l khlmkhvn hrtsyvn v'lmqr'h 'nn  yvmm v'shn vngh 'sh lhbh lylh khy 'lkhlkhbvd chph
verses.translation: And the LORD will create over the whole habitation of mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory shall be a canopy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסֻכָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְצֵל־יוֹמָ֖ם מֵחֹ֑רֶב וּלְמַחְסֶה֙ וּלְמִסְתּ֔וֹר מִזֶּ֖רֶם וּמִמָּטָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vskhh thyh ltslyvmm mchrb vlmchsh vlmstvr mzrm vmmtr {p}
verses.translation: And there shall be a pavilion for a shadow in the day-time from the heat, and for a refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָשִׁ֤ירָה נָּא֙ לִֽידִידִ֔י שִׁירַ֥ת דּוֹדִ֖י לְכַרְמ֑וֹ כֶּ֛רֶם הָיָ֥ה לִידִידִ֖י בְּקֶ֥רֶן בֶּן־שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: 'shyrh n' lydydy shyrt dvdy lkhrmv khrm hyh lydydy bqrn bnshmn
verses.translation: Let me sing of my well-beloved, A song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My well-beloved had a vineyard In a very fruitful hill;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְעַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וַֽיְסַקְּלֵ֗הוּ וַיִּטָּעֵ֙הוּ֙ שֹׂרֵ֔ק וַיִּ֤בֶן מִגְדָּל֙ בְּתוֹכ֔וֹ וְגַם־יֶ֖קֶב חָצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַ֛ו לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vy'zqhv vysqlhv vyt'hv shrq vybn mgdl btvkhv vgmyqb chtsb bv vyqv l'shvt 'nbym vy'sh b'shym
verses.translation: And he digged it, and cleared it of stones, And planted it with the choicest vine, And built a tower in the midst of it, And also hewed out a vat therein; And he looked that it should bring forth grapes, And it brought forth wild grapes. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה שִׁפְטוּ־נָ֕א בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין כַּרְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th yvshb yrvshl͏m v'ysh yhvdh shptvn' byny vbyn khrmy
verses.translation: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, Judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־לַּעֲשׂ֥וֹת עוֹד֙ לְכַרְמִ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָשִׂ֖יתִי בּ֑וֹ מַדּ֧וּעַ קִוֵּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: mhl'shvt 'vd lkhrmy vl' 'shyty bv mdv' qvyty l'shvt 'nbym vy'sh b'shym
verses.translation: What could have been done more to my vineyard, That I have not done in it? Wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, Brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אוֹדִיעָה־נָּ֣א אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְכַרְמִ֑י הָסֵ֤ר מְשׂוּכָּתוֹ֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לְבָעֵ֔ר פָּרֹ֥ץ גְּדֵר֖וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.translit: v'th 'vdy'hn' 'tkhm 't 'shr'ny 'shh lkhrmy hsr mshvkhtv vhyh lb'r prts gdrv vhyh lmrms
verses.translation: And now come, I will tell you What I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, And it shall be eaten up; I will break down the fence thereof, And it shall be trodden down;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בָתָ֗ה לֹ֤א יִזָּמֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵעָדֵ֔ר וְעָלָ֥ה שָׁמִ֖יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְעַ֤ל הֶֽעָבִים֙ אֲצַוֶּ֔ה מֵהַמְטִ֥יר עָלָ֖יו מָטָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'shythv bth l' yzmr vl' y'dr v'lh shmyr vshyt v'l h'bym 'tsvh mhmtyr 'lyv mtr
verses.translation: And I will lay it waste: It shall not be pruned nor hoed, But there shall come up briers and thorns; I will also command the clouds That they rain no rain upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֜רֶם יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה נְטַ֖ע שַׁעֲשׁוּעָ֑יו וַיְקַ֤ו לְמִשְׁפָּט֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִשְׂפָּ֔ח לִצְדָקָ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה צְעָקָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy khrm yhvh tsb'vt byt yshr'l v'ysh yhvdh nt' sh'shv'yv vyqv lmshpt vhnh mshpch ltsdqh vhnh ts'qh {p}
verses.translation: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, And the men of Judah the plant of His delight; And He looked for justice, but behold violence; For righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֙יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hvy mgy'y byt bbyt shdh bshdh yqrybv 'd 'ps mqvm vhvshbtm lbdkhm bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: Woe unto them that join house to house, That lay field to field, Till there be no room, and ye be made to dwell Alone in the midst of the land!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאׇזְנָ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־לֹ֞א בָּתִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה יִֽהְי֔וּ גְּדֹלִ֥ים וְטוֹבִ֖ים מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: b'zny yhvh tsb'vt 'ml' btym rbym lshmh yhyv gdlym vtvbym m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts: Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, Even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י עֲשֶׂ֙רֶת֙ צִמְדֵּי־כֶ֔רֶם יַעֲשׂ֖וּ בַּ֣ת אֶחָ֑ת וְזֶ֥רַע חֹ֖מֶר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֵיפָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'shrt tsmdykhrm y'shv bt 'cht vzr' chmr y'shh 'yph {s}
verses.translation: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, And the seed of a homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַבֹּ֖קֶר שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃
verses.translit: hvy mshkhymy bbqr shkhr yrdpv m'chry bnshf yyn ydlyqm
verses.translation: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, That they may follow strong drink; That tarry late into the night, Till wine inflame them!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה כִנּ֜וֹר וָנֶ֗בֶל תֹּ֧ף וְחָלִ֛יל וָיַ֖יִן מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת פֹּ֤עַל יְהֹוָה֙ לֹ֣א יַבִּ֔יטוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khnvr vnbl tf vchlyl vyyn mshtyhm v't p'l yhvh l' ybytv vm'shh ydyv l' r'v
verses.translation: And the harp and the psaltery, the tabret and the pipe, And wine, are in their feasts; But they regard not the work of the LORD, Neither have they considered the operation of His hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן גָּלָ֥ה עַמִּ֖י מִבְּלִי־דָ֑עַת וּכְבוֹדוֹ֙ מְתֵ֣י רָעָ֔ב וַהֲמוֹנ֖וֹ צִחֵ֥ה צָמָֽא׃
verses.translit: lkhn glh 'my mblyd't vkhbvdv mty r'b vhmvnv tschh tsm'
verses.translation: Therefore My people are gone into captivity, For want of knowledge; And their honourable men are famished, And their multitude are parched with thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִרְחִ֤יבָה שְּׁאוֹל֙ נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וּפָעֲרָ֥ה פִ֖יהָ לִבְלִי־חֹ֑ק וְיָרַ֨ד הֲדָרָ֧הּ וַהֲמוֹנָ֛הּ וּשְׁאוֹנָ֖הּ וְעָלֵ֥ז בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hrchybh sh'vl npshh vp'rh pyh lblychq vyrd hdrh vhmvnh vsh'vnh v'lz bh
verses.translation: Therefore the nether-world hath enlarged her desire, And opened her mouth without measure; And down goeth their glory, and their tumult, and their uproar, And he that rejoiceth among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְעֵינֵ֥י גְבֹהִ֖ים תִּשְׁפַּֽלְנָה׃
verses.translit: vyshch 'dm vyshpl'ysh v'yny gbhym tshplnh
verses.translation: And man is bowed down, And man is humbled, And the eyes of the lofty are humbled; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְבַּ֛הּ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהָאֵל֙ הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vygbh yhvh tsb'vt bmshpt vh'l hqdvsh nqdsh btsdqh
verses.translation: But the LORD of hosts is exalted through justice, And God the Holy One is sanctified through righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָע֥וּ כְבָשִׂ֖ים כְּדׇבְרָ֑ם וְחׇרְב֥וֹת מֵחִ֖ים גָּרִ֥ים יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vr'v khbshym khdbrm vchrbvt mchym grym y'khlv {s}
verses.translation: Then shall the lambs feed as in their pasture, And the waste places of the fat ones shall wanderers eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מֹשְׁכֵ֥י הֶעָוֺ֖ן בְּחַבְלֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑וְא וְכַעֲב֥וֹת הָעֲגָלָ֖ה חַטָּאָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvy mshkhy h'vn bchbly hshv' vkh'bvt h'glh cht'h
verses.translation: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, And sin as it were with a cart rope,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֗ים יְמַהֵ֧ר ׀ יָחִ֛ישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ לְמַ֣עַן נִרְאֶ֑ה וְתִקְרַ֣ב וְתָב֗וֹאָה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנֵדָֽעָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: h'mrym ymhr  ychyshh m'shhv lm'n nr'h vtqrb vtbv'h 'tst qdvsh yshr'l vnd'h {p}
verses.translation: That say: ‘Let Him make speed, let Him hasten His work, That we may see it; And let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, That we may know it! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֤שֶׁךְ לְאוֹר֙ וְא֣וֹר לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְמָת֖וֹק וּמָת֥וֹק לְמָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy h'mrym lr' tvb vltvb r' shmym chshkh l'vr v'vr lchshkh shmym mr lmtvq vmtvq lmr {s}
verses.translation: Woe unto them that call evil good, And good evil; That change darkness into light, And light into darkness; That change bitter into sweet, And sweet into bitter!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וְנֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם נְבֹנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy chkhmym b'ynyhm vngd pnyhm nbnym {s}
verses.translation: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, And prudent in their own sight!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִשְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְאַנְשֵׁי־חַ֖יִל לִמְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.translit: hvy gbvrym lshtvt yyn v'nshychyl lmskh shkhr
verses.translation: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, And men of strength to mingle strong drink;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצְדִּיקֵ֥י רָשָׁ֖ע עֵ֣קֶב שֹׁ֑חַד וְצִדְקַ֥ת צַדִּיקִ֖ים יָסִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mtsdyqy rsh' 'qb shchd vtsdqt tsdyqym ysyrv mmnv {p}
verses.translation: That justify the wicked for a reward, And take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ כֶּאֱכֹ֨ל קַ֜שׁ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֵ֗שׁ וַחֲשַׁ֤שׁ לֶהָבָה֙ יִרְפֶּ֔ה שׇׁרְשָׁם֙ כַּמָּ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וּפִרְחָ֖ם כָּאָבָ֣ק יַעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֣י מָאֲס֗וּ אֵ֚ת תּוֹרַת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֵ֛ת אִמְרַ֥ת קְדֽוֹשׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִאֵֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn kh'khl qsh lshvn 'sh vchshsh lhbh yrph shrshm khmq yhyh vprchm kh'bq y'lh khy m'sv 't tvrt yhvh tsb'vt v't 'mrt qdvshyshr'l n'tsv
verses.translation: Therefore as the tongue of fire devoureth the stubble, And as the chaff is consumed in the flame, So their root shall be as rottenness, And their blossom shall go up as dust; Because they have rejected the law of the LORD of hosts, And contemned the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֡ן חָרָה֩ אַף־יְהֹוָ֨ה בְּעַמּ֜וֹ וַיֵּ֣ט יָד֧וֹ עָלָ֣יו וַיַּכֵּ֗הוּ וַֽיִּרְגְּזוּ֙ הֶהָרִ֔ים וַתְּהִ֧י נִבְלָתָ֛ם כַּסּוּחָ֖ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב חוּצ֑וֹת בְּכׇל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn chrh 'fyhvh b'mv vyt ydv 'lyv vykhhv vyrgzv hhrym vthy nbltm khsvchh bqrb chvtsvt bkhlz't l'shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against His people, And He hath stretched forth His hand against them, and hath smitten them, And the hills did tremble, And their carcasses were as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָֽשָׂא־נֵ֤ס לַגּוֹיִם֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: vnsh'ns lgvym mrchvq vshrq lv mqtsh h'rts vhnh mhrh ql ybv'
verses.translation: And He will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, And will hiss unto them from the end of the earth; And, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־עָיֵ֤ף וְאֵין־כּוֹשֵׁל֙ בּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א יָנ֖וּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן וְלֹ֤א נִפְתַּח֙ אֵז֣וֹר חֲלָצָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א נִתַּ֖ק שְׂר֥וֹךְ נְעָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'yn'yf v'ynkhvshl bv l' ynvm vl' yyshn vl' nptch 'zvr chltsyv vl' ntq shrvkh n'lyv
verses.translation: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; None shall slumber nor sleep; Neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, Nor the latchet of their shoes be broken;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִצָּיו֙ שְׁנוּנִ֔ים וְכׇל־קַשְּׁתֹתָ֖יו דְּרֻכ֑וֹת פַּרְס֤וֹת סוּסָיו֙ כַּצַּ֣ר נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וְגַלְגִּלָּ֖יו כַּסּוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shr chtsyv shnvnym vkhlqshttyv drkhvt prsvt svsyv khtsr nchshbv vglglyv khsvph
verses.translation: Whose arrows are sharp, And all their bows bent; Their horses’hoofs shall be counted like flint, And their wheels like a whirlwind;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאָגָ֥ה ל֖וֹ כַּלָּבִ֑יא (ושאג) [יִשְׁאַ֨ג] כַּכְּפִירִ֤ים וְיִנְהֹם֙ וְיֹאחֵ֣ז טֶ֔רֶף וְיַפְלִ֖יט וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: sh'gh lv khlby' (vsh'g) [ysh'g] khkhpyrym vynhm vy'chz trf vyplyt v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Their roaring shall be like a lion, They shall roar like young lions, yea, they shall roar, And lay hold of the prey, and carry it away safe, And there shall be none to deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִנְהֹ֥ם עָלָ֛יו בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּנַהֲמַת־יָ֑ם וְנִבַּ֤ט לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְהִנֵּה־חֹ֔שֶׁךְ צַ֣ר וָא֔וֹר חָשַׁ֖ךְ בַּעֲרִיפֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vynhm 'lyv byvm hhv' khnhmtym vnbt l'rts vhnhchshkh tsr v'vr chshkh b'rypyh {p}
verses.translation: And they shall roar against them in that day Like the roaring of the sea; And if one look unto the land, Behold darkness and distress, And the light is darkened in the skies thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת־מוֹת֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וָאֶרְאֶ֧ה אֶת־אֲדֹנָ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֖א רָ֣ם וְנִשָּׂ֑א וְשׁוּלָ֖יו מְלֵאִ֥ים אֶת־הַהֵיכָֽל׃
verses.translit: bshntmvt hmlkh 'zyhv v'r'h 't'dny yshb 'lkhs' rm vnsh' vshvlyv ml'ym 'thhykhl
verses.translation: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne high and lifted up, and His train filled the temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂרָפִ֨ים עֹמְדִ֤ים ׀ מִמַּ֙עַל֙ ל֔וֹ שֵׁ֧שׁ כְּנָפַ֛יִם שֵׁ֥שׁ כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד בִּשְׁתַּ֣יִם  יְכַסֶּ֣ה פָנָ֗יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֛יִם יְכַסֶּ֥ה רַגְלָ֖יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֥יִם יְעוֹפֵֽף׃
verses.translit: shrpym 'mdym  mm'l lv shsh khnpym shsh khnpym l'chd bshtym  ykhsh pnyv vbshtym ykhsh rglyv vbshtym y'vpf
verses.translation: Above Him stood the seraphim; each one had six wings: with twain he covered his face and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vqr' zh 'lzh v'mr qdvsh  qdvsh qdvsh yhvh tsb'vt ml' khlh'rts khbvdv
verses.translation: And one called unto another, and said: Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts; The whole earth is full of His glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּנֻ֙עוּ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַסִּפִּ֔ים מִקּ֖וֹל הַקּוֹרֵ֑א וְהַבַּ֖יִת יִמָּלֵ֥א עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vyn'v 'mvt hspym mqvl hqvr' vhbyt yml' 'shn
verses.translation: And the posts of the door were moved at the voice of them that called, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֞ר אֽוֹי־לִ֣י כִֽי־נִדְמֵ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ טְמֵֽא־שְׂפָתַ֙יִם֙ אָנֹ֔כִי וּבְתוֹךְ֙ עַם־טְמֵ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔יִם אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֑ב כִּ֗י אֶת־הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת רָא֥וּ עֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'vyly khyndmyty khy 'ysh tm'shptym 'nkhy vbtvkh 'mtm' shptym 'nkhy yvshb khy 'thmlkh yhvh tsb'vt r'v 'yny
verses.translation: Then said I: Woe is me! for I am undone; Because I am a man of unclean lips, And I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; For mine eyes have seen the King, The LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣עׇף אֵלַ֗י אֶחָד֙ מִן־הַשְּׂרָפִ֔ים וּבְיָד֖וֹ רִצְפָּ֑ה בְּמֶ֨לְקַחַ֔יִם לָקַ֖ח מֵעַ֥ל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vy'f 'ly 'chd mnhshrpym vbydv rtsph bmlqchym lqch m'l hmzbch
verses.translation: Then flew unto me one of the seraphim, with a glowing stone in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגַּ֣ע עַל־פִּ֔י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה נָגַ֥ע זֶ֖ה עַל־שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ וְסָ֣ר עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְחַטָּאתְךָ֖ תְּכֻפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyg' 'lpy vy'mr hnh ng' zh 'lshptykh vsr 'vnkh vcht'tkh tkhpr
verses.translation: and he touched my mouth with it, and said: Lo, this hath touched thy lips; And thine iniquity is taken away, And thy sin expiated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־ק֤וֹל אֲדֹנָי֙ אֹמֵ֔ר אֶת־מִ֥י אֶשְׁלַ֖ח וּמִ֣י יֵֽלֶךְ־לָ֑נוּ וָאֹמַ֖ר הִנְנִ֥י שְׁלָחֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'shm' 'tqvl 'dny 'mr 'tmy 'shlch vmy ylkhlnv v'mr hnny shlchny
verses.translation: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying: Whom shall I send, And who will go for us? Then I said: ‘Here am I; send me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֵ֥ךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֙וֹעַ֙ וְאַל־תָּבִ֔ינוּ וּרְא֥וּ רָא֖וֹ וְאַל־תֵּדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lkh v'mrt l'm hzh shm'v shmv' v'ltbynv vr'v r'v v'ltd'v
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Go, and tell this people: Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁמֵן֙ לֵב־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאׇזְנָ֥יו הַכְבֵּ֖ד וְעֵינָ֣יו הָשַׁ֑ע פֶּן־יִרְאֶ֨ה בְעֵינָ֜יו וּבְאׇזְנָ֣יו יִשְׁמָ֗ע וּלְבָב֥וֹ יָבִ֛ין וָשָׁ֖ב וְרָ֥פָא לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hshmn lbh'm hzh v'znyv hkhbd v'ynyv hsh' pnyr'h b'ynyv vb'znyv yshm' vlbbv ybyn vshb vrp' lv
verses.translation: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they, seeing with their eyes, and hearing with their ears, and understanding with their heart, return, and be healed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר עַד־מָתַ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑י וַיֹּ֡אמֶר עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר֩ אִם־שָׁא֨וּ עָרִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֗ב וּבָתִּים֙ מֵאֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְהָאֲדָמָ֖ה תִּשָּׁאֶ֥ה שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'dmty 'dny vy'mr 'd 'shr 'msh'v 'rym m'yn yvshb vbtym m'yn 'dm vh'dmh tsh'h shmmh
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘Lord, how long?’ And He answered: ‘Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, And the land become utterly waste,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרִחַ֥ק יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־הָאָדָ֑ם וְרַבָּ֥ה הָעֲזוּבָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vrchq yhvh 'th'dm vrbh h'zvbh bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: And the LORD have removed men far away, and the forsaken places be many in the midst of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֥וֹד בָּהּ֙ עֲשִׂ֣רִיָּ֔ה וְשָׁ֖בָה וְהָיְתָ֣ה לְבָעֵ֑ר כָּאֵלָ֣ה וְכָאַלּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּשַׁלֶּ֙כֶת֙ מַצֶּ֣בֶת בָּ֔ם זֶ֥רַע קֹ֖דֶשׁ מַצַּבְתָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'vd bh 'shryh vshbh vhyth lb'r kh'lh vkh'lvn 'shr bshlkht mtsbt bm zr' qdsh mtsbth {p}
verses.translation: And if there be yet a tenth in it, it shall again be eaten up; as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remaineth, when they cast their leaves, so the holy seed shall be the stock thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י בִּימֵ֣י אָ֠חָ֠ז בֶּן־יוֹתָ֨ם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה עָלָ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲ֠רָ֠ם וּפֶ֨קַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עָלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'chz bnyvtm bn'zyhv mlkh yhvdh 'lh rtsyn mlkh'rm vpqch bnrmlyhv mlkhyshr'l yrvshl͏m lmlchmh 'lyh vl' ykhl lhlchm 'lyh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Aram, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it; but could not prevail against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לְבֵ֤ית דָּוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נָ֥חָה אֲרָ֖ם עַל־אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֤נַע לְבָבוֹ֙ וּלְבַ֣ב עַמּ֔וֹ כְּנ֥וֹעַ עֲצֵי־יַ֖עַר מִפְּנֵי־רֽוּחַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vygd lbyt dvd l'mr nchh 'rm 'l'prym vyn' lbbv vlbb 'mv khnv' 'tsyy'r mpnyrvch {s}
verses.translation: And it was told the house of David, saying: ‘Aram is confederate with Ephraim.’ And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest are moved with the wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָה֮ אֶֽל־יְשַֽׁעְיָ֒הוּ֒ צֵא־נָא֙ לִקְרַ֣את אָחָ֔ז אַתָּ֕ה וּשְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בְּנֶ֑ךָ אֶל־קְצֵ֗ה תְּעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lysh'yhv ts'n' lqr't 'chz 'th vsh'r yshvb bnkh 'lqtsh t'lt hbrkhh h'lyvnh 'lmslt shdh khvbs
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah: ‘Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, in the highway of the fullers’field;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵ֠לָ֠יו הִשָּׁמֵ֨ר וְהַשְׁקֵ֜ט אַל־תִּירָ֗א וּלְבָֽבְךָ֙ אַל־יֵרַ֔ךְ מִשְּׁנֵ֨י זַנְב֧וֹת הָאוּדִ֛ים הָעֲשֵׁנִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בׇּחֳרִי־אַ֛ף רְצִ֥ין וַאֲרָ֖ם וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyv hshmr vhshqt 'ltyr' vlbbkh 'lyrkh mshny znbvt h'vdym h'shnym h'lh bchry'f rtsyn v'rm vbnrmlyhv
verses.translation: and say unto him: Keep calm, and be quiet; fear not, neither let thy heart be faint, because of these two tails of smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּֽי־יָעַ֥ץ עָלֶ֛יךָ אֲרָ֖ם רָעָ֑ה אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: y'n khyy'ts 'lykh 'rm r'h 'prym vbnrmlyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Because Aram hath counselled evil against thee, Ephraim also, and the son of Remaliah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַעֲלֶ֤ה בִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּנְקִיצֶ֔נָּה וְנַבְקִעֶ֖נָּה אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְנַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן־טָֽבְאַֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: n'lh byhvdh vnqytsnh vnbq'nh 'lynv vnmlykh mlkh btvkhh 't bntb'l {p}
verses.translation: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set up a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה לֹ֥א תָק֖וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l' tqvm vl' thyh
verses.translation: thus saith the Lord GOD: It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י רֹ֤אשׁ אֲרָם֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְרֹ֥אשׁ דַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק רְצִ֑ין וּבְע֗וֹד שִׁשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה יֵחַ֥ת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy r'sh 'rm dmshq vr'sh dmshq rtsyn vb'vd shshym vchmsh shnh ycht 'prym m'm
verses.translation: For the head of Aram is Damascus, And the head of Damascus is Rezin; And within threescore and five years Shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וְרֹ֥אשׁ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן בֶּן־רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַאֲמִ֔ינוּ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א תֵאָמֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vr'sh 'prym shmrvn vr'sh shmrvn bnrmlyhv 'm l' t'mynv khy l' t'mnv {p}
verses.translation: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, And the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not have faith, surely ye shall not be established.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֣וֹסֶף יְהֹוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־אָחָ֖ז לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyvsf yhvh dbr 'l'chz l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke again unto Ahaz, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאַל־לְךָ֣ א֔וֹת מֵעִ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ הַעְמֵ֣ק שְׁאָ֔לָה א֖וֹ הַגְבֵּ֥הַּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: sh'llkh 'vt m'm yhvh 'lhykh h'mq sh'lh 'v hgbh lm'lh
verses.translation: ’Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God: ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָחָ֑ז לֹא־אֶשְׁאַ֥ל וְלֹֽא־אֲנַסֶּ֖ה אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chz l''sh'l vl''nsh 'tyhvh
verses.translation: But Ahaz said: ‘I will not ask, neither will I try the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֖א בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד הַמְעַ֤ט מִכֶּם֙ הַלְא֣וֹת אֲנָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י תַלְא֖וּ גַּ֥ם אֶת־אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shm'vn' byt dvd hm't mkhm hl'vt 'nshym khy tl'v gm 't'lhy
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Hear ye now, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to weary men, that ye will weary my God also?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵ֠ן יִתֵּ֨ן אֲדֹנָ֥י ה֛וּא לָכֶ֖ם א֑וֹת הִנֵּ֣ה הָעַלְמָ֗ה הָרָה֙ וְיֹלֶ֣דֶת בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥את שְׁמ֖וֹ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn ytn 'dny hv' lkhm 'vt hnh h'lmh hrh vyldt bn vqr't shmv 'mnv 'l
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord Himself shall give you a sign: behold, the young woman shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶמְאָ֥ה וּדְבַ֖שׁ יֹאכֵ֑ל לְדַעְתּ֛וֹ מָא֥וֹס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָח֥וֹר בַּטּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: chm'h vdbsh y'khl ld'tv m'vs br' vbchvr btvb
verses.translation: Curd and honey shall he eat, when he knoweth to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י בְּטֶ֨רֶם יֵדַ֥ע הַנַּ֛עַר מָאֹ֥ס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָחֹ֣ר בַּטּ֑וֹב תֵּעָזֵ֤ב הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה קָ֔ץ מִפְּנֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י מְלָכֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khy btrm yd' hn'r m's br' vbchr btvb t'zb h'dmh 'shr 'th qts mpny shny mlkhyh
verses.translation: Yea, before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings thou hast a horror of shall be forsaken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָבִ֨יא יְהֹוָ֜ה עָלֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־עַמְּךָ֮ וְעַל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֒יךָ֒ יָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־בָ֔אוּ לְמִיּ֥וֹם סוּר־אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֑ה אֵ֖ת מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yby' yhvh 'lykh v'l'mkh v'lbyt 'bykh ymym 'shr l'b'v lmyvm svr'prym m'l yhvdh 't mlkh 'shvr {p}
verses.translation: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִשְׁרֹ֤ק יְהֹוָה֙ לַזְּב֔וּב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה יְאֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלַ֨דְּבוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' yshrq yhvh lzbvb 'shr bqtsh y'ry mtsrym vldbvrh 'shr b'rts 'shvr
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the LORD shall hiss for the fly That is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, And for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ וְנָח֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ בְּנַחֲלֵ֣י הַבַּתּ֔וֹת וּבִנְקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים וּבְכֹל֙ הַנַּ֣עֲצוּצִ֔ים וּבְכֹ֖ל הַנַּהֲלֹלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vb'v vnchv khlm bnchly hbtvt vbnqyqy hsl'ym vbkhl hn'tsvtsym vbkhl hnhllym
verses.translation: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them In the rugged valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, And upon all thorns, and upon all brambles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יְגַלַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָי֩ בְּתַ֨עַר הַשְּׂכִירָ֜ה בְּעֶבְרֵ֤י נָהָר֙ בְּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר אֶת־הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְשַׂ֣עַר הָרַגְלָ֑יִם וְגַ֥ם אֶת־הַזָּקָ֖ן תִּסְפֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yglch 'dny bt'r hshkhyrh b'bry nhr bmlkh 'shvr 'thr'sh vsh'r hrglym vgm 'thzqn tsph {p}
verses.translation: In that day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also sweep away the beard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא יְחַיֶּה־אִ֛ישׁ עֶגְלַ֥ת בָּקָ֖ר וּשְׁתֵּי־צֹֽאן׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ychyh'ysh 'glt bqr vshtyts'n
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall rear a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מֵרֹ֛ב עֲשׂ֥וֹת חָלָ֖ב יֹאכַ֣ל חֶמְאָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֶמְאָ֤ה וּדְבַשׁ֙ יֹאכֵ֔ל כׇּל־הַנּוֹתָ֖ר בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh mrb 'shvt chlb y'khl chm'h khychm'h vdbsh y'khl khlhnvtr bqrb h'rts {s}
verses.translation: and it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give, he shall eat curd; for curd and honey shall every one eat that is left in the midst of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה כׇל־מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִֽהְיֶה־שָּׁ֛ם אֶ֥לֶף גֶּ֖פֶן בְּאֶ֣לֶף כָּ֑סֶף לַשָּׁמִ֥יר וְלַשַּׁ֖יִת יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' yhyh khlmqvm 'shr yhyhshm 'lf gpn b'lf khsf lshmyr vlshyt yhyh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחִצִּ֥ים וּבַקֶּ֖שֶׁת יָ֣בוֹא שָׁ֑מָּה כִּֽי־שָׁמִ֥יר וָשַׁ֖יִת תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה כׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: bchtsym vbqsht ybv' shmh khyshmyr vshyt thyh khlh'rts
verses.translation: With arrows and with bow shall one come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל הֶהָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּמַּעְדֵּר֙ יֵעָ֣דֵר֔וּן לֹא־תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְהָיָה֙ לְמִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר וּלְמִרְמַ֖ס שֶֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhl hhrym 'shr bm'dr y'drvn l'tbv' shmh yr't shmyr vshyt vhyh lmshlch shvr vlmrms shh {p}
verses.translation: And all the hills that were digged with the mattock, thou shalt not come thither for fear of briers and thorns, but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קַח־לְךָ֖ גִּלָּי֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וּכְתֹ֤ב עָלָיו֙ בְּחֶ֣רֶט אֱנ֔וֹשׁ לְמַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qchlkh glyvn gdvl vkhtb 'lyv bchrt 'nvsh lmhr shll chsh bz
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Take thee a great tablet, and write upon it in common script: The spoil speedeth, the prey hasteth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָעִ֣ידָה לִּ֔י עֵדִ֖ים נֶאֱמָנִ֑ים אֵ֚ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּ֥ן יְבֶרֶכְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: v''ydh ly 'dym n'mnym 't 'vryh hkhhn v'tzkhryhv bn ybrkhyhv
verses.translation: and I will take unto Me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְרַב֙ אֶל־הַנְּבִיאָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן {ס} וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ מַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃
verses.translit: v'qrb 'lhnby'h vthr vtld bn {s} vy'mr yhvh 'ly qr' shmv mhr shll chsh bz
verses.translation: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bore a son. Then said the LORD unto me: ‘Call his name Maher-shalal-hashbaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ יֵדַ֣ע הַנַּ֔עַר קְרֹ֖א אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֑י יִשָּׂ֣א  אֶת־חֵ֣יל דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק וְאֵת֙ שְׁלַ֣ל שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy btrm yd' hn'r qr' 'by v'my ysh'  'tchyl dmshq v't shll shmrvn lpny mlkh 'shvr {s}
verses.translation: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry: My father, and: My mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be carried away before the king of Assyria.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהֹוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vysf yhvh dbr 'ly 'vd l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto me yet again, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָאַס֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֚ת מֵ֣י הַשִּׁלֹ֔חַ הַהֹלְכִ֖ים לְאַ֑ט וּמְשׂ֥וֹשׂ אֶת־רְצִ֖ין וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: y'n khy m's h'm hzh 't my hshlch hhlkhym l't vmshvsh 'trtsyn vbnrmlyhv
verses.translation: Forasmuch as this people hath refused The waters of Shiloah that go softly, And rejoiceth with Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָכֵ֡ן הִנֵּ֣ה אֲדֹנָי֩ מַעֲלֶ֨ה עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַנָּהָ֗ר הָעֲצוּמִים֙ וְהָ֣רַבִּ֔ים אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְאֶת־כׇּל־כְּבוֹד֑וֹ וְעָלָה֙ עַל־כׇּל־אֲפִיקָ֔יו וְהָלַ֖ךְ עַל־כׇּל־גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vlkhn hnh 'dny m'lh 'lyhm 'tmy hnhr h'tsvmym vhrbym 'tmlkh 'shvr v'tkhlkhbvdv v'lh 'lkhl'pyqyv vhlkh 'lkhlgdvtyv
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them The waters of the River, mighty and many, Even the king of Assyria and all his glory; And he shall come up over all his channels, And go over all his banks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָלַ֤ף בִּֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבַ֔ר עַד־צַוָּ֖אר יַגִּ֑יעַ וְהָיָה֙ מֻטּ֣וֹת כְּנָפָ֔יו מְלֹ֥א רֹחַב־אַרְצְךָ֖ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchlf byhvdh shtf v'br 'dtsv'r ygy' vhyh mtvt khnpyv ml' rchb'rtskh 'mnv 'l {s}
verses.translation: And he shall sweep through Judah Overflowing as he passeth through He shall reach even to the neck; And the stretching out of his wings Shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֤עוּ עַמִּים֙ וָחֹ֔תּוּ וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל מֶרְחַקֵּי־אָ֑רֶץ הִתְאַזְּר֣וּ וָחֹ֔תּוּ הִֽתְאַזְּר֖וּ וָחֹֽתּוּ׃
verses.translit: r'v 'mym vchtv vh'zynv khl mrchqy'rts ht'zrv vchtv ht'zrv vchtv
verses.translation: Make an uproar, O ye peoples, and ye shall be broken in pieces; And give ear, all ye of far countries; Gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; Gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֻ֥צוּ עֵצָ֖ה וְתֻפָ֑ר דַּבְּר֤וּ דָבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָק֔וּם כִּ֥י עִמָּ֖נוּ אֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tsv 'tsh vtpr dbrv dbr vl' yqvm khy 'mnv 'l {s}
verses.translation: Take counsel together, and it shall be brought to nought; Speak the word, and it shall not stand; For God is with us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י כְּחֶזְקַ֣ת הַיָּ֑ד וְיִסְּרֵ֕נִי מִלֶּ֛כֶת בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'ly khchzqt hyd vysrny mlkht bdrkh h'mhzh l'mr
verses.translation: For the LORD spoke thus to me with a strong hand, admonishing me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תֹאמְר֣וּן קֶ֔שֶׁר לְכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֛ר הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁר וְאֶת־מוֹרָא֥וֹ לֹא־תִֽירְא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃
verses.translit: l't'mrvn qshr lkhl 'shry'mr h'm hzh qshr v'tmvr'v l'tyr'v vl' t'rytsv
verses.translation: ’Say ye not: A conspiracy, concerning all whereof this people do say: A conspiracy; neither fear ye their fear, nor account it dreadful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֹת֣וֹ תַקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ וְה֥וּא מוֹרַאֲכֶ֖ם וְה֥וּא מַעֲרִֽצְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'tyhvh tsb'vt 'tv tqdyshv vhv' mvr'khm vhv' m'rtskhm
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts, Him shall ye sanctify; and let Him be your fear, and let Him be your dread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה לְמִקְדָּ֑שׁ וּלְאֶ֣בֶן נֶ֠גֶף וּלְצ֨וּר מִכְשׁ֜וֹל לִשְׁנֵ֨י בָתֵּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְפַ֣ח וּלְמוֹקֵ֔שׁ לְיוֹשֵׁ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhyh lmqdsh vl'bn ngf vltsvr mkhshvl lshny bty yshr'l lpch vlmvqsh lyvshb yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And He shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָ֥שְׁלוּ בָ֖ם רַבִּ֑ים וְנָפְל֣וּ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhshlv bm rbym vnplv vnshbrv vnvqshv vnlkhdv {p}
verses.translation: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צ֖וֹר תְּעוּדָ֑ה חֲת֥וֹם תּוֹרָ֖ה בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃
verses.translit: tsvr t'vdh chtvm tvrh blmdy
verses.translation: ’Bind up the testimony, seal the instruction among My disciples.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִכִּ֙יתִי֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה הַמַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖יו מִבֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְקִוֵּ֖יתִי־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vchkhyty lyhvh hmstyr pnyv mbyt y'qb vqvytylv
verses.translation: And I will wait for the LORD, that hideth His face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י וְהַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן־לִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה לְאֹת֥וֹת וּלְמוֹפְתִ֖ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵעִם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַשֹּׁכֵ֖ן בְּהַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy vhyldym 'shr ntnly yhvh l'tvt vlmvptym byshr'l m'm yhvh tsb'vt hshkhn bhr tsyvn {s}
verses.translation: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me shall be for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, who dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יֹאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיכֶ֗ם דִּרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־הָֽאֹבוֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים הַֽמְצַפְצְפִ֖ים וְהַמַּהְגִּ֑ים הֲלוֹא־עַם֙ אֶל־אֱלֹהָ֣יו יִדְרֹ֔שׁ בְּעַ֥ד הַחַיִּ֖ים אֶל־הַמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhyy'mrv 'lykhm drshv 'lh'bvt v'lhyd'nym hmtsptspym vhmhgym hlv''m 'l'lhyv ydrsh b'd hchyym 'lhmtym
verses.translation: And when they shall say unto you: ‘Seek unto the ghosts and the familiar spirits, that chirp and that mutter; should not a people seek unto their God? on behalf of the living unto the dead
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְתוֹרָ֖ה וְלִתְעוּדָ֑ה אִם־לֹ֤א יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ל֖וֹ שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: ltvrh vlt'vdh 'ml' y'mrv khdbr hzh 'shr 'ynlv shchr
verses.translation: for instruction and for testimony?’—Surely they will speak according to this word, wherein there is no light.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָ֥בַר בָּ֖הּ נִקְשֶׁ֣ה וְרָעֵ֑ב וְהָיָ֨ה כִֽי־יִרְעַ֜ב וְהִתְקַצַּ֗ף וְקִלֵּ֧ל בְּמַלְכּ֛וֹ וּבֵאלֹהָ֖יו וּפָנָ֥ה לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: v'br bh nqshh vr'b vhyh khyyr'b vhtqtsf vqll bmlkhv vb'lhyv vpnh lm'lh
verses.translation: And they shall pass this way that are sore bestead and hungry; and it shall come to pass that, when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse by their king and by their God, and, whether they turn their faces upward,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט וְהִנֵּ֨ה צָרָ֤ה וַֽחֲשֵׁכָה֙ מְע֣וּף צוּקָ֔ה וַאֲפֵלָ֖ה מְנֻדָּֽח׃
verses.translit: v'l'rts ybyt vhnh tsrh vchshkhh m'vf tsvqh v'plh mndch
verses.translation: or look unto the earth, behold distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish, and outspread thick darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֣א מוּעָף֮ לַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מוּצָ֣ק לָהּ֒ כָּעֵ֣ת הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן הֵקַ֞ל אַ֤רְצָה זְבֻלוּן֙ וְאַ֣רְצָה נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְהָאַחֲר֖וֹן הִכְבִּ֑יד דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַיָּם֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן גְּלִ֖יל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' mv'f l'shr mvtsq lh kh't hr'shvn hql 'rtsh zblvn v'rtsh nptly vh'chrvn hkhbyd drkh hym 'br hyrdn glyl hgvym
verses.translation: For is there no gloom to her that was stedfast? Now the former hath lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but the latter hath dealt a more grievous blow by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, in the district of the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
